chapters.title: Chapter 5489: Unknown! II
paragraphs: The crossing, in the end, gave them no trouble at all!

Perhaps that should have been comforting. The dark between Dimensions had offered nothing but its frothing quiet as no wakes rose to meet them, no attention pressed back against their own as the living vessel flowed along its chosen road until the road simply ended. Ahead, through the radiant stanchions of blue, gold, and crimson...the outer boundary of their destination resolved out of the boundless dark!
The outer weavings of this Dimension were unfathomably heavy.

Age pressed off of them in profound waves as even at the boundary, even before entry, the threads out here ran thicker and older than anything his Sight had ever read before! How old did something have to be before its edges alone felt like this? He had stood before THE Queen Regnant. He had felt THE Sealed One fill an entire sky. Neither of those weights had carried this particular texture of sheer ancientness!
And just as Ryaenara had said, entering an open Dimension was no issue at all as the boundary took hold of the vessel gently, and they began to be pulled in.
Noah breathed out.

What here would have a connection to him, if anything did? His Eye had chosen this door out of millions, across time itself as an Anchor was a promise to a possibility. So was he closing a loop in time right now? Was some deed of his already waiting in this place, aged and patient, recorded in a history he had not lived yet?! Would he find answers here, or only more questions?
He didn’t know.
"Let’s go!"
Without an ounce of fear or doubt, he proceeded in.
HUUM!

The passage was unlike the crossing that came before it as entering felt like falling through countless event horizons stacked one behind another, each threshold folding space differently than the last as their sense of time and distance came apart entirely somewhere in the middle of it all. Up became a memory. Duration became a rumor! The glorious vessel held as Ruination’s weave hummed through every stanchion, and then, all at once...they arrived.
BOOM!
They arrived into liquid!

A viscous, glowing fluid pressed in around all of them as it filled the curved space they had emerged into from wall to wall. And it did not wait politely at their skin! The fluid forced its way into their bodies, into their very existences as it pushed past defenses that had turned aside the authorities of Mesozoic Scale beings as if those defenses were mere suggestions.
Power did not matter to it. It entered THE Creature the same way it entered the Dora Shath’yar, utterly indifferent to the difference between them!
HUUM!
|A foreign authority has forcefully entered your existence. I attempted to bar it and was overruled.|
Noah fought it on instinct as his Intent rose, his Foundations bracing to expel the intrusion.
And then, an instant later, he stopped.
BOOM!
Because his existence was cheering.

There was no better word for it! His Foundations, every single one of them, turned toward the invading substance the way roots turn toward water as he felt them begin to advance. THE Tide hummed. THE Hunger woke ravenous! Even the sleeping eight stirred in their grades as through all of him ran a fervor his body had not even asked his mind’s permission for.

|Correction to my prior report, and happily so. The foreign matter is extremely conducive to growth. It is being integrated across every component of your existence at once. +10,000 Osmontian Biomass has been gained. +20,000 Osmontian Biomass has been gained. +20,000 Osmontian Biomass has been gained...The count is still climbing.|
Prompts of majesty and wonder!

His existence buzzed with shock and fervor both as his eyes flashed with tyranny. If this place wanted to pour wealth into him uninvited, then he would stop being a passive recipient about it! Noah opened THE Hunger That Refines fully and began to actively devour the substance around him, drawing it in through skin and breath and existence alike!
He wasn’t the only one.

THE Creature had already begun as his obsidian flames drank the fluid in slow greedy spirals. THE Infiniverse absorbed through every thread of her manifestation, and Emotive laughed somewhere in the golden thickness of it all, pulling the liquid in like a girl gulping air after a long dive! Even Ryaenara, wary as she was, had clearly decided that waste was the greater sin as every being aboard became akin to a black hole, the glowing fluid thinning around them, and thinning...until at last the curved space stood entirely empty of it!
Then the walls began to crack.
BZZT!

Thin fracture lines spidered across the edges of the space, glowing at their seams as the whole enclosure shuddered around them. Through the widening cracks came air, and the air was heavy! Dense past anything Observable Existences or THE Primordial Source offered, thick with terrifying concentrations of some unknown matter as it flooded in and pressed against them.
CRACK!
The cracks met. The walls gave!

And everything broke open at once, the curved shell falling away in great pale shards as they rose out of it into open air with the residue of the enclosure clinging to all of them, streaks of glistening film and clinging membrane...the unmistakable leavings of the inside of...an egg.
They had been inside an egg!

Noah wiped a slick of it from his jaw and looked around as the looking answered one question by opening ten more! They stood in a nest. A vast one, woven from materials even his Sight could not fully parse as its walls rose around them like hills, and beyond its rim, the air of the wider Dimension pressed down so heavily that his awareness could not spread past his immediate surroundings at all! He pushed against that pressure once, carefully. It did not push back so much as simply decline to move!

His existence buzzed with elation and oppression in the same breath. Oppression, because nothing here yielded even an inch to him. Elation, because the air itself was so pure, so pristine, that merely standing in it fed him! He could feel the slow steady tick of it already, Osmontian Biomass accruing from nothing but his very presense!
What kind of place fed you for existing in it while crushing your senses in the same breath? What had they hatched out of? And whose nest was this?
As they acclimated, an inflow of information arrived, freely and unasked.
|Master, information is being given. Given, to all entrants, as a matter of this Dimension’s law. I will relay it as it settles.|

|You have been born again with your entry. All of you. Passage into this Dimension occurs in no other way, and by hatching, you have been recognized as inhabitants. The Dimension now counts you among its own.|
|You have arrived in THE Krazhor-Nul. Its weavings sit before Vakochev’s Scales of Existence were ever born.|

|A caution, delivered with the welcome. This place is lethal as a matter of course. Anything that is not a True Lifeform will die here within minutes, unraveled by the same ambient density currently feeding you. The Dora Shath’yar and Amser Modred survive, for now, because they hatched within your Pantheon’s protection and stand inside its reach. I recommend they remain there.|
|The weavings of ancientness saturate everything here. And through all of it, prevalent past measuring, runs the aura of Those Who Remain.|
Noah’s eyes were unfathomably bright!
Behind him, Ryaenara’s gaze had gone heavy, and then her composure simply failed her.
"Fuck... fuck! Osmont!"
She cursed him out as if he had personally murdered all of them.
Noah remained standing strong, egg residue and all. Because before anything else, before the nest and the name and even the aura of Those Who Remain...something in him had already begun to move!

|THE Tide That Owes Nothing has been triggered, Master, and Straif has finished settling just in time to answer it. You have given safe passage across Dimensions and Time itself, delivering a number of beings to an unfathomable place none of them could have reached alone. The Tide recognizes the carriage, the protection, and the arrival as one compound act of giving.|

|At C-Rank, Straif, the grade that sharpens and compels, the Tide’s returns now range from three thousand to twenty thousandfold, and it has gained the property of Sharpened Returns: boons no longer arrive merely as value, but honed toward what serves you most in the moment of payment.|

|Boons delivered. +75,000 Osmontian Biomass. Your rate of ambient absorption within this Dimension has been sharpened threefold, for you and for every being you carried. And one further return, shaped by where we now stand: a single thread of standing within THE Krazhor-Nul. You did not merely hatch as an inhabitant. As of this moment, the Dimension recognizes you as one born of its First Clutch, and I do not yet know what that title carries.|

sentences.text: The crossing, in the end, gave them no trouble at all!
Perhaps that should have been comforting.

The dark between Dimensions had offered nothing but its frothing quiet as no wakes rose to meet them, no attention pressed back against their own as the living vessel flowed along its chosen road until the road simply ended.
Ahead, through the radiant stanchions of blue, gold, and crimson...the outer boundary of their destination resolved out of the boundless dark!
The outer weavings of this Dimension were unfathomably heavy.
Age pressed off of them in profound waves as even at the boundary, even before entry, the threads out here ran thicker and older than anything his Sight had ever read before!
How old did something have to be before its edges alone felt like this?
He had stood before THE Queen Regnant.
He had felt THE Sealed One fill an entire sky.
Neither of those weights had carried this particular texture of sheer ancientness!
And just as Ryaenara had said, entering an open Dimension was no issue at all as the boundary took hold of the vessel gently, and they began to be pulled in.
Noah breathed out.
What here would have a connection to him, if anything did?
His Eye had chosen this door out of millions, across time itself as an Anchor was a promise to a possibility.
So was he closing a loop in time right now?
Was some deed of his already waiting in this place, aged and patient, recorded in a history he had not lived yet?!
Would he find answers here, or only more questions?
He didn’t know.
"Let’s go!"
Without an ounce of fear or doubt, he proceeded in.
HUUM!

The passage was unlike the crossing that came before it as entering felt like falling through countless event horizons stacked one behind another, each threshold folding space differently than the last as their sense of time and distance came apart entirely somewhere in the middle of it all.
Up became a memory.
Duration became a rumor!
The glorious vessel held as Ruination’s weave hummed through every stanchion, and then, all at once...they arrived.
BOOM!
They arrived into liquid!
A viscous, glowing fluid pressed in around all of them as it filled the curved space they had emerged into from wall to wall.
And it did not wait politely at their skin!

The fluid forced its way into their bodies, into their very existences as it pushed past defenses that had turned aside the authorities of Mesozoic Scale beings as if those defenses were mere suggestions.
Power did not matter to it.
It entered THE Creature the same way it entered the Dora Shath’yar, utterly indifferent to the difference between them!
HUUM!
|A foreign authority has forcefully entered your existence.
I attempted to bar it and was overruled.|
Noah fought it on instinct as his Intent rose, his Foundations bracing to expel the intrusion.
And then, an instant later, he stopped.
BOOM!
Because his existence was cheering.
There was no better word for it!
His Foundations, every single one of them, turned toward the invading substance the way roots turn toward water as he felt them begin to advance.
THE Tide hummed.
THE Hunger woke ravenous!
Even the sleeping eight stirred in their grades as through all of him ran a fervor his body had not even asked his mind’s permission for.
|Correction to my prior report, and happily so.
The foreign matter is extremely conducive to growth.

It is being integrated across every component of your existence at once. +10,000 Osmontian Biomass has been gained. +20,000 Osmontian Biomass has been gained. +20,000 Osmontian Biomass has been gained...The count is still climbing.|
Prompts of majesty and wonder!
His existence buzzed with shock and fervor both as his eyes flashed with tyranny.
If this place wanted to pour wealth into him uninvited, then he would stop being a passive recipient about it!
Noah opened THE Hunger That Refines fully and began to actively devour the substance around him, drawing it in through skin and breath and existence alike!
He wasn’t the only one.
THE Creature had already begun as his obsidian flames drank the fluid in slow greedy spirals.
THE Infiniverse absorbed through every thread of her manifestation, and Emotive laughed somewhere in the golden thickness of it all, pulling the liquid in like a girl gulping air after a long dive!

Even Ryaenara, wary as she was, had clearly decided that waste was the greater sin as every being aboard became akin to a black hole, the glowing fluid thinning around them, and thinning...until at last the curved space stood entirely empty of it!
Then the walls began to crack.
BZZT!
Thin fracture lines spidered across the edges of the space, glowing at their seams as the whole enclosure shuddered around them.
Through the widening cracks came air, and the air was heavy!
Dense past anything Observable Existences or THE Primordial Source offered, thick with terrifying concentrations of some unknown matter as it flooded in and pressed against them.
CRACK!
The cracks met.
The walls gave!

And everything broke open at once, the curved shell falling away in great pale shards as they rose out of it into open air with the residue of the enclosure clinging to all of them, streaks of glistening film and clinging membrane...the unmistakable leavings of the inside of...an egg.
They had been inside an egg!
Noah wiped a slick of it from his jaw and looked around as the looking answered one question by opening ten more!
They stood in a nest.

A vast one, woven from materials even his Sight could not fully parse as its walls rose around them like hills, and beyond its rim, the air of the wider Dimension pressed down so heavily that his awareness could not spread past his immediate surroundings at all!
He pushed against that pressure once, carefully.
It did not push back so much as simply decline to move!
His existence buzzed with elation and oppression in the same breath.
Oppression, because nothing here yielded even an inch to him.
Elation, because the air itself was so pure, so pristine, that merely standing in it fed him!
He could feel the slow steady tick of it already, Osmontian Biomass accruing from nothing but his very presense!
What kind of place fed you for existing in it while crushing your senses in the same breath?
What had they hatched out of?
And whose nest was this?
As they acclimated, an inflow of information arrived, freely and unasked.
|Master, information is being given.
Given, to all entrants, as a matter of this Dimension’s law.
I will relay it as it settles.|
|You have been born again with your entry.
All of you.
Passage into this Dimension occurs in no other way, and by hatching, you have been recognized as inhabitants.
The Dimension now counts you among its own.|
|You have arrived in THE Krazhor-Nul.
Its weavings sit before Vakochev’s Scales of Existence were ever born.|
|A caution, delivered with the welcome.
This place is lethal as a matter of course.
Anything that is not a True Lifeform will die here within minutes, unraveled by the same ambient density currently feeding you.
The Dora Shath’yar and Amser Modred survive, for now, because they hatched within your Pantheon’s protection and stand inside its reach.
I recommend they remain there.|
|The weavings of ancientness saturate everything here.
And through all of it, prevalent past measuring, runs the aura of Those Who Remain.|
Noah’s eyes were unfathomably bright!
Behind him, Ryaenara’s gaze had gone heavy, and then her composure simply failed her.
"Fuck... fuck!
Osmont!"
She cursed him out as if he had personally murdered all of them.
Noah remained standing strong, egg residue and all.
Because before anything else, before the nest and the name and even the aura of Those Who Remain...something in him had already begun to move!
|THE Tide That Owes Nothing has been triggered, Master, and Straif has finished settling just in time to answer it.
You have given safe passage across Dimensions and Time itself, delivering a number of beings to an unfathomable place none of them could have reached alone.
The Tide recognizes the carriage, the protection, and the arrival as one compound act of giving.|

|At C-Rank, Straif, the grade that sharpens and compels, the Tide’s returns now range from three thousand to twenty thousandfold, and it has gained the property of Sharpened Returns: boons no longer arrive merely as value, but honed toward what serves you most in the moment of payment.|

And one further return, shaped by where we now stand: a single thread of standing within THE Krazhor-Nul.
You did not merely hatch as an inhabitant.
As of this moment, the Dimension recognizes you as one born of its First Clutch, and I do not yet know what that title carries.|

chapters.title: Chapter 5490: Peril! I
paragraphs: The weavings of existence within THE Krazhor-Nul were not easily discernible.
Yet Noah kept an eye on his continuing changes as the ambient wealth of this ancient place ticked steadily into him, his existence buzzing with wonder as he turned towards a stern Ryaenara!

The exquisite figure of THE Mirthful Antiquity had gone stern in a way he had rarely seen from her as her hands were already moving, waving through the heavy air as strands of her boundless power spread out to cover everyone present, settling over them in radiant fine layers as she was veiling them!
She was not doing this casually either, but with the thorough and hurried care of someone wrapping priceless treasures before a calamitous storm arrived.
"THE Krazhor-Nul is a place I have only ever heard of. And what I heard was enough to never come looking."
She kept weaving as she spoke, the words flowing out fast as her vibrant eyes shone with graveness!
"This place held the first templates of Lifeforms. Experiments, run by the Cursed Descendants, the Cursed Lineage of Existence descending from a particularly powerful one among Those Who Remain."
She did not name which one!

"Regal Steeds of Those Who Remain were bred in this Dimension as experiments, and they were the first Lifeforms ever cultivated as if they were Observable Existences, each one was given its own First Cause as each one was meant to be untouched, set apart, perfect! The Progeny who tended this place akin to farmhands were told plainly to never hold designs on the Steeds of Those Who Remain."

Around the vast nest, the listening beings had gone still as the hand of Astrid settled on her spear without her even seeming to notice, the patient purple light of Amser Modred turning slower and slower!

"But of course, such Steeds were unfathomable things to leave alone. Lifeforms holding their own First Causes, bred for the backs of Those Who Remain? Greed overcame the Progeny as greed always does, they tried to take the Steeds for themselves and for it...they were cursed!"
WAA!

"The Steeds they touched were cursed alongside them as their Causes collapsed into perpetual terminal weavings, every experiment declared a failure in a single stroke as all of them became Abominations. The Steeds with their failing Causes...and the Progeny themselves!"
She finished the veil and let her hands fall as her voice carried boundless graveness.

"The Descendants have been seeking escape from their curse ever since. That is what this Dimension is now! They experiment on every other lifeform they can reach, hunting for solutions as they cast weavings across existence to pull subjects in. Infinite Lifeforms, Source Lifeforms, Gilded ones, anything unique...even True Lifeforms and Primeval ones who find their way here are treated as nothing more than experimental subjects for the Cursed Descendants!"
Words of terrifying calamity echoed.

The Dora Shath’yar had gone grim down their whole line as Emotive pressed closer against Noah’s arm, her manic light banked low for once as even the manifestation of THE Infiniverse had drawn quiet, her gaze moving slowly across the colossal nest walls as though re-measuring what had hatched them.
Only Noah’s eyes were shining.
Brilliantly, in fact, as if he was hearing something entirely different compared to everyone else here!
At this moment, THE Creature floated up while looking around the vast nest with his cold and unhurried attention as he nodded.

"I have heard of this place as well. It is one even Primeval Lifeforms try to avoid as the Cursed Descendants are ruthless in trying to reverse their fates, they are powerful, but their lives carry an expiration date. They reproduce well enough, but some die after a hundred years, some after a thousand, some after a million depending on the potency of the curse in their line."
His obsidian flames burned low and even as his grand voice continued.

"Knowing there are lifeforms so much weaker than them who can live for so much longer made them extremely brutal. If this place is even slightly survivable, it will hold tremendous adversity. Otherwise..."
He did not finish the sentence.
Even THE Creature was somber as Noah almost wanted to ask him the obvious question of just how he could have any informstion about this place at all!

Ryaenara had only heard rumors, and she was more powerful than any of them here...so what had THE Creature heard, and from whom, and in which era? The question joined a growing shelf of questions about his companion!
But he set this aside for now.
Because his mind was buzzing with something else entirely!

Cursed Steeds of Those Who Remain that were designed and engineered like Observable Existences, each one holding its own First Cause...and now cursed with their Causes locked in perpetual terminal weavings. Dying, in other words! Dying the slow structural death of ones whose foundations were failing.
His shining eyes turned to gaze at THE Infiniverse.

She could effectively be considered a Living Observable Existence, couldn’t she? A domain with her own Causes and her own Egoic Intent, aware, alive, whole...she was, when he laid it out plainly, a success! The very thing these ancient experiments had been reaching for when they cultivated Lifeforms as Observable Existences was standing in this nest fully realized while wearing a cerulean-threaded dress!
And the Steeds?

If they truly were cursed and dying lifeforms built on the architecture of Observable Existences, then what were their failing First Causes if not the exact wound Noah had already healed multiple times before?!
He had resuscitated Chernobyl. He had resuscitated the drowned Cradle, seating Causes into dying foundations was not a theory to him.
It was a practiced craft!
Was this why THE Estuary Eye had drawn him into this perilous place?!
Out of millions of doors across the dark, across time itself, his Anchor had chosen the one Dimension holding such history!
As he was thinking all of this...
HUUM!
His existence buzzed with warning and immensity at this time unlike any other!
A colossal shadow covered the nest.
Noah and the others looked up as their gazes changed.

Right. Many lifeforms were pulled into this place. And they had come out of an egg inside a nest as naturally, nests did not tend themselves! Something had built this one, something had laid or gathered or guarded what hatched here and looked after it...and that something seemed to have come home!
Its aura was suffocating as crimson eyes opened wide and curved into an utterly devilish smile, as if it were looking at vibrant new meals!

chapters.title: Chapter 5491: Peril! II
paragraphs: The crimson eyes did not blink.

They curved with that devilish delight as the colossal shadow above the nest finally lowered itself into full view, and the sight of it pressed down on every existence present like a hand closing slowly around a throat!
It was a Serpent.

A massive, monstrous Serpent whose body coiled around the entire rim of the nest and kept going, scales of deep obsidian-green layered like shields of a drowned armory as over this armored skin, rivers of Infinity and THE Primordial Source circled and slithered like obedient snakes of their own. They did not rage. They did not resist. The two grandest essences of existence moved over this being’s body the way tamed things moved, and that obedience said more than any roar could!
And its power...

Noah felt his existence buzz as he gauged the pressure rolling off of it. It was more suffocating than even Ryaenara. The strongest being of their party, and the thing smiling down at them right now outweighed her aura the way a sea outweighed a river.
His body pulsed. His breath came heavier.
And what rose in him was not dread, but excitment!
How long had it been? How long since he stepped into a place where his senses screamed at him like this, where the very air promised that the beings here could actually end him?

Ah. It had been too long. This Dimension of Existence held dangerous things all around, and he found that he was actually looking forward to it. It would be hard. It would be painful, even. But he was ready.
So he looked up gloriously and without fear at the monstrous thing smiling down at them.

"I was wondering what was drawn into this little nest here." The Serpent’s voice rolled through the heavy air, deep and rich and horribly pleased with itself, the voice of a being that had never once been interrupted."I did not expect all of you. Haha... many is good. Many is very good. I can offer all of you to Jarl Erling without worry."
Jarl Erling.

A name, dropped carelessly, as this being spoke about offering True Lifeforms to someone the way a farmhand spoke about delivering grain. Noah’s Sight pressed against the ancient composition above as Ruination worked alongside him, and information began to settle.
|Master, readings on the being above us.|

|Designation: Ormarr Grimtunge. True Lifeform. Intent: THE Ananke Intent of THE Inevitable Coil.His Trueness is seamless, and his Intent is of the second order, inevitability itself, expressed through constriction. What his coils close around does not escape as a matter of law.|
|Pantheon:THE Hoard of the World-Coil.From its weavings, he does not merely hold records within it. He holds beings. Collected, coiled, and kept.|
A True Lifeform with an Ananke Intent, whose Pantheon was a hoard of living things!
| I have gauged the surrounding weavings and run every probability available to me. This True Lifeform intends to attack and imprison all of us within the next 3 nanoseconds. Certainty: 99%.|

Noah felt the danger down to his foundations as the prompts settled. He really could feel it, sharp and real in a way nothing had been for so long, and he welcomed every drop of it as he spoke out grandly.
"A True Lifeform is our welcoming party... let’s enjoy it!"
HUUM!

His will moved as he spoke, pulling Amser Modred and the Dora Shath’yar into THE Pantheon of THE Infiniverse in a single fold of blue light, the nine Daughters vanishing mid-stance as only Ryaenara, THE Creature, THE Infiniverse, and Emotive remained outside with him, all of them already lighting up with waves of vibrant Intent!
Above them, the Serpent’s smile stretched wider as its laughter shook the nest walls.

"Haha... me? A welcoming party?"Ormarr Grimtunge loomed closer as the rivers of Infinity coiled faster over his scales, his crimson eyes drinking in their risen auras the way a merchant drinks in fresh stock. "You fuckin scrubs. Let me introduce you properly then, and remind you of what you are. You are not guests. You are not challengers. You... are only merchandise. Little Prisoners!"
BOOM!

Ryaenara shook her head with naked frustration as she shot upwards toward the Serpent, her slender body unleashing waves of rolling darkness that blotted out the nest below her, an Antiquity finally shedding her looseness!
And the snake smiled brutally.
"Discombobulate."
Terrifying weavings of power erupted across the whole sky!

The massive Serpent split. One colossal body became many in a single beat of existence, coils dividing into coils as nearby space itself cried out fearfully under the weight of the technique, and purple rivers of an alien Intent flooded outwards in every direction at once!
Noah only managed to put his hands on Emotive and THE Infiniverse.

Then a purple river of intent swept past them, and the three of them disappeared. THE Creature bellowed out as another purple river passed over him, and he too was gone, obsidian flames swallowed mid-eruption!
The only one who remained above the nest was Ryaenara.
She looked down and saw nobody else here as her darkness churned around her, and she cussed, her cold gaze rising to the enemy ahead of her who smiled with open brutality.

"Divide and conquer."The greatest mass of the Serpent coiled before her, crimson eyes gleaming. "You are the strongest among them, so you will face most of me. The others should be light years away from here by now, facing lesser parts of me. But do not worry for them... even a single lesser me is enough. Haha. Are you ready?"
Ryaenara rolled her neck and stretched her arms slowly, the frustration bleeding out of her frame with each movement until only the old, bright, dangerous mirth remained.

"Yeah, yeah. I’m fucking ready." Her vibrant eyes settled on the mountain of coils ahead. "At least this place has curses. I never wanted to come here, but now that I am... I will learn everything I can. A little serpent won’t stop me!"
Her existence pulsed, and she fully unleashed her power.
She only thought how at this time, Osmont had truly found the adversity he was seeking!

"Discombobulate."
Terrifying weavings of power erupted across the whole sky!
The massive Serpent split.

One colossal body became many in a single beat of existence, coils dividing into coils as nearby space itself cried out fearfully under the weight of the technique, and purple rivers of an alien Intent flooded outwards in every direction at once!
Noah only managed to put his hands on Emotive and THE Infiniverse.
Then a purple river of intent swept past them, and the three of them disappeared.
THE Creature bellowed out as another purple river passed over him, and he too was gone, obsidian flames swallowed mid-eruption!
The only one who remained above the nest was Ryaenara.
She looked down and saw nobody else here as her darkness churned around her, and she cussed, her cold gaze rising to the enemy ahead of her who smiled with open brutality.
"Divide and conquer."The greatest mass of the Serpent coiled before her, crimson eyes gleaming.
"You are the strongest among them, so you will face most of me.
The others should be light years away from here by now, facing lesser parts of me.
But do not worry for them... even a single lesser me is enough.
Haha.
Are you ready?"
Ryaenara rolled her neck and stretched her arms slowly, the frustration bleeding out of her frame with each movement until only the old, bright, dangerous mirth remained.
"Yeah, yeah.
I’m fucking ready." Her vibrant eyes settled on the mountain of coils ahead.
"At least this place has curses.
I never wanted to come here, but now that I am...
I will learn everything I can.
A little serpent won’t stop me!"
Her existence pulsed, and she fully unleashed her power.
She only thought how at this time, Osmont had truly found the adversity he was seeking!

chapters.title: Chapter 5492: I Will Lounge! I
paragraphs: Noah, Emotive, and THE Infiniverse found themselves standing on flat ground filled with moss, mist, and darkness in all directions!

The moss below them was ancient and black-green, layered so thick that their feet sank into it like carpets woven over eons as the mist coiled around their figures in slow gray rivers that refused to disperse. Past the mist, darkness stretched out with no horizon to end it, and through this darkness...the sky raged!

Concentrated rivers of Infinity and THE Primordial Source tore across the heavens as if mad, blue and prismatic currents crashing against each other with none of the obedience they had shown over the Serpent’s scales! Here they were wild, unclaimed, furious, and from their collisions, a rain of both these authorities crashed down like a storm alongside something else.

Droplets of pure Infinity. Droplets of raw Primordial Source. And laced between both, droplets of a third essence Noah’s Sight could not name as it hissed against the moss and sank into the ancient ground!
What kind of place had weather made of the grandest authorities in existence? What was the third essence raining down beside them?
They were questions for later! Because above them, coiled through the raging sky, a familiar figure gazed down.

It was Ormarr, and yet it was less. This body was smaller and less imposing than the mountain of coils that had loomed over the nest, its crimson eyes dimmer, its pressure reduced from a sea to a heavy lake. A divided body! A fraction of the whole, sent to handle the fraction of them, and its cold smile said it found even this assignment generous.
"I’ve got the weakest ones separated here,"Ormarr said, his voice rolling down through the storm. "You all should be the first to fall."
...The weakest ones?

Noah couldn’t help but smile at this as his existence buzzed and roiled with power, his Osmontian Biomass screaming to be used as he looked up at this being! Over two hundred thousand in reserve, a crown humming on his head, a living Pantheon breathing around his existence, and the storm-fed air of this Dimension still ticking wealth into him with every breath!
The weakest ones. He would remember that appraisal fondly.

"Before destruction, big guy, are you talkative?" Noah called up through the rain of authorities, his tone light as his eyes shone. "Do you want to tell us a few things about where we are and what’s around us? Any of those... Steeds of Those Who Remain nearby? Or THE Cursed Descendants themselves?"
Ormarr harrumphed, a sound like a hill collapsing!
"Don’t ask things when the answers will mean nothing to you. Be bound."
HUUM!
Obsidian-purple ropes unleashed from the Serpent’s body.

They poured out from between his scales in the dozens, then the hundreds, each one a woven cord of his Ananke Intent given form as inevitability was spun into bindings that snaked down through the raging sky! And Noah could already feel them constricting around him even before they arrived.

This was the terror of an Ananke Intent expressed through constriction as the binding began the moment it was willed, the capture already unfolding as law before the ropes ever crossed the distance! His shoulders felt phantom coils. His existence felt the hoard waiting.
Noah breathed out slowly as his mind ran cold and clear.

He knew plainly that he could not beat this True Lifeform as he was right now. Even this divided body outweighed him, and the whole of Ormarr Grimtunge outweighed Ryaenara herself! Alone, at E-Rank grades, against inevitability made flesh...the math was not kind. He did not worry for THE Creature or Ryaenara, wherever the purple rivers had scattered them, as both were terrifying beings who had survived eras of things.
As for himself...he breathed out as his hand rose to the crown upon his head.
"Ruination."
|I have been waiting for you to say it, Master. Fusing.|

THE Circlet of the Quintessential Ruin lifted from his brow and began to spin above him, faster and faster as it bloomed with crimson-gold light, thousands upon thousands of woven strings unwinding from its band as they poured down over his figure like a waterfall of burning threads.
The strings did not wrap him. They entered him!

Every thread of her wove into every thread of him, string finding string, her Intent sliding into the spaces of his Intent as two True Lifeforms folded into a single existence, and Noah’s body transformed under the confluence! His dark hair bled through with veins of crimson and gold, burning like woven fire past his shoulders. His eyes turned into layered rings of cerulean and crimson, lemniscate patterns turning slowly within both pupils, and across his skin, faint lines of light traced themsleves like circuitry of pure string as every one of them hummed with her predictive weavings!

The world slowed around his perception as her sight became his sight, every falling drop of the authority-storm resolving into readable threads, every incoming binding-rope a composition whose weakest stitch glowed before his eyes!
And he did not stop there.
"Infiniverse."
"Yes, Master."Her voice came warm from beside him, and her manifestation smiled as she dissolved into cerulean light that sank into his chest.
For the first time...his Pantheon unfurled fully!

THE Quintessential Pantheon of THE Infiniverse bloomed out from his existence not as a backbone, not as stanchions, but as everything, a dimension of existence erupting outward with him at its heart as the moss and mist and storm were swallowed whole by realms! Skies of gold. Seas of glass. Mountain ranges of turning blue light, nested Observable Existences glimmering in the distance like hung lanterns, thousands upon thousands of realms unfolding in every direction as one man became intune and fused together with two other True Lifeforms and wore their shared dimension as his body!

Noah stood on merely one of the thousands of realms of his Pantheon, his feet settling upon vast stretches of golden sands that glimmered like crushed dreams, dunes of radiant gold rolling out to a horizon that belonged to him! Emotive was pulled gently to his side by a current of the Pantheon’s will, and around his transformed figure, the aura he radiated...actually reached a suffocating level!

Where a lone E-Rank True Lifeform had stood, something else now breathed! Three Egoic Intents layered into one presence. A living dimension worn as flesh! The storm of Infinity and Primordial Source still raged somewhere beyond his Pantheon’s edges,and for the first time since arriving in THE Krazhor-Nul, it did not feel heavy at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 5493: I Will Lounge! II
paragraphs: |The full fusion has settled.|

|Designation of this form: THE Quintessential Confluence.Three True Lifeforms, one existence.Within it, all grades of your existence are raised by one. Your Osmontian Source Infinity, your Egoic Intent, your Volume, Output, and Trueness, and all nine Foundations now stand and function a full rank above their true grades for the duration of the fusion.|

|Offensive capability: THE Osmontian Dimensional Barrage. The Pantheon can now condense Miniature Osmontian Dimensional Observable Existences, whole miniature realms formed from its fabric, each one seeded with your Infinite Cause and all your other Causes converted into pure destruction. Each miniature Observable Existence carries the weight and immensity of THE Infiniverse, the string-guidance of my Intent, and the crushing authority of your Causes as they detonate with the death of a realm behind every impact. Woven into each is the gaze of THE Pinion Vigil, Sanity Flaying and Intent Perception Overload lashing all struck enemies, and the pull of THE Estuary, bleeding their weavings toward you with every detonation. You are no longer a being who casts techniques. You are a dimension that throws its own realms...|

|Defensive capability: THE Osmontian Dimensional Auras of THE Infiniverse. The Pantheon can conjure layered auras of its own dimensional law around you and any you designate. Anything seeking passage through these auras faces a single demand written into their weavings: present a Cause grander than THE Infiniverse herself, or be refused. Attacks below that threshold do not weaken against the auras, Master. They are simply denied, as one dimension refusing entry to lesser laws.|
Prompts of majesty and wonder bloomed!

Noah read them as golden sand swirled lazily around his feet, and he reached out to grab onto Emotive’s body, pulling her close as she squealed with visible excitment, her manic eyes darting over every inch of his transformed figure and the thousands of realms beyond as if she couldn’t decide which part of his power to adore first!
Behind him, the golden sands rose!

They spiraled upward and condensed, dune folding upon dune as a throne formed itself grain by grain, vast and gleaming and shaped from the dreams of a living dimension, and Noah sat down upon it grandly as he pulled Emotive onto his lap, one arm around her waist while his layered eyes gazed out through his Pantheon’s edge at the distant coils of the Serpent!
Then he spoke, and his voice carried through every realm at once.

"I have been thinking about what it means to be true to one’s identity ever since existence handed me a crown. And I have arrived at a simple answer. A True Human Emperor should act like exactly what he is."His crimson-gold hair drifted in the dimensional winds as his smile curved, devilish and regal in equal measure.

"I have spent my whole existence lifting my own hands. Every enemy, every era, every grave. Fists, blades, Letters, wings. And that was correct, for a climber. But I am not merely a climber anymore, am I? An Emperor’s truth is not that he can fight. It is that he does not have to!"

The thousands of realms of THE Quintessential Pantheon of THE Infiniverse began to glow, miniature Observable Existences condensing across the golden skies in the hundreds like a harvest of burning domains waiting to fall!
"So for my first true act in this Dimension, I will live true to my identity. I will lounge on this throne without lifting even a hand, and take on...a True Lifeform!"

He leaned back into the golden throne, Emotive curled delightedly against him, and at that moment, the visage of THE True Human Emperor looked like nothing so much as a regal devilish demon crowned in a dimension of his own!
"Ruination. Infiniverse. Bombard this fucker with Dimensional Observable Existences for me."
HUUM!
The first Miniature Osmontian Dimensional Observable Existence launched from the golden skies of Noah’s Pantheon like a star being hurled by the hand of a living dimension.

It was a sphere of condensed cerulean brilliance no larger than a man’s fist, and yet within it churned the weight of an entire realm as Noah’s Infinite Cause and all his other Causes were converted into pure destruction, THE Pinion Vigil’s gaze woven into its fabric alongside the pull of THE Estuary as it screamed across the distance between the golden sands and the coiled Serpent!
BOOM!
It struck Ormarr Grimtunge across his massive jaw!

The detonation alone should have ended a Mesozoic Scale existence three times over as the death of a miniature Observable Existence unleashed itself in a bloom of blue-gold annihilation, the Sanity Flaying lashing out from within the explosion to assault the Serpent’s mind while THE Estuary drank greedily at the weavings displaced by the blast!
But Ormarr did not fall.

His massive head turned from the impact as scales cracked and bled rivers of prismatic fluid, and behind his coiled body, THE Hoard of the World-Coil manifested for the first time! It bloomed like a prison given architecture, an entire Pantheonic Dimension of writhing obsidian-purple coils layered upon coils as within its depths, Noah’s Sight could perceive the faint signatures of collected beings, hundreds of them, lifeforms hoarded across ages and kept alive within the serpentine dimension as trophies and fuel!

THE Ananke Intent of THE Inevitable Coil surged from this Pantheon as the very concept of inevitability pressed outward, a law declaring that what Ormarr closed upon stayed closed, that escape was not a thing this dimension permitted, and the wave of it crashed against Noah’s golden sands!
THE Osmontian Dimensional Auras of THE Infiniverse answered.
The layered auras bloomed across the Pantheon’s edge like walls of living law as the incoming Intent struck them and was met with a single demand:present a Cause grander than THE Infiniverse herself.

An Ananke Intent was terrifying! But was it grander than a living Observable Existence who held her own Causes, her own Intent, and three nested Observable Existences within her? The aura checked, and the aura refused, and the crushing wave of inevitability broke against the dimensional boundary like a tide striking a continent!
Noah watched all of this from his throne without moving a single muscle.
"Again," he said.
HUUM!

Ten more Miniature Osmontian Dimensional Observable Existences condensed across the golden skies, each one burning with the light of a dying realm, each one seeded with all nine of his Causes turned to annihilation as Ruination’s strings guided their trajectories and THE Infiniverse’s weight filled their cores!
They fell upon the Serpent like a volley of burning worlds!
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!

Three struck his coils mid-body and detonated in cascading rings of destruction as scales the size of mountains cracked and flew off into the raging storm, prismatic blood spraying across the mist-covered flatlands below! Two more struck the base of his manifested Pantheon, THE Hoard of the World-Coil shuddering under the impacts as its coiled architecture visibly strained! And five more peppered across his length from tail to skull, each detonation unleashing Sanity Flaying into a different section of his mind while THE Estuary drank at the displaced weavings with growing hunger!
The effects were staggering!

Ormarr Grimtunge recoiled across the sky as his massive form buckled under the onslaught, his Ananke Intent flickering at its edges as sections of his coiled body spasmed where the Sanity Flaying had breached, and the crimson light in his eyes strobed between fury and a disorientation he had clearly never experienced!
But this was a True Lifeform with an Ananke Intent.

Even battered, even bleeding, inevitability reasserted itself! His coils tightened around empty air and the tightening itself became an attack as the space around Noah’s Pantheon began to compress, the very distance between the Serpent and the throne closing not because the Serpent moved but because his Intent declared the distance no longer existed!
WAA!

The Osmontian Dimensional Auras flared as the compression met them, layers of dimensional law pushing back against an inevitability that simply refused to accept the word no, and for the first time, the demand of the auras trembled! The check did not break, but it creaked, because an Ananke Intent did not attack the way ordinary power attacked. It did not try to be grander. It simply insisted, over and over, that the outcome was already decided!

chapters.title: Chapter 5494: Immensity!
paragraphs: Noah felt the trembling through every realm of his Pantheon.
From the Serpent’s bleeding jaws, a response came at last.
"Haha... hahahaha!"Ormarr’s laughter rolled across the battlefield as his body straightened despite the wounds, prismatic blood still flowing freely from dozens of shattered scales.

"I called you the weakest ones. What a thing to be wrong about! You... a fused existence that throws miniature dimensions like stones."His crimson eyes burned brighter as his own Pantheon’s coils began to tighten and multiply behind him, the hoard deepening, more bindings manifesting from its depths!

"I may just have to bring forth more power here. I may have to recall parts of myself from the others, or open the deeper coils of my Hoard. You are making me work, little thing, and I do not enjoy working!"
Noah remained undaunted on his throne.

His layered cerulean-crimson eyes gazed through the dimensional edge at the recovering Serpent as he calculated what his Sight was telling him. The divided body was healing. The Ananke Intent was reasserting. And Ormarr was talking about pulling more of himself back from the fragments fighting Ryaenara and THE Creature, which meant the window of relative weakness was closing!
He looked down at Emotive on his lap.

She had been watching the whole battle with wide manic eyes as her amaranthine light flickered in rhythm with every detonation, and the look on her face was somewhere between awe and a child watching fireworks. She met his gaze and understood immediately what he was asking.
"Join in," Noah said simply.
Emotive’s eyes changed!

The mania did not leave, it never left, but something beneath it locked into place with a seriousness that transformed her entire bearing as she rose from his lap and floated upward, her slender form beginning to radiate waves of amaranthine light that pulsed outward like a second heartbeat!
THE Egoic Intent of THE Felt Eternity erupted from her.

It was not a combat Intent. It did not strike, it did not cut, it did not bind. It did something far worse! It reached across the battlefield and touched the emotional foundation of every existence in its range, and for Ormarr Grimtunge, whose Ananke Intent ran on the absolute certainty that his outcomes were inevitable...THE Felt Eternity introduced doubt.
Not as a thought! As a feeling!

The Serpent’s crimson eyes widened as an unfamiliar sensation flooded through his coils, his certainty wavering not because logic challenged it but because something had reached into the place where certainty lived and made it feel less! His Ananke Intent stuttered! THE Hoard of the World-Coil flickered as its architecture lost coherence for a single critical instant, the bindings within loosening as if the Hoard itself had momentarily forgotten why it was holding on!
It lasted only a heartbeat.
But a heartbeat was enough for Noah.
"Ruination," he spoke from his throne, his voice calm as the Serpent’s defenses flickered. "Spend 150,000 Osmontian Biomass. Elevate THE Egoic Intent of THE Quintessential Osmontian."
|Done.|
WAA!

The cost burned through him like a river of fire as 150,000 Osmontian Biomass vanished in a single breath, and his Egoic Intent surged upward to D-Rank Ruis. But he was not at his base state! He was fused as THE Quintessential Confluence where all grades functioned one rank above their true level, which meant his Intent did not settle at D-Rank.
It erupted at C-Rank!
And C-Rank...was the threshold.

|Master. Your Egoic Intent, elevated within the Confluence, now functions at C-Rank, Straif. At this grade, expressed through this fusion, your Intent has crossed a threshold. You are emanating the grandeur of Ananke.|
His Egoic Intent, THE Quintessential Osmontian, was not an Ananke Intent by nature. It was an Egoic Intent, first-order.

But at C-Rank Straif within the fusion of three True Lifeforms, operating one rank above, its sheer weight and Trueness had climbed high enough to radiate at the same tier as second-order inevitability.
He was not inevitability! He was identity, so dense and True that it functioned with the same immovable authority.
Cerulean flames exploded from Noah’s seated figure!

They were not ordinary flames of Osmontian Source Infinity. These were Intent made visible, identity burning at the grade of Ananke, and they rose from his throne in towering pillars as Emotive’s amaranthine disruption still held the Serpent’s certainty in its grip! The flames surged upward and poured into the hundreds of Miniature Osmontian Dimensional Observable Existences already condensed across the golden skies, each one drinking the cerulean fire and swelling with an authority that had not been there moments ago.
"Now," Noah said from his throne.
HUUM!
The bombardment came!

Not ten, not twenty, but hundreds of Miniature Osmontian Dimensional Observable Existences descended upon Ormarr Grimtunge at once as each one now burned with cerulean flames carrying the grandeur of Ananke! They struck his coils and his scales and his manifested Pantheon from every conceivable angle as detonation after detonation after detonation ripped across the battlefield in a cascade of blue-gold annihilation.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
The destruction was absolute.

Ormarr’s scales shattered in sheets as his prismatic blood rained down across the moss-covered flatlands in rivers! His Ananke Intent, already stuttering from Emotive’s disruption, could not reassert itself against an opposing authority radiating at the same order as the miniature realms pressed and wrapped around his body, tightening, constricting the constrictor, dozens of burning Observable Existences folding over his coils like a net woven from dying dimensions.
THE Hoard of the World-Coil buckled!

The Serpent’s Pantheon cracked along its deepest architecture as the bindings within snapped one after another, collected beings tumbling free inside its collapsing structure as the hoard that had held hundreds across ages began to come apart! THE Pinion Vigil’s gaze poured in through every crack, Sanity Flaying flooding the fractured Pantheon’s interior, and THE Estuary drank and drank and drank at the weavings bleeding out of the dying dimension.

The Serpent’s body was wrapped in a cocoon of burning miniature Observable Existences, constricted by the very technique of constriction turned against him as his crimson eyes blazed through the devastation!
And even now, even at the end, the Serpent managed to look directly at Noah through the inferno!

"Just you wait," Ormarr Grimtunge said, his voice carrying through the destruction with a calm that promised a future far worse than this present. "Just you wait, little thing. This was a fraction of me. A sliver! The whole of me will remember your face and your flames and your little throne of sand, and when I find you again in this Dimension with my full body... I will coil around everything you love and I will not let go!"
His crimson eyes held Noah’s layered gaze for one more instant.

Then the cerulean flames ate through the last of his divided body, and the fractured Pantheon collapsed inward, and the coils turned to ash and prismatic dust that scattered across the raging storm above!
WAA!
The divided body of Ormarr Grimtunge was destroyed.
And through it all, Noah had not lifted a single muscle from his throne of golden sand.

He sat there as the dust of a True Lifeform’s fractured body rained down through the storming sky, Emotive floating back down to settle against him with shining manic eyes, his cerulean flames still burning across his frame with the heavy Intent of a being who had just operated at the grandeur of Ananke! His crimson-gold hair drifted in dimensional winds as his layered eyes gazed through the settling destruction with the calm of an Emperor who had passed judgment and watched it carried out.
His body burned vibrantly with a heavy Intent!
And through that heavy burning, the prompts came.

|THE Tide That Owes Nothing has been triggered. You have destroyed the divided body of a True Lifeform through the acts of your bonded existences, without lifting a hand, granting your companions the adversity of battle and the triumph of victory as a gift of your own architecture. The Tide recognizes the giving.|
|Boons delivered. +180,000 Osmontian Biomass, recovered in part from the expenditure of the elevation. And two further returns, shaped by what THE Estuary drank during the destruction.|

|First: geographic records bled from Ormarr’s collapsing Pantheon. I now hold a partial map of the surrounding territory within THE Krazhor-Nul, extending approximately three hundred leagues from our current position.|

|Second: sparse knowledge of Ormarr Grimtunge himself, extracted from the records his divided body held. He serves one called Jarl Erling, who commands a court of True Lifeforms somewhere within this Dimension. He was dispatched to this nest specifically because it is a known entry point for pulled-in lifeforms. He has performed this collection many times. His full body is still out there, and the parts fighting THE Creature and Ryaenara will have felt this one die.|
Noah sat on his throne of golden sand as the storm of Infinity and Primordial Source raged on beyond the edges of his living Pantheon, his layered eyes burning cerulean and crimson.
The True Human Emperor had won his first battle in THE Krazhor-Nul without rising from his seat.

chapters.title: Chapter 5495: The Dying Jarl!
paragraphs: Far away.
Another body of Ormarr Grimtunge moved quickly through the interior of a vast floating mountain within THE Krazhor-Nul.

The mountain was ancient beyond the framing of any Scale as its hollowed passages stretched wide enough for beings the size of hills to pass one another, walls of primordial black stone veined with rivers of Infinity that pulsed like slow heartbeats, and carvings older than eras were etched across every surface as they depicted coiled Steeds and towering riders whose faces had been worn away by time itself.
Ormarr’s coils carried him through these passages at speed.

He passed other True Lifeforms as he moved. A towering elk-like existence whose antlers held miniature storms nodded to him in greeting. A three-faced woman wreathed in gray flames raised a hand as he passed her chamber. A brutish hound of layered stone rumbled his name in acknowledgment!
To each of them, the Serpent merely nodded back as he did not slow, did not speak, did not coil aside for pleasantries.
The other True Lifeforms watched him pass with knowing looks. When Ormarr Grimtunge moved like this, he moved for only one reason.
He was going straight to the abode of Jarl Erling!

The abode sat at the heart of the floating mountain as its entrance rose taller than the rest of the passages combined, gates of fossilized Steed-bone inlaid with cursed gold that hummed against Ormarr’s scales as he slipped between them. And within...
Within was a hall of pleasure and power both.

The chamber stretched out like a valley given a ceiling as fountains of liquefied Primordial Source rained down in glittering falls, floating platforms drifted lazily through perfumed air, and music from unseen instruments coiled through everything. Upon the platforms and across the vast floors, female True Lifeforms danced. Beings of terrifying grades moved in silks and flames and scales as others lounged upon the titanic form at the chamber’s center, pouring essence-wine, tracing his skin, servicing the mountain of a being who ruled this floating domain!
Jarl Erling!

He was a massive titanic humanoid whose seated form still rose higher than Ormarr’s lifted head, his skin like weathered bronze crossed with glowing fissures of crimson, his beard braided with the bones of things that had once been True! Power radiated off his lounging body in lazy, crushing waves that made Ormarr Grimtunge, a True Lifeform, look and feel utterly tiny!
This was a Cursed Descendant.

And this was how a Cursed Descendant lived! For when a man knows the year of his death, he lives every remaining hour drowning in whatever pleasure he can find. The dancing, the wine, the flesh, the music, none of it was decadence to Jarl Erling. It was life! Every moment of pleasure was a moment stolen back from a curse that had already scheduled his ending, and he collected such moments the way misers collected coin.
At Ormarr’s entrance, Jarl Erling frowned.

The frown alone pressed down through the chamber as the music stumbled, and the dancing True Lifeforms slowed as their annoyed gazes turned toward the Serpent who had interrupted their lord’s pleasures!
Ormarr did not flinch as he sent a single message directly into the Jarl’s mind.
"I have potentially found extremely good Seeds."
The frown on Jarl Erling’s face held for a moment longer.

Then he waved one titanic hand, and the dismissal was absolute. The female True Lifeforms rose and withdrew, silks and flames trailing as more than a few shot Ormarr looks of open annoyance on their way out, and within moments, the vast pleasure hall held only the titan and the Serpent.
"Show me," Jarl Erling rumbled.
Ormarr’s coils shifted as he waved his head, and the air of the chamber bloomed with illusory scenes.

His memories poured out in light. The nest, and the strange clutch that had hatched within it. The party of terrifying beings wet with egg residue. His division of them across light years! And then, the battle. Noah upon his throne of golden sand, the crown, the fusion, the thousands of realms, the hundreds of Miniature Osmontian Dimensional Observable Existences falling like a harvest of burning worlds, the cerulean flames rising to the grandeur of Ananke, and the destruction of Ormarr’s divided body by a man who never once rose from his seat!

"I wanted THE Jarl to know what I am currently doing in your service," Ormarr said as the scenes played. "The party is scattered but formidable. I will send another body to ensure the ones who destroyed my clone-"
He never finished!
Jarl Erling had risen!

The titan crossed his own hall in two strides that shook the fountains as his ancient face came close to the illusory scenes, his cursed eyes narrowing upon two figures within them. Upon the crowned man on the golden throne. And upon the woman in the cerulean-threaded dress who had dissolved into his chest as the Pantheon unfurled!
His eyes were not ordinary eyes.

They were the eyes of a Cursed Descendant who had spent an entire cursed lifetime staring into the weavings of dying Causes, eyes that had dissected ten thousand lifeforms in search of a cure, eyes that saw layers of existence that even True Lifeforms could not perceive! And right now, those ancient cursed eyes were seeing something that made his breath still in his titanic chest.
Less than ten years.

That was what remained of him. Less than ten years before the curse that had hollowed out his lineage since the first transgression finally collected him, and he had long ago stopped believing a solution would arrive in time. He had chosen the wine and the dancing and the flesh because hope was a resource that had run out centuries before his lifespan would!
But was that...
His cursed eyes strained against the illusory memory as they peeled back its layers, reading what Ormarr’s serpentine senses had recorded without understanding!
Were his eyes truly seeing a Living Observable Existence filled with vibrant Causes?!

Not a Steed. Not anything born of this Dimension’s ancient experiments. The woman, the Pantheon, the dimension that man had worn as a body, it was an Observable Existence that was alive! Alive with her own will, her own Intent, and within her, Causes burned vibrant and healthy and whole, First Causes that lived and breathed and thrived inside a living world the way they had never once managed to make a Cause survive inside a Cursed Steed!
Everything the Cursed Descendants had bled this Dimension trying to create for ages beyond counting!
Everything his lineage had been cursed for touching.
It was real, and it was walking around inside a newcomer’s Pantheon, and Ormarr, the loyal, brutal, simple Ormarr, did not even know what he had stumbled into.
Jarl Erling rose to his full height as his voice rolled through the empty hall like a verdict.
"What you have found is now deemed of utmost importance." His massive hand swept out as the mountain itself seemed to lean toward his words.
"Every True Lifeform upon this mountain is yours to command. Take them all if you must. Your task is singular, Ormarr Grimtunge. You are to bring in those beings... without fail!"
His titanic finger pointed into the illusory scenes as he said it, pointed directly at the crowned figure of Noah and at THE Infiniverse beside him.
Ormarr was shocked.

The entire mountain’s True Lifeforms, placed under his command? For a collection task? He had delivered thousands of Seeds to THE Jarl across his long service, and never once had a haul warranted even a tenth of this! But shock did not slow his fervor as the Serpent bowed his massive head and nodded deeply.
"It will be done, Jarl. And... will you be moving yourself?"
Jarl Erling was silent.

The titan turned from the illusory scenes and gazed out through the far wall of his hall, where an opening looked out over the endless storming skies of THE Krazhor-Nul, and behind his ancient cursed eyes, colder calculations turned.

If he made any large moves himself, his brethren would notice. Every Cursed Descendant across this Dimension lived exactly as he lived, drowning in pleasure while desperately, quietly, eternally searching for a solution before their clocks ran out. They watched each other the way starving men watched each other’s plates! If Jarl Erling, who had not left his mountain in centuries, suddenly mobilized in force, every dying Jarl in THE Krazhor-Nul would know within minutes that Erling had found something, and they would descend upon his prize like carrion birds, and ten years was not enough time to win that war.
No. Secrecy was the cage this treasure had to be carried in.

But secrecy could not come at the cost of failure! He had seen what that crowned man did to Ormarr’s divided body from a chair. Whatever he sent had to be overwhelming enough to guarantee success while quiet enough to raise no alarms, and there was exactly one asset in his possession that satisfied both!
Jarl Erling turned back to the Serpent, and his terrifying voice fell upon the hall.
"You are to depart with THE Steed of Oblivion to ensure your success."
Ormarr was even more shocked.

THE Steed of Oblivion! The dying colossus chained in the deepest hollow of this floating mountain, the asset THE Jarl had never once deployed in all of Ormarr’s long service, a creature whose failing Cause still generated an ambient field that made True Lifeforms weep blood merely standing near its chains! For a collection! Why... why was Jarl Erling placing such importance on those lifeforms?
The question burned through the Serpent’s mind.

But Ormarr Grimtunge had survived this long in service to a dying titan by knowing exactly which questions to swallow, and so he did not question! His coils lowered as the True Lifeform knelt before the Cursed Descendant, his massive head bowing to the floor of the pleasure hall.
"I shall follow your will, Jarl."
