chapters.title: Chapter 5502: Sensation!
paragraphs: The feast roared on across the golden island, and beneath its laughter, Noah gave a silent command to THE Infiniverse to take the herd below. All of it!
She stepped off the edge of the drifting island and flew down.

Noah watched her descent as her cerulean-threaded form dove through the mists of the sanctuary, and then THE Infiniverse went to work in a manner only a Living Observable Existence could. Her authority spread out across the entire basin as she carved out this whole section of THE Krazhor-Nul Dimension, the silver-green plains, the towering blue groves, the placid herds of Mistgrove Behemoths mid-graze, even the ancient soils and the mist itself, all of it separating from the dark geography in one colossal, gentle excision. The dimensional forcefield collapsed as its paradise simply rose, an entire ecosystem lifting like a lily pulled whole from a pond!
And she pulled it into herself.

Her form bloomed with cerulean light as the carved sanctuary folded into her existence, realms within her opening to receive it, and the herds did not even panic, placid natal intents registering only that the sky had changed color and the grass was somehow sweeter. Within moments, an entire domain of THE Krazhor-Nul had been relocated into THE Infiniverse, and somewhere inside her.
And while she did so...Noah heard back from Ryaenara at this time.

He had already heard from THE Creature a little while ago, flat words crossing the dark to confirm he was safe, his portion of the Serpent collapsed into dust. And right now, threading faintly through the heavy weavings of this Dimension, Ryaenara’s voice arrived saying similar words!

"Fucking finally, the threads connect. That serpent was a pain!"Her voice carried its old looseness. "Now listen, I cannot sense your location. Everything in this Dimension carries unknown restrictions, the weavings here are old and territorial, and if we drift too far apart, even messages like this one may not reach through anymore. So describe the regions you have recently crossed, landmarks, anything, and we will see about coming together again."
A pause, and then her voice dropped lower.

"And one more thing. When I defeated his body, that snake looked at me with those crimson eyes and said, ominously, mind you, that they were coming for us. They. Not I. He has called for help, or he serves something that is now aware of us. Be careful."
Noah smiled slightly as he listened.
This was almost the exact same conversation he had held with THE Creature. The same inability to sense locations, the same request for landmarks, well, without the warning.
He proceeded to communicate back to Ryaenara, describing the million-mile obsidian tree, the fossil valleys, the bone sea’s direction, every landmark their golden island had crossed.
And while he did this, he looked at his feasting people, and made a decision.

"Everyone," Noah called out, and the laughter quieted as dozens of faces turned to him. "Finish the feast inside THE Infiniverse. Take the remaining meats with you, take your time, and acclimate to the power settling in you. Your Sources are elevated and your armaments are new, so train with them, learn them, and grow fat and strong! When the time comes, if its safe, you can put the power to use. Otherwise...we may have to upgrade The Dungeons and Crucibles within to give you all a taste of Adversity..."
His words rang out and began to be followed by all.

He needed to get a better grasp of this Dimension and its dangers, and a feast, however joyous, was a gathering of everything he loved in one exposed place. His people withdrew in cheerful waves, Titano carrying three plates, the Emperor Penguin refusing to relinquish his roast, Amelia squeezing Noah’s hand once before stepping through, and soon the golden island held only those he left outside.
Seo-yeon, still sensing upon the throne’s handle. THE Infiniverse. And Emotive!
Their journey continued across the Dimension as the island flew on through the storming dark, and Noah lay back on his throne and closed his eyes.
His senses spread out.

He reached into the chaotic infinity raging through the skies of this place, pulling upon his Infinite Tongue to gather as much information as possible, and as the boundless currents poured their grammar through him, his thoughts moved.
THE Infinite Tongue. THE Primordial Tongue!

Both, at their heart, equated to depth of understanding, how deeply one understood Infinity, and how deeply one understood THE Primordial Source. Letters and weavings of those Tongues were simply understanding crystallized.
And Noah had walked further down both, fusing Infinity and Primordial Source together and integrating them so deeply into his existence that they had stopped being external concepts at all.
But he had done so through his Identity. Osmontian!

He could continue seeking and grasping the Letters and weavings of THE Primordial Tongue and THE Infinite Tongue directly, learning the old grammars as they were written. Or...he could continue expressing Infinity and THE Primordial Source through his identity, through the Osmontian Source Infinity that was both of them fused and claimed as his.
The answer...was fairly obvious.

Why learn a language as a foreigner when he had already built his own tongue atop its roots? Through his Osmontian Source Infinity, he unlocked more and more Trueness in conjunction with his Intent, and more True Appendages arose this way, the Eye, the Vigil, the Root, all of them grown from identity rather than granted by grammar. And for easy advancement, his Osmontian Biomass was the answer, of which he gained more of through his Osmontian Tongue and its Letters, through I AM’s perpetual assertion, through HUMAN’s gathering warmth, through the Tide answering his gifts.

Everything...was neatly connected! Identity fed the Tongue, the Tongue fed the Biomass, the Biomass fed the grades, the grades deepened the Trueness, and the Trueness grew new anatomy. He closed his eyes and smiled as he felt as much as he could, boundless chaotic strings of Infinity humming through his awareness alongside the deep prismatic obsidian currents of Primordial Source!
And threading between both of them, everywherein this Dimension...the third essence.

It had been prevalent all around since their hatching. In the storm-rain. In the stones he forged with. In the heavy air itself, a quiet third presence braided through the two authorities he knew best, and Noah turned the whole of his focus upon it now as its nature began, slowly, to be grasped by him!

It did not vibrate like Infinity. It did not flow like Primordial Source. It clung. It remembered. Every string of it hooked into other strings like a burr, like a debt, like a word spoken over a cradle that never stopped applying, and as his Osmontian Source Infinity traced its grammar, the prompts began to bloom.
|You have grasped the nature of the third essence.|

|Designation: THE Lingering Word. It is Curse Authority.Concentrated, ambient, and ancient past all framing, and its weavings trace directly back to Those Who Remain. This entire Dimension is saturated in it because this entire Dimension was judged in it. THE Lingering Word is the residue of the original curse spoken over THE Krazhor-Nul, the authority that collapsed the Steeds’ First Causes into terminal weavings and bound expiration into the blood of every Cursed Descendant. It has rained upon this place for ages beyond counting, and it does not fade, because a curse from Those Who Remain is not an event. It is a standing sentence, still being served.|

|Its properties, as I can measure them: it is a True authority of binding and decree. A wielder could brand outcomes onto existences, terminal weavings, guaranteed endings, decrees that ignore the gap between Scales entirely, for a curse does not fight its target’s power, it simply applies. The Marrowbane Fruit you carry is a condensed droplet of this very authority.|

|And its cost. THE Lingering Word is detrimental to the existence of any wielder. To speak in it is to hold it, and to hold it is to be marked by it, every use hooks its burrs into the wielder’s own weavings, and enough use will seed terminal threads into one’s own Cause. The Cursed Descendants did not merely inherit their curse. Their ancestors wielded this authority in their experiments, and it collected its fee.|

Within moments, an entire domain of THE Krazhor-Nul had been relocated into THE Infiniverse, and somewhere inside her.
And while she did so...Noah heard back from Ryaenara at this time.
He had already heard from THE Creature a little while ago, flat words crossing the dark to confirm he was safe, his portion of the Serpent collapsed into dust.
And right now, threading faintly through the heavy weavings of this Dimension, Ryaenara’s voice arrived saying similar words!
"Fucking finally, the threads connect.
That serpent was a pain!"Her voice carried its old looseness.
"Now listen, I cannot sense your location.
Everything in this Dimension carries unknown restrictions, the weavings here are old and territorial, and if we drift too far apart, even messages like this one may not reach through anymore.
So describe the regions you have recently crossed, landmarks, anything, and we will see about coming together again."
A pause, and then her voice dropped lower.
"And one more thing.
When I defeated his body, that snake looked at me with those crimson eyes and said, ominously, mind you, that they were coming for us.
They.
Not I.
He has called for help, or he serves something that is now aware of us.
Be careful."
Noah smiled slightly as he listened.
This was almost the exact same conversation he had held with THE Creature.
The same inability to sense locations, the same request for landmarks, well, without the warning.
He proceeded to communicate back to Ryaenara, describing the million-mile obsidian tree, the fossil valleys, the bone sea’s direction, every landmark their golden island had crossed.
And while he did this, he looked at his feasting people, and made a decision.
"Everyone," Noah called out, and the laughter quieted as dozens of faces turned to him.
"Finish the feast inside THE Infiniverse.
Take the remaining meats with you, take your time, and acclimate to the power settling in you.
Your Sources are elevated and your armaments are new, so train with them, learn them, and grow fat and strong!
When the time comes, if its safe, you can put the power to use.
Otherwise...we may have to upgrade The Dungeons and Crucibles within to give you all a taste of Adversity..."
His words rang out and began to be followed by all.
He needed to get a better grasp of this Dimension and its dangers, and a feast, however joyous, was a gathering of everything he loved in one exposed place.

His people withdrew in cheerful waves, Titano carrying three plates, the Emperor Penguin refusing to relinquish his roast, Amelia squeezing Noah’s hand once before stepping through, and soon the golden island held only those he left outside.
Seo-yeon, still sensing upon the throne’s handle.
THE Infiniverse.
And Emotive!
Their journey continued across the Dimension as the island flew on through the storming dark, and Noah lay back on his throne and closed his eyes.
His senses spread out.

He reached into the chaotic infinity raging through the skies of this place, pulling upon his Infinite Tongue to gather as much information as possible, and as the boundless currents poured their grammar through him, his thoughts moved.
THE Infinite Tongue.
THE Primordial Tongue!
Both, at their heart, equated to depth of understanding, how deeply one understood Infinity, and how deeply one understood THE Primordial Source.
Letters and weavings of those Tongues were simply understanding crystallized.
And Noah had walked further down both, fusing Infinity and Primordial Source together and integrating them so deeply into his existence that they had stopped being external concepts at all.
But he had done so through his Identity.
Osmontian!
He could continue seeking and grasping the Letters and weavings of THE Primordial Tongue and THE Infinite Tongue directly, learning the old grammars as they were written.
Or...he could continue expressing Infinity and THE Primordial Source through his identity, through the Osmontian Source Infinity that was both of them fused and claimed as his.
The answer...was fairly obvious.
Why learn a language as a foreigner when he had already built his own tongue atop its roots?

Through his Osmontian Source Infinity, he unlocked more and more Trueness in conjunction with his Intent, and more True Appendages arose this way, the Eye, the Vigil, the Root, all of them grown from identity rather than granted by grammar.

And for easy advancement, his Osmontian Biomass was the answer, of which he gained more of through his Osmontian Tongue and its Letters, through I AM’s perpetual assertion, through HUMAN’s gathering warmth, through the Tide answering his gifts.
Everything...was neatly connected!
Identity fed the Tongue, the Tongue fed the Biomass, the Biomass fed the grades, the grades deepened the Trueness, and the Trueness grew new anatomy.
He closed his eyes and smiled as he felt as much as he could, boundless chaotic strings of Infinity humming through his awareness alongside the deep prismatic obsidian currents of Primordial Source!
And threading between both of them, everywherein this Dimension...the third essence.
It had been prevalent all around since their hatching.
In the storm-rain.
In the stones he forged with.
In the heavy air itself, a quiet third presence braided through the two authorities he knew best, and Noah turned the whole of his focus upon it now as its nature began, slowly, to be grasped by him!
It did not vibrate like Infinity.
It did not flow like Primordial Source.
It clung.
It remembered.

Every string of it hooked into other strings like a burr, like a debt, like a word spoken over a cradle that never stopped applying, and as his Osmontian Source Infinity traced its grammar, the prompts began to bloom.
|You have grasped the nature of the third essence.|
|Designation: THE Lingering Word.
It is Curse Authority.Concentrated, ambient, and ancient past all framing, and its weavings trace directly back to Those Who Remain.
This entire Dimension is saturated in it because this entire Dimension was judged in it.

THE Lingering Word is the residue of the original curse spoken over THE Krazhor-Nul, the authority that collapsed the Steeds’ First Causes into terminal weavings and bound expiration into the blood of every Cursed Descendant.
It has rained upon this place for ages beyond counting, and it does not fade, because a curse from Those Who Remain is not an event.
It is a standing sentence, still being served.|
|Its properties, as I can measure them: it is a True authority of binding and decree.

A wielder could brand outcomes onto existences, terminal weavings, guaranteed endings, decrees that ignore the gap between Scales entirely, for a curse does not fight its target’s power, it simply applies.
The Marrowbane Fruit you carry is a condensed droplet of this very authority.|
|And its cost.
THE Lingering Word is detrimental to the existence of any wielder.
To speak in it is to hold it, and to hold it is to be marked by it, every use hooks its burrs into the wielder’s own weavings, and enough use will seed terminal threads into one’s own Cause.
The Cursed Descendants did not merely inherit their curse.
Their ancestors wielded this authority in their experiments, and it collected its fee.|

chapters.title: Chapter 5503: Sisyphus! I
paragraphs: THE Lingering Word churned at the edges of his awareness, and Noah studied it the way a man studies a beautiful blade lying in poisoned oil.
A True authority of binding and decree. Sentences that ignored the gap between Scales entirely, endings that simply applied!
Every sentence spoken in it writes a small piece of the speaker’s own ending.
And he did not know how quickly he could be tainted.

Was it ten uses before the burrs seeded terminal threads into his Cause? A hundred? One? The Cursed Descendants themselves were the case study, and Noah had no intention of joining a study group whose members all had expiration dates. So he decided, calmly and finally, not to utilize it for now.
But there was another matter that had been quietly bothering him since the battle, and this one he could solve today.
The fusion.

When THE Quintessential Confluence had released, all his grades had settled back down a rank, and his Egoic Intent had fallen from its functional C-Rank back to its true D-Rank Ruis. And Noah had not liked it! For those brief moments of the battle, his Intent had erupted with the grandeur of Ananke, identity so dense it functioned as inevitability, and after tasting that...going without it felt like a handicap! Like a man who had stood at his full height once and was now asked to stoop.
Why stoop, when he had the wealth to stand?
"Ruination. My Intent...elevate it to C-Rank."

|Elevating. 300,000 Osmontian Biomass spent as THE Egoic Intent of THE Quintessential Osmontian rises from D-Rank, Ruis, to C-Rank, Straif. Your reserves settle at 163,000. And since you will ask next: elevation to B-Rank, Ngetal, will require 1,250,000 Osmontian Biomass.|
HUUM!
The elevation flowed through him, and Noah closed his eyes to feel it properly!

His Intent rose through his existence like a tide claiming a shore it had always owned, and everything it touched changed! His Volume deepened first, the sheer breadth of what "Osmontian" contained expanding as his records and Causes and lived truths pressed outward into the new grade. His Output sharpened second, the force with which his identity expressed itself into existence gaining an edge that made the storm-winds bend subtly around the golden island! And his Trueness...his Trueness sang! The seam between what he claimed and what he was, already nonexistent, somehow grew more nonexistent, his "I am" settling into reality with a weight that made the ambient weavings of THE Krazhor-Nul shift respectfully around him.
At C-Rank Straif, unfused, his Intent already brushed Ananke grandeur. And fused, it would stand at B-Rank!
He breathed out slowly as satisfaction settled through his body, and then he turned to the matter that this elevation had really been preparing for.
"Infiniverse."

Her manifestation approached across the golden sands, and Noah gestured to the space between them where their shared connection hummed, that unfathomably deep weave that was his Pantheon and her body and their bond all at once.

"Shall we finish actualizing THE Quintessential Pantheon of THE Infiniverse? It is a Pantheonic Dimension, and it is also you. So we can officially designate you as your own Dimension." His eyes gleamed. "Let us enact its rulings."
"I was already finalizing this, Master."
Her reply came efficient and level, her expression composed as ever. She raised one hand, and between her fingers, threads of cerulean weavings began to weave!

"THE Infiniverse, as a Dimension, is capable of enacting theAbsolute Dimensional Ruling.I have written it as follows: only those bearing Osmontian Source Infinity, or those granted access, may enter." The threads locked into place with a sound like a vault door the size of existence closing.

"Unless we encounter something that can shatter Dimensions completely, a True or Primeval Lifeform exceeding THE Sixth Scale, THE Seventh, or whatever stands equivalent to such heights, those within me are safe. That is the ruling. It is now absolute."
HUUM!
Noah felt it settle through the Pantheon, a weaving older in nature than walls, and his people within her became, in a single stroke, unreachable by many!

"There is more," THE Infiniverse continued. "The completion of a Pantheon carries a lesser-known consequence. Civilizational Access, the access one holds to their own Way and its full utility, approaches 100% for all those who complete their Pantheons. Those upon Vakochev’s Scales will never reach 100% access unless they become True. It is the hidden ceiling of the Scales themselves."

"At 100%, a True Lifeform gains the capability to steer their own power." Her voice remained level, but the weight in it rose. "How one’s power progresses, which directions it grows, what shape the next advancement takes, these stop being matters of fortune and framework, and become matters of will. A True Lifeform with an enacted Pantheon and a forged Intent no longer discovers their path. They author it. You have been doing this instinctively for a while now."
Noah nodded slowly as the implications unfolded through him! Every being on the Scales climbed a ladder someone else had built. A completed True Lifeform built the ladder as they climbed it.
But not every True Lifeform lived outside of Scales of Existence.

"And the second feature I have actualized so far,"THE Infiniverse said. "I studied your Estuary Eye, Master. I admired its principle. So I wrote a version of it into my Dimensional weavings. Wherever I am, THE Infiniverse now passively devours the surrounding Dimension I reside within. Its space, its ambient essense, its unclaimed weavings, all of it, drawn into me continuously, and with it...I grow larger and larger. Every moment we spend within THE Krazhor-Nul, I am quietly eating THE Krazhor-Nul."
Noah’s eyes shone ever brighter!
A Living Observable Existence that grazed upon the very Dimensions she visited! He loved it for its elegance, growth without battle, expansion without exposure, his home swelling silently.

Before, she had to devour Folds or Wheels of Existence for expansion as since then, she grew rapidly without needing to. Even now, her growth continued as she didn’t particularly need to devour surrounding Dimensions. But if she could and proceeded to do so to elevate her growth even further, why not?

chapters.title: Chapter 5504: Sisyphus! II
paragraphs: The golden island drifted on through the storm, and for a while, Noah simply sat with his elevated Intent and his finalizing Pantheon and his thoughts.
Then he spoke to no one and to all of them.
"There is an old myth I always think about. The myth of Sisyphus." His gaze rested on the raging horizon.

"A king who offended the powers above him, and was sentenced to roll an immense boulder up a mountain. And every time he neared the peak, the boulder would roll back down, and he would descend, and begin again. Forever. That was the entire punishment. Not fire, not blades. Just effort, rendered meaningless, repeated without end."
Emotive had gone still beside him. THE Infiniverse listened without moving.

"The lesson, as it was taught, was about futility. The cruelty of labor that arrives nowhere! And when I heard it while I was young, I pitied him. Endless hardship, endless struggle, a mountain that never stays climbed. What existence could be worse?"Noah’s mouth curved faintly.

"But when I think about hardship now. About adversity, and effort. I find I only want more and more of it. Show me the boulder! Show me the mountain! I have rolled my stone up through Scales and eras and domains, and every time it rolled back down, I picked it up heavier and climbed faster, and somewhere along the way, the climbing stopped being the punishment and became the point. I think, if I met Sisyphus now, I would not pity him. I would ask him what he learned on the ten thousandth climb that he missed on the first."
He paused.
"And at the same time...I feel like thinking this way puts my family, and everyone I love, in more and more danger."

"I want adversity to grow. I have built my entire existence to convert hardship into height! But this adversity is sometimes extremely terrifying, and it does not always aim at me. What will I do when, one day, an adversity comes that causes an irreversible death of those close to me? I chase after hardship so relentlessly."His voice stayed level which made it heavier.
"Am I so selfish, to do this? To drag everything I love along the road to every storm I can find, because the storms make me grander?"

He thought this out loud, openly, and THE Infiniverse and Emotive were somber as they listened, neither offering comfort. A distance away, Seo-yeon still sat with her eyes closed, sensing, her small frame wrapped in mirrored light, unaware that her Aba was speaking about her and many others.
Noah looked at her for a long moment.

"This is another one of my human qualities," he said quietly. "Selfishness. Every human expresses it. The wanting that does not stop to fully count its costs! I want to continue climbing higher and higher, and I am doing so knowing the dangers, knowing the peril, knowing exactly who stands behind me on the mountain. This is human. And it is one of the negative aspects of being human, so I will not pretend it is a virtue."His eyes sharpened!
"I will simply be ready for the consequences when they come. I know what my existence is. I am playing with my life and the lives of many. So, to do my very best to ensure I do not fall..."
He rose from the throne.
"I shall enact the last Letter of THE Osmontian Tongue."
HUUM!
The last Letter!

Well, he could always change his mind later, it was his Tongue after all. But he wanted this to be the last Letter! For he had studied the First Tongue, the Infinite Tongue, THE Primordial Tongue across his climb, and all of them shared the same bloat, many Letters, especislly THE First Tongue, where most simply ended up being there, catalogued and unutilized, grammar for the sake of grammar!
His Tongue would not rot that way. Five Letters, consolidated hard around his core identity, and from that foundation...he would begin enacting Words. And then sentances.
It was definitely very sad not to reach that magical number 9, but he wouldn’t dwell on it.
A language did not grow grand by adding more alphabet. It grew grand by speaking!
"For now, my last Letter of THE Osmontian Tongue shall be..." Noah’s voice rolled out across the golden sands as his existence gathered itself. "PROTAGONIST. I AM...THE PROTAGONIST!"
HUUM!
He had this Civilization already, seated inside his Osmontian Pillar within his Scales of Existence! And as abstract as the identity was, it was pivotal, for what was a Protagonist?

Across every story humanity had ever told, barring the protagonists of extremely darker tales, the Protagonist and their people were safe! They werre not spared hardship, never spared hardship, but carried through it. The Protagonist faced the impossible battle and made the breakthrough at the final moment. The Protagonist’s family survived the siege. The story bent, subtly and constantly, toward their continuation.

It was the oldest architecture in Human storytelling, and Noah uttered this Letter wanting it to truly become part of his identity, so that his selfishness in seeking adversity...would not come one day to bite everything he loved.
The Letter carved itself into his backbone as existence checked the claim, weighing a being who had clawed up from a dying world through apocalypses and found the word fit!
|The Fifth Letter of THE Osmontian Tongue has been transcribed. PROTAGONIST. I will catalogue its boons.|

|First: THE Aura of THE Protagonist.Whenever you face adversity, this aura gathers around you, and it passively produces Osmontian Biomass proportional to the adversity being faced. A skirmish will trickle. A battle against something that should kill you will pour! It is a mechanization of the oldest pattern in Human stories, the protagonist who somehow makes their breakthrough in the middle of the battle that guaranteed their death. From this moment, the more impossible your circumstances, the faster your wealth grows...|

|Second: THE Protagonist’s Omniscient Regard.The Protagonist survives because the Protagonist reads the story. Upon any lifeform your gaze settles on, you may now perceive their Character Sheet: their designation, their driving motivations, their current disposition toward you, whether malice, neutrality, or favor, their level of danger to you rendered in plain terms, and the pertinent threads of their circumstance, debts, fears, and desires. Beings vastly exceeding your existence will return partial sheets, veiled in ?????, and beings actively concealing themselves may distort their entries. But against all others, you now walk into every room already holding the script.|
Prompts of magisterial wonder bloomed.
Noah gazed at the terrifying capabilities detailed before him as the fifth Letter settled its weight through his existence, and he nodded slowly, and whispered calmly to himself.
"I AM THE PROTAGONIST."

He said it silently, privately, because he wanted to convince himself! Because he knew there could be terrifying adversity on the horizon, adversity he himself had invited by fishing an unknown door out of the dark, and he wanted every tool possible to get past such adversity that he himself wanted...without ruining what he wanted to protect!

For he was THE True Human Emperor. He could be selfish. He could be loving! He could be brave, fearless, Quintessential, and so much more. But most of all, he needed himself and those around him to be safe,for one major human condition was death. And death...came for all humans.
Would he be any different?
In his grand existence, if he endlessly asked himself his purpose, and continued to enact his Scales, and climbed the ladder of existence rung after rung after rung, it was truly hard for him to die.
But could he ever call himself immortal? Or would that violate what it meant to be human, as even for him...there would be an end one day? Was that Osmontian? Was that part of his identity?
He kept these thoughts to himself and nobody else, and in the privacy of his own vast existence, he wondered...how existence would be without Noah Osmont in it.
He was met with heavy silence within himself.

Noah breathed out, and focused. He stopped thinking about what the end could be, for he was living in the now! And his now was infinitely grand, filled with aspirstions and goals, with so many things he wanted to explore and understand! For now, he wouldn’t think about his end. If there was ever an end.
It was such a human thing... that he may have not realized it.

They werre not spared hardship, never spared hardship, but carried through it.
The Protagonist faced the impossible battle and made the breakthrough at the final moment.
The Protagonist’s family survived the siege.
The story bent, subtly and constantly, toward their continuation.

It was the oldest architecture in Human storytelling, and Noah uttered this Letter wanting it to truly become part of his identity, so that his selfishness in seeking adversity...would not come one day to bite everything he loved.
The Letter carved itself into his backbone as existence checked the claim, weighing a being who had clawed up from a dying world through apocalypses and found the word fit!
|The Fifth Letter of THE Osmontian Tongue has been transcribed.
PROTAGONIST.
I will catalogue its boons.|
|First: THE Aura of THE Protagonist.Whenever you face adversity, this aura gathers around you, and it passively produces Osmontian Biomass proportional to the adversity being faced.
A skirmish will trickle.
A battle against something that should kill you will pour!
It is a mechanization of the oldest pattern in Human stories, the protagonist who somehow makes their breakthrough in the middle of the battle that guaranteed their death.
From this moment, the more impossible your circumstances, the faster your wealth grows...|
|Second: THE Protagonist’s Omniscient Regard.The Protagonist survives because the Protagonist reads the story.

Upon any lifeform your gaze settles on, you may now perceive their Character Sheet: their designation, their driving motivations, their current disposition toward you, whether malice, neutrality, or favor, their level of danger to you rendered in plain terms, and the pertinent threads of their circumstance, debts, fears, and desires.
Beings vastly exceeding your existence will return partial sheets, veiled in ?????, and beings actively concealing themselves may distort their entries.
But against all others, you now walk into every room already holding the script.|
Prompts of magisterial wonder bloomed.
Noah gazed at the terrifying capabilities detailed before him as the fifth Letter settled its weight through his existence, and he nodded slowly, and whispered calmly to himself.
"I AM THE PROTAGONIST."
He said it silently, privately, because he wanted to convince himself!

Because he knew there could be terrifying adversity on the horizon, adversity he himself had invited by fishing an unknown door out of the dark, and he wanted every tool possible to get past such adversity that he himself wanted...without ruining what he wanted to protect!
For he was THE True Human Emperor.
He could be selfish.
He could be loving!
He could be brave, fearless, Quintessential, and so much more.
But most of all, he needed himself and those around him to be safe,for one major human condition was death.
And death...came for all humans.
Would he be any different?
In his grand existence, if he endlessly asked himself his purpose, and continued to enact his Scales, and climbed the ladder of existence rung after rung after rung, it was truly hard for him to die.
But could he ever call himself immortal?
Or would that violate what it meant to be human, as even for him...there would be an end one day?
Was that Osmontian?
Was that part of his identity?
He kept these thoughts to himself and nobody else, and in the privacy of his own vast existence, he wondered...how existence would be without Noah Osmont in it.
He was met with heavy silence within himself.
Noah breathed out, and focused.
He stopped thinking about what the end could be, for he was living in the now!
And his now was infinitely grand, filled with aspirstions and goals, with so many things he wanted to explore and understand!
For now, he wouldn’t think about his end.
If there was ever an end.
It was such a human thing... that he may have not realized it.

chapters.title: Chapter 5505: Come! I
paragraphs: <THE Creature>
Where did he end?

The question walked with him across the storming dark of THE Krazhor-Nul, as it had walked with him across every era since THE Wyld. His titanic body moved through the raging skies wrapped in obsidian flames, fossil ranges and drifting mountains sliding past beneath him, and the question turned itself over in his silence.

He was Existence. This was not philosophy, it was anatomy! His Pantheon took the shape of whatever surrounded him because whatever surrounded him was, in the deepest accounting, already his. The bone seas were him. The storm was him. The million-mile trees and the cursed rain and the ancient graves, all of it existence, and all of existence...him.
And yet.

Was the curse woven through this Dimension him? The curse clung to every string of this place, a sentence spoken by Those Who Remain, and when his flames passed through it, it did not feel like touching himself. It felt foreign! Like finding a scar on one’s back that one never remembered earning. And the statue, the inherited thing that rose when he called and stared where it pleased, was that him? It answered him. It was his. And yet every time it moved on its own, something in his ancient frame said borrowed, said debt!
Up to which point was it all him? And past which point did Existence become something foreign wearing his name?
He had no answer.
"Hm," THE Creature said to the storm, and kept walking.
And then he sensed it!

A grand aura of existence, far across the dark, old and vast and utterly still, the particular stillness of something mighty that had stopped being alive a very long time ago. His flat eyes narrowed as his path bent toward it, obsidian flames trailing behind his titanic strides, and the geography changed beneath him as he crossed, dark stone giving way to shores of rust-colored crystal, and then to the sea.
A vast red sea!

It stretched to every horizon beneath the storm, waters the deep arterial color of old blood, waves rolling slow and heavy as if the sea itself remembered grief. And upon those red waters, floating like a fallen mountain range...
Was a leg.

A single colossal severed leg, its pale flesh unrotted across what may have been ages, its scale so vast that clouds gathered around its heel, and the grandeur pouring off of it pressed upon the entire sea!

For this...was the limb of a Primeval One! A corpse-piece of one of existence’s apex beings, and even a piece of their body, even in death, was terrifying, its residual weavings humming with an authority that made the red waves kneel flat for miles around it!
And two figures were trying to eat it.

THE Creature’s gaze went cold as he took them in because he recognized something. Two True Lifeforms hovered above the colossal limb, golden radiance pouring off their frames as they worked siphoning weavings into the dead flesh, and they were struggling!

Sweat-light beaded off their golden brows as the Primeval limb’s residual grandeur fought their extraction at every thread, a dead thing still too proud to be drunk easily! And around each of them burned their natures plainly, one wreathed in the crimson storm of an elevated Ego of Ira, wrath refined across a True existence, the other wrapped in the towering golden pillar of an elevated Ego of Superbius, pride worn as law!
Gilded True Lifeforms.

His cold gaze held on them, and old detestation moved through his frame like a slow tide! He detested the entire structure of Gilded Ones. The harvesters! The golden civilization that had stood behind the reaping of First Causes from Observable Existences across many Ages, plucking the hearts of newborn domains while THE Primeval Ones stood behind them and blessed the harvest! He had planned, in the long ledger of his intentions, to one day gaze upon those Primeval Ones themselves, the ancient backers, the ones existence had somehow permitted to farm existence.
But Gilded True Lifeforms were a good place to start!

And there was also the limb. A Primeval One’s corpse-piece, dense with authority that even True Lifeforms strained to siphon, floating unclaimed upon a red sea. THE Creature could take that for himself!

He was honest with himself, as he was Existence and lying to himself was structurally embarrassing. His motivations here were self-serving! He knew exactly what he wanted to achieve. The detestation was real, the old grudge was real, but he was not here as an avenger of harvested Observable Existences. He was here because two things he disliked were holding one thing he wanted.
THE Creature stretched.

His titanic frame rolled its shoulders as obsidian flames climbed higher, and he measured the math plainly. One against two True Lifeforms, both Gilded, both elevated, both True, would be a challenge for him! A real one.
But he was born in Adversity, and he lived on Adversity!
So he went forward.

He did not announce himself. He did not offer pleasantries, or demands, or even a single word, for words were for negotiations and there was nothing here to negotiate! His obsidian flames began to rise in vast burning sheets as his stride lengthened across the red waves, and behind him, folding out of nothing, the titanic visage of the ancient statue bloomed, its faceless face staring down at the two golden figures with an immensity that made the sea shudder!
And already, silently, completely, before either Gilded True Lifeform had even turned around...
All of the surrounding existence had become his Pantheon!

The red sea was his. The storm above the limb was his! The rust-crystal shores and the kneeling waves and the very space the two harvesters floated in, all of it THE Pantheon of All Existence, and the two golden beings were no longer standing on a battlefield.
They were standing inside him in the most...significant way possible as at such a time...
THE Creature attacked!

chapters.title: Chapter 5506: Come! II
paragraphs: Existence closed its fist!

The red sea rose in colossal walls as the storm hammered down, space itself folding inward upon the two golden figures with the full weight of THE Pantheon of All Existence, THE MAW tearing open across the sky as THE Burden of Existence descended in the same breath, everything, all at once, the same overwhelming convergence that had crushed a portion of Ormarr Grimtunge into prismatic dust!
And it worked.
On one of them!

The Gilded True Lifeform wreathed in Ira was caught mid-turn as the Burden slammed him down into the red waves, his crimson wrath erupting against the folding sea as his golden frame buckled beneath eras of carried adversity, his scream tearing across the water!
But the other one...
The other one simply raised his gaze.

The Gilded True Lifeform wrapped in the golden pillar of Superbius looked up at the collapsing totality of Existence bearing down upon him, and his eyes were filled with nothing but pride! No alarm. No strain! Only the mild, bottomless offense of a being interrupted, and he raised one golden hand...
And swatted.
BOOOM!
A terrifying Ananke Intent smashed outward from that single gesture!

It did not push through THE Creature’s Pantheon. It overruled it! Inevitability of a caliber the Serpent had never dreamed of crashed against the folding existence and declared it unfolded, declared the seas flat, declared the intruder elsewhere, and THE Creature’s titanic frame was smashed backward across the red sea, his obsidian flames guttering as he tore a canyon through the arterial waves for hundreds of miles before his form arrested itself!
And when he looked at this being again...he truly looked.

His flat eyes read the golden figure hovering calm above the Primeval limb, and the accounting came back cold and clear! This being had far since escaped THE Mesozoic Scale. The Fifth Scale did not contain him! He stood upon the Sixth Scale equivalent, or even higher, the Scale the old records namedTHE Cenozoic Scale, the tier where Vakochev’s ladder grew thin!
And this entity seemed comfortable on it.
"Hm," said THE Creature, and rose, and attacked again!

He unleashed everything, just as he had against Ormarr! THE MAW split the sky and devoured the incoming golden weavings by the hundreds. THE Burden of Existence dropped again and again, eras of weight hammering down! The statue’s faceless immensity pressed upon the battlefield as the whole red sea churned as his Pantheon, fossil-crystal shores tearing free to orbit his advance, and THE Creature moved through his own convergence like a flaming obsidian titan, striking with the accumulated mass of everything that existed nearby!
And he was pressed back.

Pressed! Continuously, grindingly pushed back, the golden being meeting the totality of Existence with one hand while the pillar of Superbius around him burned brighter, and this entity seemed a level above even Ryaenara as his cold laughter finally rolled across the red sea!

"Haha... ha. And who,"the Gilded True Lifeform asked, golden eyes gleaming with genuine, unhurried amusement, "do you think you are, to attack like this? No words. No declaration! You simply walked up to your betters and swung all of existence at us like a club. I have lived a very long time, dark thing, and I confess, the audacity is almost refreshing."
His hand pressed forward, and THE Creature learned what made this being’s oppression unique!

For the Ananke Intent of this Superbius Gilded One carried qualities other Intents could not even imagine! Ordinary inevitability declared outcomes upon targets. His inevitability declared outcomes upon the stage itself, his Intent woven through with Dimensional weavings, the deep grammar of Dimensions folded into every expression of his will! When he pressed, he did not merely press against THE Creature. He pressed against the space THE Creature occupied, against the weavings THE Creature’s Pantheon had claimed, and the surrounding existence simply tore apart beneath the declarations, reality shredding in golden lines because his pride had decided that where he pushed, nothing, not even the fabric of the Dimension, was permitted to push back!
It was Intent that had stopped negotiating with existence entirely!

THE Creature’s Pantheon claimed the surroundings, and the golden being’s Intent tore the claimed surroundings out from under him, ripping the stage apart faster than Existence could be it, and piece by piece, exchange by exchange, THE Creature was gradually getting bloody!

Obsidian flames sputtered around fresh wounds as his titanic frame absorbed blow after declaring blow, dark blood the color of deep space scattering across the red waves, and through all of it, THE Creature remained calm! He did not rage. He did not fear, for Existence had no fear! He simply fought, and bled, and thought, with the flat clarity that had carried him since before THE Wyld.
What should he do? He had hit an immovable wall as...should he call for help?

Normally, the question would not even rise. Normally, he would face everything himself, alone, as he had faced every era since his other half was brutalized before his eyes, for Existence needed nothing else! Existence bore all things alone. That was the architecture of him, the truth his appendages had grown from, the path he had built his entire long survival upon.
But...
Another exchange. Another golden declaration tearing through his claimed sea. Another wound opening across his titanic shoulder as he was pressed back another hundred miles!
He thought once more. He was not Existence alone.

The thought arrived quietly, in the middle of the blood and the pressure, and it did not feel like weakness. It felt, strangely, like an idea he had been refusing to finish for eras! He was Existence. And he was also THE Creature! And THE Creature was made up of many things, the flames, the flat words, the grudges and the graves, the memory of a slaughtered other half, the endless Adversity, and...
Connections. Connections were one of the things he was made of!
He had simply spent so long bearing everything alone that he had catalogued them as things he protected, and never once as things he could call!

And out of all his connections... Even if he called for Osmont, this anomaly could not cross this Dimension’s restricted weavings in time. Even Ryaenara, mighty as she was, could not sense his location through THE Krazhor-Nul’s ancient veils! Distance ruled them all here.
But he knew one person who was not ruled by distance.
One person who could always appear wherever he needed to appear...so long as he was called for! An old explorer of everywhere, who had A Way others could not imagine.

The golden being’s next declaration tore the sea apart beneath him, and THE Creature stood bloody at the heart of his own shredding Pantheon, facing powerful Gilded True Lifeforms upon a red sea at the bottom of a cursed Dimension...
And called out grandly!
"Anaximander, come."
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5507: The Explorer! I
paragraphs: The Superbius Gilded True Lifeform struck again.

His terrifying Intent descended upon the bloodied titan as golden Dimensional weavings tore the red sea apart along its path, inevitability declaring THE Creature broken, the stage shredding beneath the declaration as the strike crossed the distance in a single fold of pride!
And then a figure appeared in front of THE Creature.

It was a humanoid visage. A scholar! An explorer! A man of unremarkable height in scholarly white robes, his hair tousled as if he had just walked out of a library and into a hurricane, his hands clasped calmly behind his back!
And shockingly...the descending Intent split!

The golden declaration of a Cenozoic-equivalent being forked around the newcomer like a river forced around a stone it could not acknowledge, tearing twin canyons through the sea on either side of him as it dispersed into the storm, as if the Intent itself simply could not hit the being that had just appeared!
THE Creature looked at this being, and sighed, and shook his head with open marvel.
Anaximander!

A supposedly normal human who had been studying the stars of a Lower Observable Existence, only to be visited paradoxically by THE Weavers, and from there...he had taken a step simply because he said he could...and appeared in space! He could not survive in space. But he simply deemed that he should, and so he did!

He held no authority. Not a single wisp of it, not then and not now! And yet this man had shouldered the burden of the Veil between the Living and the Dead, helping THE Creature carry it without even knowing what it was. He could do things because his existence made it so he could do them, and in that early era, others had not truly understood what they were looking at. Even THE Creature had not.
But the moment THE Creature grasped the weavings of a True Lifeform, of Identity and how it steered everything, how a lived claim made existence conform...his first thought had been Anaximander.
In all of existence, THE Creature truly could not say who had lived their way, based purely on their identity, making existence conform to what they believed...more than Anaximander!

And he appeared now, untouched, the terrifying Intent of a Superbius Gilded True Lifeform parting around him, likely because somewhere along his wandering road, the scholar had simply declared a commandment that his body could not be harmed by others.
THE Creature shook his head and nodded to him.
"It has been some time, Anaximander."
The explorer turned, and laughed!
"Some time? It’s been over a year, big guy!"
A year?

Barely days had passed since THE Creature, Osmont, and Anaximander had parted, since they painted the skies of that Lower Observable Existence red-gold with the blood of a Gilded One and started this entire chain of events.
But for Anaximander, more than a year had passed? Just what dimensions had this man wandered into, to distort time so much?
There was no time to catch up.

Anaximander turned around to see the two grand True Lifeforms gazing over coldly, the Ira one risen bloodied from the waves, the Superbius one burning with golden offense, and the scholar whistled in open amazement as he looked them up and down like specimens.

"Oh, wonderful. The two of you are True," he said, nodding along to his own observation. "Genuinely True, I can tell, it’s all very impressive. But...hm. Your Egos seem to conflict with your Trueness. Ira rages against what is, and Superbius insists on more than what is, and both of those are arguments with reality, aren’t they? That is quite paradoxical for beings whose whole foundation is being seamless with reality."He tilted his head, and said it plainly, like a diagnosis.
"I don’t think...you are True at all."
HUUM!
He said such simple words.

And yet in the next moment, the gazes of two True Lifeforms changed heavily! Shock bloomed first, then incredulity, and then from their golden bodies...their Intents began to leak! Wrath and pride flooded out of them in unraveling streams as if a hole had been poked in each of their existences, Trueness hemorrhaging into the storm, two seamless claims suddenly springing seams because a man with no authority had looked at them and disagreed!
Even THE Creature was alarmed!

His flat eyes swept the scholar and found nothing, no Intent, no working, no exertion of any framework existence had ever catalogued, just a man in white robes floating over a red sea, being right at people!
"You may want to attack, big guy,"Anaximander said casually,"I can’t keep this up for too long!"
THE Creature shook his head once at the immensity of his friend.
And took a step!

He imposed himself upon two incredulous True Lifeforms in whose deepest weavings doubt had begun to bloom, doubt about the very claims their existences were built upon! And when there was doubt in something True...it was done for!
The battle that followed was brutal.
BOOM!

The Ira Gilded One erupted first as his True Appendage tore free of his back, THE Gauntlets of the Unspent Fury, colossal crimson gauntlets forged from every rage he had ever swallowed, and he met THE Creature’s charge head-on as their fists collided with a detonation that vaporized miles of the red sea! THE Creature took the blow across his jaw, dark blood scattering, and answered with THE Burden, slamming the wrathful titan down through the boiling waves as he followed him under, fists hammering down like falling eras!

The Superbius one moved a breath later, golden light screaming as his own Appendage bloomed, THE Crown of the Unbowed Summit, a floating diadem of golden Dimensional weavings that tore reality apart in halos around him, and his declarations rained down upon THE Creature’s back, shredding the claimed sea, ripping wounds across obsidian shoulders even as their Trueness kept leaking, kept bleeding, their every technique arriving thinner than the last!
CRACK!
THE Creature caught the Ira one’s gauntlet mid-swing and broke the arm behind it over his knee!

The wrathful being howled as THE MAW opened along the titan’s shoulder and bit the crimson Appendage in half, devouring fury mid-scream, and THE Creature spun through the golden declarations raining from above, taking two across the chest, bleeding, always bleeding, and not slowing at all, as he seized the Ira one by the skull and used a True Lifeform as a club to smash the descending Crown from the sky!
"You...what did he DO?!"
And through all of it, both Gilded beings kept glancing hatefully at the scholar!

His terrifying Intent descended upon the bloodied titan as golden Dimensional weavings tore the red sea apart along its path, inevitability declaring THE Creature broken, the stage shredding beneath the declaration as the strike crossed the distance in a single fold of pride!
And then a figure appeared in front of THE Creature.
It was a humanoid visage.
A scholar!
An explorer!
A man of unremarkable height in scholarly white robes, his hair tousled as if he had just walked out of a library and into a hurricane, his hands clasped calmly behind his back!
And shockingly...the descending Intent split!

The golden declaration of a Cenozoic-equivalent being forked around the newcomer like a river forced around a stone it could not acknowledge, tearing twin canyons through the sea on either side of him as it dispersed into the storm, as if the Intent itself simply could not hit the being that had just appeared!
THE Creature looked at this being, and sighed, and shook his head with open marvel.
Anaximander!

He could not survive in space.
But he simply deemed that he should, and so he did!
He held no authority.
Not a single wisp of it, not then and not now!
And yet this man had shouldered the burden of the Veil between the Living and the Dead, helping THE Creature carry it without even knowing what it was.
He could do things because his existence made it so he could do them, and in that early era, others had not truly understood what they were looking at.
Even THE Creature had not.

"It has been some time, Anaximander."
The explorer turned, and laughed!
"Some time?
It’s been over a year, big guy!"
A year?

But for Anaximander, more than a year had passed?
Just what dimensions had this man wandered into, to distort time so much?
There was no time to catch up.

chapters.title: Chapter 5508: The Explorer! II
paragraphs: They kept glancing at the explorer who floated calmly beyond the battle with no authority around him whatsoever, doing, as far as any sense could detect, absolutely nothing.

And when they looked at him in their fury, they actually saw him wiping sweat from his forehead, dabbing at it with his sleeve like an academic in an overheated lecture hall, and they wanted to curse him! What was he so tired from when he was just floating there?!
Their distraction cost them everything.

THE Creature’s Pantheon closed. The red sea folded upward in continental walls as the Burden descended one final time upon both leaking, doubting, hemorrhaging existences, and THE MAW opened wider than it had ever opened, wide as a horizon, and THE Creature drove both Gilded True Lifeforms into it with his own bleeding hands!
He devoured them!

Their bodies, their Appendages, their screaming and unraveling Intents, wrath and pride and every last golden thread of two True existences, all of it poured down into the burning dark of THE MAW as the sea finally, finally went still!
And THE Creature fell.

His titanic frame smashed into the calm red water and lay there, half-sunken, breathing heavily as obsidian flames flickered low across dozens of wounds, his existence groaning as it began to heal! Deep within him, the boons of devouring two powerful True Lifeforms churned through his foundations, wrath and pride and Trueness breaking down into raw existential wealth, his frame drinking it all as his grades creaked upward, and Existence, for once, simply floated on its back and processed.
Anaximander whistled and floated over.

The scholar drifted across the settling waves, and then his eyes blinked wide in wonder as he finally noticed the colossal pale limb floating in the distance, the severed leg with clouds around its heel!
"Oh my. What Lifeform left such a limb behind?"
His eyes sparkled with a pure, bottomless need to understand.
THE Creature breathed out heavily from the water, and waved one bleeding hand.
"The limb of a Primeval One. You can have it." He said it flatly, easily.
"I wouldn’t have even come close to getting it without your help."
He said such words casually, handing away a treasure that a True Lifeform of the Sixth Scale had been bleeding themselves to siphon, for THE Creature had tremendous control over his greed!
Anaximander blinked at him. Then he laughed, loud and delighted, robes shaking.

"What use have I for something so big? Come on, I’ll study it, maybe cook a bit of it, and then you can have it after."He settled cross-legged onto the air above the healing titan, grinning."It is great seeing you again, Old Friend. I only wish Osmont was here too, so we could all enjoy this properly! I have so many stories. I met so many interesting things! There was this dimension made entirely of arguments, and a creature that only existed on alternating days, and..."
THE Creature calibrated his existence in the water below, and interrupted mildly.
"Osmont is in this Dimension too. Just somewhere very far, as I can’t easily reach him."
At these words, Anaximander’s eyes lit up like twin stars!
"Osmont is here too? Haha!" The Explorer clapped his hands once. "Then it should be easy for us all to get together. I can just take us to him."
THE Creature’s eyes shone with brilliance as he looked up at Anaximander.

The restricted weavings of THE Krazhor-Nul. The veils that blinded even Ryaenara. The distances that severed messages! And this man, this authority-less scholar, stood on the air and offered to simply walk past all of it, because doors, and distances, and ancient Dimensional restrictions, were superstitions he had never subscribed to.
Right. He was Anaximander!
And between him and Osmont, THE Creature could truly not decide who was more of an anomaly. He shook his head as...
His aura began to surge upwards!

THE Creature lay half-sunken in the calm red sea as the digestion of two True Lifeforms truly began, and it was a heavy feast even for Existence! Wrath and pride broke down within THE MAW’s deep furnaces as two devoured Intents unwound into raw Trueness, two consumed Pantheons dissolved into dense existential wealth, and his obsidian flames climbed higher and higher off his healing frame as his aura swelled in slow, rising tides that made the storm above the sea circle like stirred water.
And while he digested, Anaximander drifted over to the limb.

The scholar floated up alongside the colossal severed leg of the Primeval One, craning his neck to take in its full scale, the pale unrotted flesh, the clouds gathered around its heel, the residual grandeur that kept the red waves flattened for miles, and he shook his head with unhidden marvel.

"You know, after I left our Observable Existence, I crossed through multiple Dimensions," he said, walking slowly along the air beside the limb as if strolling a museum hall. "I just wanted to get away and explore! And in all the Dimensions I have been in, all of them, Primeval Lifeforms are deemed those at the top. The apex above apexes! You do not readily find a limb of one just...lying around."He gestured at it, delighted.

"I heard stories of Dimensions that served as old battlefields, places where many Primeval and True Lifeforms died in ancient wars, and I was planning on making a trip to one eventually. But this will do..."
He said such words casually.
THE Creature watched him from the water as the digestion churned on, and he couldn’t help but ask.
"Your path is somewhat unique. What do you normally gain from something like this?"
Anaximander smiled.

And then, shockingly, he came near the limb, the very limb that two Gilded True Lifeforms had been straining and sweating to siphon, whose residual grandeur had fought a Cenozoic-adjacent being thread by thread, and simply placed his hand on it!

His lack of aura, his lack of power, his lack of anything, seemingly did not cause the limb to even react! The dead flesh that had resisted True Lifeforms accepted the palm of a scholar with no authority the way a book accepts being opened, and Anaximander patted it fondly.

"There is an old parable I heard in one of the many worlds I visited,"he said. "This one was about a two-thousand-year-old Taoist, and it went like this. A farmer lost his only horse, and his neighbors cried for his bad luck. The farmer simply asked, how do you know it is bad?"His hand drifted along the pale flesh as he spoke.
"The next day, the horse returned, and brought a dozen wild horses with it. The neighbors cheered for his good fortune. The farmer asked, how do you know it is good?"
THE Creature listened from the red water, flames rising slowly.

"Days later, the farmer’s son fell off one of the wild horses and broke his leg. The neighbors cried about the bad luck. The farmer asked, how do you know it is bad?"Anaximander’s voice carried easily across the still sea.
"And soon, the army arrived to draft all able-bodied young men for a war. But the son was skipped, because of his broken leg. And the neighbors rejoiced at his luck!"
He turned back toward the healing titan, and his scholar’s eyes were bright.

"The lesson in it was simple. All knowledge is temporary! You never know the full story when events happen. The horse leaving was the horses arriving. The broken leg was the saved life! True wisdom is accepting life as it comes, because the story is never finished when you judge it."

chapters.title: Chapter 5509: Giving! I
paragraphs: He patted the Primeval limb once more.

"So, what do I gain from something like this? Exactly that. I know things I have no control over will happen, big guy. They always do. Horses leave, and armies come. I cannot stop any of it."He shrugged, and there was nothing resigned in the gesture at all, only appetite.

"So I just seek more and more knowledge, to just maybe understand those things when they happen...or get through them. Understanding the power of beings like Primeval Lifeforms is a good test of knowledge! And knowledge is the only thing I will ever need, while I prepare for whatever existence sends my way."He laughed at himself, waving a hand.
"Haha, I talked too much, it’s been a while since I had company that talks back! I’ll be done with a preliminary look soon, and then I’ll see if I can take us to Osmont."
With these words, Anaximander focused.

He closed his eyes while touching the limb, his tousled head bowing slightly, a man with no authority quietly reading the corpse-flesh of an apex being like a text, and the red sea went very still around him.
And THE Creature, half-sunken and healing, thought about the story.
How do you know what is good or what is bad?

He turned the parable over in his flat, ancient way. His other half, brutalized before his eyes, the worst thing existence had ever done to him, and the reason he had carried every burden alone since. It was..Bad. Surely bad!

And yet that carrying had grown into THE Burden of Existence, the appendage that had crushed a Serpent and hammered Gilded True Lifeforms into THE MAW among many more. The statue, inherited and unwanted, foreign weight wearing his name. Bad? It had risen for him many now, and he still breathed! Even today, pressed bloody across a red sea by a Cenozoic-equivalent being, moments from a loss that would have ended eras of solitude, bad, plainly bad, and it had forced him to finally finish the weavings he had refused for so long, that connections were not only things he protected. And the finishing had brought Anaximander, and Anaximander was about to bring Osmont!
How do you know it is good or bad?
He didn’t.
Existence itself, and he could not judge his own story mid-telling.
"Hm," THE Creature said quietly to the red water, and let the parable settle into his foundations.
Then he had to focus himself.

For eating the Intent and Pantheon of an Ananke Intent True Lifeform, alongside the Intent and Pantheon of an Egoic Intent True Lifeform, was truly a heavy feast! Wrath’s seamless pride and inevitability’s golden grammar poured through his deepest weavings as his own Intent drank and drank, and the accounting of the digestion ran clear before him. It should be enough to take him to Ananke as well.
Just barely!
Enough to carry Existence itself across the threshold of the second order, from I am...to I must be obeyed!
So he focused.
And like this, the red sea closed on the two of them.

A scholar in white robes with his eyes shut and his palm upon the limb of a dead apex being, reading! A titan of obsidian flame half-sunken in arterial waters, digesting two True existences toward inevitability! Neither of them speaking, neither of them moving, the storm turning in slow reverence overhead.
And around the two of them, unfathomable Trueness gathered in silent, invisible waves!
<THE True Human Emperor>
Ever since he became THE True Human Emperor, Noah felt like he had become more...contemplative.

He thought about many things now, in the drifting quiets between eruptions, and he had come to understand that this was not idleness. It was work! For a True Lifeform advanced through Identity, and Identity was not a treasure one stumbled upon, it was a territory one surveyed. If he was not turning his own self over, examining its borders, questioning its choices, then he would not truly be advancing at all. Contemplation was cultivation now. The throne was also a training ground!
And after transcribing THE Protagonist, his last Letter, or perhaps his potential last Letter, his thoughts had circled back to a decision he had made without ever formally making it.
Why had he never made INFINITE one of the Letters of THE Osmontian Tongue?

He turned the question over honestly! Infinity was the root of him, the fireball skill book, the mana, the first Cause, the boundless rivers he traveled by. Surely it deserved a Letter? And yet every time he weighed it, it did not feel like it could stand entirely true! For he was not Infinity itself, he was Osmontian, and Infinity was one of the things his identity expressed. To carve INFINITE into his backbone felt like claiming a robe was the body! He wanted to stand for Infinity through his Osmontian identity, not beside it.

And the Source received no Letter for the same deeper reason. He had long since fused Source and Infinity into Osmontian Source Infinity, one thing, seamless, his! Declaring them as separate Letters felt like...seperation. Like undoing a marriage to honor the spouses individually!
Well. This was how he currently felt. He could always change his mind.
And as he was thinking all this, the chaotic tendrils of Infinity nearby had gathered to him.

They floated in like rivers finding their sea, wild currents of the storm bending down to the golden island and coiling around his seated figure, and Noah read them idly, the information they carried of where they had been, of the ancient territories they had raged across, of things that had passed through them in ages past! It was like listening to well-traveled elders gossip, and he had been at it for hours.
Then the surroundings fluctuated heavily!
Noah rose to attention in an instant, Intent gathering, wings a thought away, for something was folding space nearby and folding it close, and in this Dimension, arrivals were rarely gentle...!
WAP!
The air split, and THE Creature appeared!

The titanic figure landed upon the edge of the golden sands wrapped in his obsidian flames, freshly-healed wounds still tracing pale lines across his frame, his aura carrying a new density that Noah’s senses flagged immediately! And behind him, hanging in the storming sky...
Was a foot.

A colossal severed limb floated in space above the golden island, pale and unrotted and vast beyond framing, clouds gathered around its heel as its residual grandeur pressed the storm flat for miles, and standing before it, wiping his brow, was a man in white scholarly robes!
"...Anaximander?"

How do you know it is good or bad?
He didn’t.
Existence itself, and he could not judge his own story mid-telling.
"Hm," THE Creature said quietly to the red water, and let the parable settle into his foundations.
Then he had to focus himself.
For eating the Intent and Pantheon of an Ananke Intent True Lifeform, alongside the Intent and Pantheon of an Egoic Intent True Lifeform, was truly a heavy feast!
Wrath’s seamless pride and inevitability’s golden grammar poured through his deepest weavings as his own Intent drank and drank, and the accounting of the digestion ran clear before him.
It should be enough to take him to Ananke as well.
Just barely!
Enough to carry Existence itself across the threshold of the second order, from I am...to I must be obeyed!
So he focused.
And like this, the red sea closed on the two of them.
A scholar in white robes with his eyes shut and his palm upon the limb of a dead apex being, reading!
A titan of obsidian flame half-sunken in arterial waters, digesting two True existences toward inevitability!
Neither of them speaking, neither of them moving, the storm turning in slow reverence overhead.
And around the two of them, unfathomable Trueness gathered in silent, invisible waves!
<THE True Human Emperor>
Ever since he became THE True Human Emperor, Noah felt like he had become more...contemplative.
He thought about many things now, in the drifting quiets between eruptions, and he had come to understand that this was not idleness.
It was work!
For a True Lifeform advanced through Identity, and Identity was not a treasure one stumbled upon, it was a territory one surveyed.
If he was not turning his own self over, examining its borders, questioning its choices, then he would not truly be advancing at all.
Contemplation was cultivation now.
The throne was also a training ground!
And after transcribing THE Protagonist, his last Letter, or perhaps his potential last Letter, his thoughts had circled back to a decision he had made without ever formally making it.
Why had he never made INFINITE one of the Letters of THE Osmontian Tongue?
He turned the question over honestly!
Infinity was the root of him, the fireball skill book, the mana, the first Cause, the boundless rivers he traveled by.
Surely it deserved a Letter?
And yet every time he weighed it, it did not feel like it could stand entirely true!
For he was not Infinity itself, he was Osmontian, and Infinity was one of the things his identity expressed.
To carve INFINITE into his backbone felt like claiming a robe was the body!
He wanted to stand for Infinity through his Osmontian identity, not beside it.
And the Source received no Letter for the same deeper reason.
He had long since fused Source and Infinity into Osmontian Source Infinity, one thing, seamless, his!
Declaring them as separate Letters felt like...seperation.
Like undoing a marriage to honor the spouses individually!
Well.
This was how he currently felt.
He could always change his mind.
And as he was thinking all this, the chaotic tendrils of Infinity nearby had gathered to him.

They floated in like rivers finding their sea, wild currents of the storm bending down to the golden island and coiling around his seated figure, and Noah read them idly, the information they carried of where they had been, of the ancient territories they had raged across, of things that had passed through them in ages past!
It was like listening to well-traveled elders gossip, and he had been at it for hours.
Then the surroundings fluctuated heavily!
Noah rose to attention in an instant, Intent gathering, wings a thought away, for something was folding space nearby and folding it close, and in this Dimension, arrivals were rarely gentle...!
WAP!
The air split, and THE Creature appeared!

The titanic figure landed upon the edge of the golden sands wrapped in his obsidian flames, freshly-healed wounds still tracing pale lines across his frame, his aura carrying a new density that Noah’s senses flagged immediately!
And behind him, hanging in the storming sky...
Was a foot.

A colossal severed limb floated in space above the golden island, pale and unrotted and vast beyond framing, clouds gathered around its heel as its residual grandeur pressed the storm flat for miles, and standing before it, wiping his brow, was a man in white scholarly robes!
"...Anaximander?"

chapters.title: Chapter 5510: Giving! II
paragraphs: Noah looked ahead with open surprise as THE Infiniverse and Emotive turned sharply, and even Seo-yeon’s eyes snapped open from her sensing, all of them taking in the entrants, and all of them especially staring at the floating limb!

Anaximander wiped his brows as if he were genuinely tired, and then he saw Noah, and his whole face lit up! He took a step, and appeared directly before the throne, and pulled Noah into a laughing bro hug, clapping his back.
"It has been many months, my friend! You look good!"
Noah shook his head as he returned the embrace and looked the explorer over.

He looked good? How the hell had this supposedly weak explorer made it to a Dimension this terrifying? And months had passed for him, when barely days had passed since they had parted over the red-gold skies of their Lower Observable Existence?
Existence was truly vast and full of terrors!
"It has been a little while,"Noah said, his mouth curving as his gaze slid past the scholar’s shoulder. "How did you end up here with...that?"

Even Noah could not keep his attention off the heart-shaking limb behind them! Anaximander turned to follow his gaze, and it was the titanic figure of THE Creature, floating over across the sands, who answered.
"I called Anaximander over after facing two Gilded True Lifeforms I could not overcome,"THE Creature said flatly. "The limb of a Primeval One was the boon from it that they were trying to devour."
Noah’s brows rose.

THE Creature had met something he could not overcome, and the solution...was Anaximander? So this monstrous explorer held enough power to go against True Lifeforms as well? Noah smiled at the idea, another impossible line quietly added to the ledger of his strangest friend, and at this moment, a small figure padded across the golden sands.
Seo-yeon came over to greet the newcomer, stopping before him with her hands clasped politely, mirrored light drifting off her shoulders.

"Hello, Aba’s friend! I am Seo-yeon!" She tilted her head at him, and her small brows furrowed with genuine puzzlement. "You are as powerful as Aba and the big Creature? But I don’t sense any authority from you..."
Anaximander knelt down to her height and shook her small hand with complete seriousness.
"Hello, Seo-yeon. It is very nice to meet you."He smiled, and answered her puzzle simply. "Sometimes you don’t need authority to be powerful. You just need to be yourself."
Seo-yeon’s eyes shone as she heard this, the words settling into her somewhere deep, and Noah watched his daughter store the sentance away like a treasure.
But his own gaze had already drifted back, again, to the limb of the Primeval One.
THE Creature watched him watching it, and thought for a moment, and then spoke.
"You can have...a piece of it, if you want. It is currently Anaximander’s, for him to study."
Noah shook his head slowly.
His eyes were shining brilliantly, for he was thinking about something else entirely, an idea assembling itself piece by piece behind the shine, and he voiced out calmly soon after.
"Do you two trust me?"
Anaximander rose up from Seo-yeon’s height and blinked. He looked at THE Creature. THE Creature looked at him. The two of them nodded.
"Then give me ownership of this entire limb."
He said the words calmly!

And with how prized the thing floating before them was, a corpse-piece of an apex being that Sixth Scale existences had bled to siphon, anyone else hearing such words might break off relations on the spot and call him greedy! But Anaximander and THE Creature both only raised their brows, exchanged one more glance, and nodded lightly.
"It’s yours," Anaximander said.
HUUM!
Noah’s figure rose from the throne at this.

For he was thinking about many things. About the utility and usage of something like THE Tide That Owes Nothing. About what things were considered his, or not his, in the deep accounting of existence! About what things he could give away, and what the act of giving truly required.
He had a daring idea he wanted to try.

He floated near the limb, and the pressure hit him like a wall. Even dead, even severed, the residual grandeur of a Primeval One pressed against his existence in slow crushing waves, and Noah could barely get near it, his newly-elevated C-Rank Intent flaring out grandly around his body as identity pushed back against the weight of an apex corpse! Endless blue bloomed beneath the colossal foot as his Osmontian Source Infinity formed a vast platform at its base, and Noah strained!

His body burned with effort as the platform groaned, and slowly, barely, the limb of a Primeval One began to move! Inch by trembling inch, he floated it forward, and through the strain he could feel it happening, some deep weaving of existence turning its pages, conditions of ownership being met one by one through the sweat of genuine effort, the thing becoming his not by word but by work!
And then, barely holding the limb aloft, Noah turned to Anaximander behind him, and spoke heavily through the strain.
"I give freely and openly...this treasure of mine...to you."
HUUM!
Anaximander looked toward Noah as if wondering just what game his friend was playing. He just asked for it, and was now giving it back?
And as Noah did this, he raised his gaze above, and wondered.
Was his capability truly so busted? Would this even lead to anything? Could-
BOOOM!
Before his thoughts even finished, the skies above them tore open!

An aura bloomed through the tear, and it was heavy, tens of times heavier than the limb floating below it, pressing down upon the entire golden island as Noah looked up in astonishment, as Anaximander’s jaw actually dropped, as even THE Creature’s flat eyes widened, and through it all, booming prompts arrived!
|THE Tide That Owes Nothing has been triggered.|
Oh!
It was simply an idea he wanted to try! Simply...an idea!
