chapters.title: Chapter 5511: Predator and Prey! I
paragraphs: Something immensely pristine and magisterial was emerging!

Noah looked up, and the Dimension itself was splitting apart! The heavy skies of THE Krazhor-Nul tore open along a widening seam as white and gold light pulsed outward for light years, waves of pristine radiance rolling across the storm and flattening it, and through the tear, condensing out of the light with unbearable slowness...was a limb!

It formed lengthwise, vast and pale and rounded, extending down through the split skies in a long thick column of white-gold flesh, and Noah stared up at its emerging shape with his astonishment slowly acquiring a very specific quality.
No way, right?

The limb kept extending! Long, cylindrical, rounded at its emerging tip, radiating apex grandeur across light years, and Noah, THE True Human Emperor, found himself tilting his head at the boon descending from his most sacred Foundation as a single unworthy thought refused to leave.
No. No way. The Tide wouldn’t!
And then hair erupted across it!
Pristine white hairs bloomed along the entire column in cascading waves, silken and radiant and flowing, and the shape resolved at last into what it had always been becoming, a tail!
A colossal severed tail of some Primeval being, its white-gold hairs drifting weightlessly across the torn sky, each strand humming with power, and Noah breathed out in relief.
But this was only the first.

Two more auras bloomed through the tear, and both of them exceeded the limb of the Primeval One floating below by at least tens of times. The whole golden island groaned under their arrival as Emotive grabbed Seo-yeon close, and the second emergence condensed into view.
It was a portion of a brain!

A vast hemisphere of white-gold cerebral matter, its folded surface glowing along every ridge and valley, a cerebral cortex of some apex existence with rivers of luminous thought-essense still flickering through its folds like trapped lightning, dead and yet dreaming, its presense pressing down with a weight that made Intent itself feel observed!
And lastly...came the bubble.

It emerged smallest of the three, a translucent sphere no larger than a palace, and it was undoubtedly the most astonishing and heart-shaking of them all! For within the bubble drifted cells. Ancient, colossal, slowly-turning cells of pure white-gold, each one a cathedral of primordial architecture, their membranes woven from layered lattices of proto-existence, their nuclei burning like compressed dawns! They were totipotent, the primeval root-cells from which anything could grow, flesh or organ or appendage or existence itself, undifferentiated and therefore unlimited, each one humming with the terrifying patience of matter that had not yet chosen what to become! Merely gazing at them, Noah’s Sight could perceive infinite branching futures folded inside every membrane, wings and eyes and hearts and things without names, all of them waiting, all of them possible!
And the moment all three finished forming, the prompts arrived.

|THE Tide That Owes Nothing has answered the single greatest act of giving you have ever performed. You strained your existence to claim true ownership of a Primeval One’s limb, and gave it away freely in the same breath. The Sharpened Returns have reached across depths I cannot source, and I will catalogue what has emerged.|
|First: THE Blank Caudal of the Unwritten Primeval. A template tail-appendage of Primeval grade, unwritten by any Intent.|
|Second: THE Blank Cortex of the Unwritten Primeval.A template cerebral appendage of Primeval grade, likewise unwritten.|
|Third: THE Primeval Totipotent Cell Source. A preserved cluster of Primeval totipotent cells, the root-matter of apex existence itself, capable of becoming anything.|

|The formation of these three goes against existence itself. They are Primeval Appendages and Source bearing no Intent except a basal, enigmatic, and tyrannical Primeval Intent, and that Intent looks down upon everything. Upon this Dimension. Upon all of you. They acknowledge no claim and await no owner! If they are not locked down and taken into an existence within the next nanosecond, they will disappear across Dimensions and Time.|
Noah roared out!
"Catch the other two! They will disappear in a nanosecond if left alone!"

He bellowed it in the span of an instant as his crown was already spinning, THE Infiniverse already dissolving into his chest, the fusion of THE Quintessential Confluence slamming through his body mid-flight as he shot upward toward the one he could not bear to lose, the most overwhelming of the three, the cluster of cells! And behind him, astonished and yet instant, THE Creature blurred toward the white-haired tail as Anaximander simply took a step and appeared before the cerebral cortex.
Noah arrived before the bubble of cells.
And their aura hit him like the contempt of a mountain range.

The cluster radiated terrific white-gold grandeur, power and arrogance woven into every turning membrane, a basal Primeval Intent gazing down upon the fused confluence of three True Lifeforms the way emperors gaze at petitioners, and the bubble was already thinning, already sliding sideways out of the grip of the present, Dimensions and Time opening around it like doors!
"COME!"
Noah bellowed as he unleashed everything!

His Intent erupted at its fused grandeur as his Osmontian Source Infinity poured out in continental tides, cerulean seas crashing around the bubble from every direction, and he barely, barely surrounded the cluster, his power straining against that tyrannical basal Intent like hands around a falling star! It was not enough to hold. He could feel it! The cells looked down upon his grip and were already leaving, and to actually obtain them, to take them into his existence, he would have to exert everything and then more than everything.
And through the strain, prompts buzzed in his mind.
|From your immense giving, you have also gained 5,000,000 Osmontian Biomass. Current reserves: 5,163,000.|
Five million!
The number landed, and Noah did not celebrate it, he spent it.

"All facets of my existence, upgrade them to Rank C! And my Intent..."His roar tore across the light-flooded sky as the cells strained against his seas! "Take THE Ananke Intent of THE Quintessential Osmontian to Rank B!"

|Executing everything at once, Master.The required number of Osmontian Biomass will vary for different upgrades of your existence as your existence has been rapidly elevating from the surroundings and from the foods and products you have been consuming.|

chapters.title: Chapter 5512: Predator and Prey! II
paragraphs: |Osmontian Source Infinity elevated to C-Rank, Straif, the Blackthorn, the grade of sharpness and consequence. Cost: 300,000.|
|Volume elevated to C-Rank. Output elevated to C-Rank. Trueness elevated to C-Rank.|

|The remaining Foundations, elevated through their grades to C-Rank, Straif: THE Unkneeling Crown. THE Mirror That Keeps. THE Hunger That Refines. THE Unmoved Verdict. THE Pure Trajectory. THE All-Drawing Stillness. THE Remembered Truth. And THE Sovereign Existence, your Ninth, whose imposition of your identity upon nearby existence now carries the Blackthorn’s edge. Cost: 1,960,000.|

|THE Tide That Owes Nothing, your Second Foundation, elevated to B-Rank, Ngetal, the Reed, the grade of reach and pervasion. Its returns now range from twenty thousand to one hundred thousandfold, and its Sharpened Returns have deepened into Woven Returns, boons that may now arrive already interlinked with your existing capabilities. Cost: 1,100,000.|

|And THE Ananke Intent of THE Quintessential Osmontian, elevated from C-Rank, Straif, to B-Rank, Ngetal. Cost: 1,250,000. Within THE Quintessential Confluence, it now functions at A-Rank, Idho, the Yew, the grade of near-permanence and authority over endings.|
|Total expenditure: 4,760,000. Remaining reserves: 403,000. Every facet of your existence now stands at C-Rank or above, and your Intent stands within the peak.|
The pressure of his existence began to change!

It was visible! Across the light-flooded sky, Noah’s fused frame erupted with the settling weight of an entire existence rising grades in a single breath, his hair blazing brighter as the lemniscate rings in his eyes multiplied, and around him, billowing prismatic cerulean seas of his A-Rank-functioning Intent surged outward and wrapped around the cluster of cells in layer after layer after layer!
And finally...there was some form of stability!

The tyrannical basal Intent of the cells pressed against his seas, and for the first time, the seas did not thin! The bubble’s sideways slide through Dimensions and Time slowed, and strained, and stopped, ancient arrogance meeting an identity that had just paid millions of Biomass for the right to disagree with it, and the two pressures ground against each other in silence above the golden island!
Noah reached his hand out to grasp them!
<THE Recorder of Wilds>
Countless gigaparsecs from a golden island, upon a drifting cloud of solid gold, an old woman in white robes was having her tea.

The cloud floated placidly through the storming dark of THE Krazhor-Nul as its owner sat cross-legged at its center, a full tea set arranged before her upon a lacquered tray, steam curling gently from a cup so ancient its glaze had forgotten its original color.

Her long white hair was pinned loosely with a single wooden stick, her wrinkled face was folded into an expression of profound peace, and around her frame, the lethal ambient density of this Dimension, the pressure that killed non-True Lifeforms in minutes and made True ones wary...simply did not apply!
The rain of authorities parted around her cloud out of what could only be called respect.
She was Primeval.
And she was, at this moment, being interrupted mid-sip.

Far below her drifting cloud, a procession moved across the dark geography, and it was vast! More than twenty True Lifeforms traveled in loose formation across the storm, and more than half of them pressed upon existence with the weight of THE Cenozoic Scale, a gathering of apex beings. Among them coiled Ormarr Grimtunge, the great Serpent whole once more. Beneath them all, dragging the storm sideways with its ambient wrongness, walked a Steed. chapters.title: Chapter 5513: Predator and Prey! III
paragraphs: She chuckled into her sleeve, and swept her finger across the broader host.

"As for the rest of the colony, followers too, but of a gentler sort. Followers of their own paths of advancement. The antlered one, the three-faced one, the stone hound at the rear, each of them walked their own long road to Trueness, and each of them is here because a keeper called and the rewards seemed worth the errand. Look at how loosely they fly. Boredom, in a war-column! Every one of them is idly wondering why so many were sent for so small a task, and every one of them expects to be home before their perch cools. That is the comfort of a herd that has never once been thinned. I’ve seen that comfort many times, in many magnificent gatherings."She sipped her tea."I rarely saw it twice in the same gathering."
Then she paused, and her voice turned musing, the idle wondering of a very old watcher turning a specimen over in her mind.

"Though it does make one think, watching the Serpent groom himself against her shadow. These creatures call themselves True. Their whole existence rests on a seamless claim of I am. But if an animal fully and completely follows another, choosing nothing, steering nothing, simply attaching itself to whichever wake is strongest...is it truly true? Can a claim of I am survive a lifetime of I follow? Hm..." She smiled into her cup.
"Nature loves a paradox. She hides them in the strangest burrows."
Then her voice dropped, hushing into genuine reverence, and she turned her finger downward, to the thing beneath them all.
"And there. Quietly now."
The Steed of Oblivion moved through the dark like a wound of Existence.

It was colossal beyond even this host combined, a mountainous quadruped whose hide had gone the gray of forgotten things, whose failing First Cause flickered through its frame in guttering terminal weavings like a city being unlit district by district, and around it for vast miles, existence simply dimmed.

Ambient essense thinned. The storm quieted! Even the cursed rain seemed reluctant to land upon it, and it walked with its great head hung low, chained at the throat, radiating an ambient field of dimensional suppression that made even the Cenozoic beings above it keep their distance!

"A burden-bearer of the first broods," the old woman breathed. "Bred as a unique type of living Observable Existence when this Dimension was young and its makers still walked it. Look at what’s left of the poor thing. That guttering in its weavings is a First Cause ages deep into its dying. And that awful dimming around it, that used to be the very gift that carried riders between Dimensions, curdled now into a walking suppression that chokes every dimensional law that comes near. The keepers, those vile progeny thst are cursed, use them as weapons these days. Imagine finding one of the rarest songbirds in existence and deciding its best use is as a club."She sighed, long and old.

"It is in constant pain. Every step. And it has been walking a very, very long time. What a painful existence. Almost makes one want to make a move and put such a thing out of its misery. Would that not ve simpler? Easier? But alas...I am only here at the behest of s friend and will not be involved on any other matters."
She refreshed her tea, unhurried, as the war-host crawled on below.

"But...let’s take stock, shall we? A predator, unwrapped after ages in the drawer. A follower serpent hiding in her shadow, hoping her path will carry him somewhere. Twenty comfortable creatures on their own roads, too mighty to look behind themselves. And a dying burden-bearer dragged along as a siege engine, which The Jarls only ever unchain for prey they genuinely fear losing. Fear. A dying titan has been frightened into spending every treasure he owns at once, and not one of the treasures has thought to ask why...why exactly is such a sordid group of animals moving, and to where?"
She was asking herself of their purpose!
And... that was when she sensed it!
BOOM!
Countless gigaparsecs away, blinding white-gold light erupted across the deep dark!

The old woman’s cup paused halfway to her lips! Her ancient eyes, eyes that had watched eras the way others watched seasons, widened by a full measure as the distant radiance pulsed across the Dimension, and the flavor of it reached her with unmistakable clarity. Pristine. Magisterial. Apex!
Weavings of a Primeval One!
"...Oh?" she said.
But there shouldn’t be any of her kind in the immediate surroundings?
The old woman sipped her tea slowly, and looked back down at the procession, at the cold predator in red and the fawning Serpent and the twenty comfortable mighty.
They were all heading towards that same direction as after seeing that light, they became even faster!

"Well now. It seems somwthing interesting is at play..."She set down her cup and rose, white robes settling around her small frame as her golden cloud began to drift downward. "I assumed this was a colony marching on prey. Easy pickings for a dying keeper’s larder. But that light out there...say differently."
Her cloud descended through the storm, closer and closer to the marching party, and her old eyes gleamed.
"So the question flips over. Is this herd closing on a meal, or are those ahead the predators instead?"
A small, ancient smile folded through her wrinkles as she loved to observe nature and how it unfolded.

With that, the old woman floated her golden cloud extremely close to the party of True Lifeforms, settling in barely above Ormarr’s own coils, near enough to see the crimson eyes of the predator in red staring dead ahead, near enough to catch the idle words of the comfortable mighty, near enough to hear the Steed’s labored breathing, her tea set clinking gently as she poured herself a fresh cup in the middle of their formation!
And not a single one of them, not the blade, not the Serpent, not twenty True Lifeforms, not even the dying Steed of Those Who Remain...
Could see or sense her at all!

chapters.title: Chapter 5514: Predator and Prey! IV
paragraphs: <THE True Human Emperor>
His Intent stood at A-Rank, Idho, and Noah had never felt anything like it!

Within the fusion of THE Quintessential Confluence, THE Ananke Intent of THE Quintessential Osmontian functioned at the grade of near-permanence and authority over endings, and its grandeur was something he couldnt fully understand just yet.
Identity so dense it functioned as inevitability. I am, spoken with such weight that existence stopped checking!
And yet...there was more.

He could feel it at the very edges of his Intent, a trembling, a readiness, as if the whole of his identity stood before a door it had only just discovered! His Intent almost felt like it was about to undergo another evolution, something past Ananke entirely. But it was like there was something missing. The door stood, and his Intent pressed against it, and it did not open! Maybe there was one more step. One more truth to live, one more claim to earn!
Either way, that trembling readiness allowed him to erupt with a terrifying immensity right now, and right now was what mattered!
"COME!"
Noah bellowed out as he pulled!

The cluster of Primeval Totipotent Cells strained against his billowing prismatic seas one final time, tyrannical basal Intent glaring down at him across the gap of Scales, and Noah simply refused it, his A-Rank-functioning Intent crashing over that ancient arrogance in wave after wave as he forcefully dragged the bubble out of its sideways slide and into his existence! The translucent sphere of white-gold cells flowed toward his chest, shrinking as it came, cathedral-cells folding down and down as his Osmontian Source Infinity wrapped them in layer upon layer of endless blue, and they sank into him!

Through his chest. Through his weavings! Down through the deep architecture of everything he was, Noah guiding them with gritted teeth into the very core of his Source, into the endless sea of blue at the heart of his existence where his Infinity churned without shore or floor, and there, in the deepest waters of himself...he anchored them down!
HUUM!
He felt their immense Primeval aura the whole way, contempt and grandeur pressing against his inner seas.
But the moment they finished entering his existence...the cells became still.

The tyrannical basal Intent quieted like a storm crossing into a temple, and his Intent and Osmontian Source Infinity began to flood into them, blue tides washing across white-gold membranes as the cluster settled at his core, slowly turning, slowly drinking, ancient totipotency meeting an identity that had paid everything for the right to hold it.

|You have successfully contained THE Primeval Totipotent Cell Source. It is anchored at the core of your Source, and it has ceased resisting. Your Trueness is now permeating across the cells, and due to their totipotent nature, they will not remain blank. Something wholly yours, carrying a profound Primeval origin, will emerge from them in time. I cannot yet model what.|
Noah breathed out heavily as he felt things stabilizing within him, the two pressures at his core settling into a slow, watchful equilibrium, and he finally looked around.
And the sights around him were something!

THE Creature stood tall in the air a distance away, and his obsidian flames were rapidly rising in tempersture! They billowed hotter and brighter around his titanic frame with every breath, and the reason stuck out plainly behind him, a tail.

THE Blank Caudal of the Unwritten Primeval had rooted itself at the base of his spine, colossal and white-haired and drifting, and its pristine radiance was bleeding up through his flames as they changed, traces of white-gold threading through the obsidian fire like dawn invading a midnight.
And Anaximander...

Anaximander was clutching his head with both hands as if he had the headache of several lifetimes! The scholar hovered lopsided in the air, white robes askew, wincing as THE Blank Cortex of the Unwritten Primeval settled somewhere into his existence, and yet even through the wincing, his eyes were shining with pure amazement, and he looked over towards Noah with an expression that asked, louder than words, just how in all of existence did you DO that?!
Noah only smiled.

He felt no negative way at all towards THE Creature and Anaximander obtaining the other two boons. How could he? He wouldn’t have even gotten anything without them giving him the original limb freely, and in that screaming nanosecond, he would never have been able to lock all three down alone anyways. Two Primeval templates in the hands of his two strongest friends. The Tide had fed all of them, and Noah found that outcome...deeply Osmontian.
He let go of the fusion.

The Confluence released as his grades settled back down a rank, Ruination’s strings reweaving into the circlet upon his brow as THE Infiniverse stepped lightly out of his chest and appeared beside him, her composed eyes immediately turning inward, no doubt inspecting the new Primeval tenant anchored in her Master’s core! Noah rolled his shoulders as the quiet weight of one True Lifeform settled back over him, reserves at 403,000+, every facet at Straif or above, and a cluster of apex root-cells slowly turning in his deepest sea!
He was about to put his full focus on the cells inside him when...
"Aba."
Seo-yeon’s voice cut across the golden sands, and it was frowning.

Noah turned. His daughter still sat upon the throne’s handle once more, but her eyes were open now, her small brows drawn together, mirrored light flickering unevenly off her shoulders as she stared out into the storming dark.

"Aba, I can finally sense something. The heaviness went away for a moment when all that light happened, and now I can feel them clearly, but..."Her frown deepened as she shook her small head."It does not make sense."
Noah crossed the sands to her in an instant, kneeling to her height as his voice came level.
"What do you feel?"

"Two clusters."Seo-yeon’s hands rose, and she pointed in two entirely different directions across the dark geography, her fingers trembling faintly with the strain of holding both threads at once. "Two clusters of pained, dying Causes. They hurt, Aba. They hurt so much, like Chernobyl hurt, but there are so potent, and they are in different directions, and..."Her wide eyes lifted to her father’s face.
"Both of them are coming towards us. Towards here. They are not wandering. They are coming...?"
Noah’s gaze turned heavy at these words!

The Confluence released as his grades settled back down a rank, Ruination’s strings reweaving into the circlet upon his brow as THE Infiniverse stepped lightly out of his chest and appeared beside him, her composed eyes immediately turning inward, no doubt inspecting the new Primeval tenant anchored in her Master’s core!

Noah rolled his shoulders as the quiet weight of one True Lifeform settled back over him, reserves at 403,000+, every facet at Straif or above, and a cluster of apex root-cells slowly turning in his deepest sea!
He was about to put his full focus on the cells inside him when...
"Aba."
Seo-yeon’s voice cut across the golden sands, and it was frowning.
Noah turned.

His daughter still sat upon the throne’s handle once more, but her eyes were open now, her small brows drawn together, mirrored light flickering unevenly off her shoulders as she stared out into the storming dark.
"Aba, I can finally sense something.
The heaviness went away for a moment when all that light happened, and now I can feel them clearly, but..."Her frown deepened as she shook her small head."It does not make sense."
Noah crossed the sands to her in an instant, kneeling to her height as his voice came level.
"What do you feel?"
"Two clusters."Seo-yeon’s hands rose, and she pointed in two entirely different directions across the dark geography, her fingers trembling faintly with the strain of holding both threads at once.
"Two clusters of pained, dying Causes.
They hurt, Aba.
They hurt so much, like Chernobyl hurt, but there are so potent, and they are in different directions, and..."Her wide eyes lifted to her father’s face.
"Both of them are coming towards us.
Towards here.
They are not wandering.
They are coming...?"
Noah’s gaze turned heavy at these words!

chapters.title: Chapter 5515: Existential Intermission- Lifeforms
paragraphs: <Existential Intermission>
From the private records of THE Recorder of Wilds, kept across ages, read by no one.
I have been asked, exactly once in all my long wandering, what it is I actually do.

The asker was a mountain that had learned to speak, and I told it the truth. I study lifeforms and how they interact with space and time. That is all. Existence is a wilderness beyond any measuring, and wildernesses are made of the things that live in them, and someone ought to be writing it all down.
So. Today’s entry. Let us take stock of the great varieties, for my own amusement if nothing else.
Beginning with the Gilded Ones, since they insist on being noticed.

A Gilded Lifeform is what happens when a species decides that the self is a resource to be mined. Their entire civilization is built upon the Ego, amplified, refined, layered, and hammered into brilliance. Superbius, Ira, Invidia, Avaritia, all the grand flavors of self, worn like plumage. And I will say this clearly, because my records are honest even when the wilds are not. It actually works. Who would’ve thought?
A Gilded One’s amplified Ego is a genuine architecture of power, and the finest of them burn brighter than nearly anything on Vakochev’s Scales.

Their weakness is the same as their gift. An Ego amplified is an Ego exposed. I once watched a Gilded hierarch of the Superbius line refuse to retreat from a collapsing Dimension because retreating contradicted his self-image, and the Dimension closed over him like water over a dropped coin. All because he was trying his best to stay true to his pride. Magnificent. Foolish. The two are neighbors more often than not. I actually don’t like Gilded Lifeforms too much.
Then the Infinite Lifeforms, the children of boundlessness.

Where the Gilded mine the self, the Infinite mine the endless. Their Sources run on Infinity itself, that wild grammar of never-finishing, and it shapes them into creatures of escalation. An Infinite Lifeform does not ask what am I, it asks what more am I, and the answer never stops arriving. I have watched infant Infinite Ones lose fights they should have won because they were too busy growing mid-battle to bother defending, and I have watched elder Infinite Ones stack themselves upward through sheer accumulated more until Scales stopped describing them.

They too have Egos, and this is where matters become interesting, for an Infinite Ego does not amplify like a Gilded one. It compounds. Quietly. Endlessly. The most dangerous beings I have ever recorded were not the loud ones. They were Infinite Ones who had been compounding in silence for an age as many lean towards the calmer Egos.
Humility, Charity, Kindness...you know the ones.
The Source Lifeforms, next. The deep-rooted.

These draw their existence from THE Primordial Source, the oldest water in the oldest well, and it makes them dense in a way no other variety matches. A Source Lifeform of middling rank can often simply outlast a superior enemy, their weavings anchored so deep into the primordial that unraveling them is like trying to dig up a mountain’s roots with a spoon. They are slow to rise, slow to anger, slow to die. Patience, given a body.
And then...the Trueness.

Trueness is not a species. It is a threshold. Any of the varieties may cross it. A lifeform becomes True when its claim of I am goes seamless, when identity and existence stop being two things, and the moment that happens, the old categories elevate.

A Gilded One who crosses becomes a Gilded True Lifeform, their amplified Ego now welded to a seamless self, and these stand toe to toe with Source True Lifeforms, whose primordial density now carries a will that cannot be pried from it. I have watched exactly such a pair duel across a dead sea for six years, and I still could not tell you which variety is superior, only that the sea did not survive the question.

And apart even these, the True Infinite Lifeforms. Boundlessness made seamless. Compounding without ceiling, claimed without seam. I have recorded many in my ages. Some of them could match a Primeval Lifeform as...there are no absolutes in life.
There are Dimensions filled with entire Civilizations of one Lifeform that could sweep the floor with another.
There are Dimensions filled with monstrous Source True Lifeforms that even Primeval Lifeforms don’t wish to enter due to some ancient animosities.
Which brings me to my own kind.

Primeval Lifeforms are most time the apex across many Dimensions not because we are strongest, though we usually are, but because we are some of the earliest. Our weavings sit beneath the frameworks others climb. Scales, Tongues, Egos, all of it was built atop ground we were already standing on. This grants tremendous advantage and, I have come to believe, a tremendous laziness. My kind watches. Hoards. Grazes on Dimensions like fat cattle on endless grass. Very few of us are ever asked a hard question.
What is our purpose? To steer causes? To fight in major wars? Why...are we here?
Alas. Forget about any Existential Crises.
Then, we continue on with the ones that fit nowhere. My favorite entries in the Dimension of Existence I am currently visiting.

The Steeds. Living Observable Existences, bred as beasts by hands that predate my records, carrying First Causes the way other creatures carry hearts. No category holds them. They are Observable Existences that walk, and those here are dying, and that is a separate entry I have not yet had the stomach to finish.
But...this is one Dimension. There are many Dimensions as are there no Steeds that are not cursed? That move grandly even now?
There are THE Descendants of Those Who Remain, those whose blood is mixed with pure wonder as these fuckers...man oh man. Some are weak, some are powerful. But even the weak ones could do wonders.

And there are more. Oh, more. I have glimpsed things in the far folds that I have no shelf for. A lifeform that existed only as a debt passed between other lifeforms. A herd that was a single memory wearing ten thousand bodies. Something at the bottom of a drowned Dimension that I am fairly certain was a question, alive, and waiting to be asked. The Sealed One...eh, something that could be considered a big deal, and also not a big deal. It is all...relative.
There are a countless number of unique beings, scattered across Existence and its endless Dimensions. That is the true census, and it humbles every category I have ever drawn.
Existence is far too vast. Those within it are abundant beyond any recording.
Which is, of course, precisely why one records.

chapters.title: Chapter 5516: Marrow!
paragraphs: Two dying Causes, coming towards them!

Noah’s expression was heavy as his mind turned through the possibilities. Why would this be happening? One possibility related to Ormarr, the Serpent had promised that they were coming. But the other...he couldn’t say for sure. Two clusters, two directions, both converging on their exact location as if the golden island had become a lodestone!
And he couldn’t even think about this in his usual terms of welcome Adversity, because this might be the type of adversity that was apocalyptic.

He was powerful. Every facet at Straif, an Intent at Ngetal, a Pantheon with absolute rulings! But he was not invincible, and the gap between those two words was where entire existences went to die. So he had to plan ahead thoroughly, and planning began with information.
He thought for a moment, and then knelt back down to his daughter’s height.
"Seo-yeon. When you think about those two dying Causes coming over...how do they make you feel?"
Seo-yeon’s small face scrunched up as she closed her eyes and reached back into the threads, her hands slowly rising to hover over her own chest as she felt them out.

"The first one..." Her voice went small. "The first one feels bad, Aba. It hurts, but it’s a mean hurt. Like it’s been hurting so long that it turned into hating. It feels heavy and cruel and, and like it wants everything else to hurt too. Like a king who is angry at everyone."She shivered!
"There are many little dying songs in that cluster, but they’re all chained to one big mean one."
Hatred and despotic emotions. A cluster of dying Causes chained to a cruel center! Noah’s eyes narrowed.
"And the second?"

"The second one is..." Seo-yeon’s brows unfurrowed, and her voice turned confused, almost wondering. "The second one hurts just as much. Maybe more! It’s so old and so tired, Aba. But it doesn’t feel mean at all. It feels like..."
She opened her eyes and looked up at her father with genuine puzzlement. "It feels like hope? It’s dying and it’s hurting and it’s rushing here so fast, and the whole time it feels...hopeful."
Hope?
Why would a cursed, dying thing be surging towards them with hope?!

Noah’s brows frowned deeply as a suspicion stirred! His gaze turned briefly inward, toward the fifth Letter newly carved into his backbone, and he questioned it directly. Had PROTAGONIST done something crazy again already?

He’d had to turn off the capabilities of the Protagonist once before, when it was simply doing too much, bending circumstances, summoning conveniences, dragging narrative weight toward him like a gravity well of plot! And now that he had transcribed it into a Letter of his very Tongue...was it already so effective that cursed things were being pulled across a Dimension towards him?
He sighed.
Well. If the Letter was going to act like this, then he would at least use it properly. Information first!

His gaze rose to THE Creature and Anaximander, who were drifting over towards the golden island, one trailing white-gold through his obsidian flames, the other still rubbing his temples, and Noah utilized the Letter of THE PROTAGONIST upon them.
|THE Protagonist’s Omniscient Regard has activated. Character Sheets are being compiled for the beings within your gaze.|

|Character Sheet: THE Creature, THE Great Ruler.Designation: Existence. True Lifeform, Intent transforming to Ananke, mid-digestion. Disposition toward you: genuine friendship.Danger to you: none by will, immense by association. Motivations: To rule, to bear what must be borne, to guard his bonds, and, newly formed, to understand the inherited thing that watches. Notable thread: a deep grief regarding a brutalized other half, carried since before THE Wyld, unhealed and unspoken. Notable thread: THE Burden he carries is older than his memory of receiving it, and its previous bearer is ?????. Notable thread: potential inheritor or Descendant. Notable thread: something is aware of this Regard, and is looking back. More information on Records may be possible...|

|Character Sheet: Anaximander, THE Explorer. Designation: ?????.Scale: inapplicable. Authority: none. Threat assessment: he is exactly as dangerous as he believes he needs to be. Disposition toward you: genuine friendship, wholly without agenda. Motivations: to know. Simply, bottomlessly, to know. Notable thread: his self-declared commandments number seven, of which you have witnessed two. Notable thread: his Undefined Life Line does not merely lack definition. Something appears to have erased it. More information on Records may be possible...|
Prompts of majesty and wonder bloomed.

Noah looked at the two beings drifting toward him with open wonder as the Sheets settled through his mind! Something that looked back at his Regard! Commandments numbering seven! A Life Line not undefined but erased! Every answer his new capability delivered arrived carrying three fresh questions on its back, and these were his friends, beings whose favor toward him was written in absolute terms.
Now, if he could see the weavings of his enemies just like this...

It would be knowledge. Information! And information was the key for many, many things. Battles were won before they began by those who knew their opponent’s motivations, their fears, their desires, their price.

"Osmont." THE Creature landed upon the golden sands, his changed flames settling, and his flat gaze studied Noah with something adjacent to curiosity as the tail behind him buzzed. "How....did you do that, exactly?"
Anaximander landed beside him, still wincing, and pointed at his own temple.
Noah only smiled as he shook his head!
"Just a little trick." He turned toward the throne. "But we do have to get going, as it seems we may have company soon. Let’s pack up and go."

He said these words as the vibrant gold platform buzzed beneath all of them, dream-sands humming with readiness as the forge folded itself away and the island prepared to move again! Anaximander sighed as he glanced back at the colossal pale limb of the Primeval One still floating in the storm-torn sky, the foot that had started this entire chain of events, and waved a hand at it.
"I’ll have my hands full analyzing this cerebral cortex alone. Truly, it argues with me when I read it."He grinned over at Noah. "As thanks, I think you can freely keep that limb."
Anaximander said such words casually, gifting away a treasure that a Cenozoic being had bled for.

And Noah did not stand on ceremony! His Intent erupted out like a tyrannical blue sea, prismatic cerulean tides wrapping around the colossal limb as he dragged the entire thing across the sky and folded it inside THE Infiniverse, an apex corpse-piece settling into his home’s deep storage beside farms and forges and feasting halls.
His mind was already running through its uses. But for now...
For now, there was a choice to make.

They would not sit still. And they would not flee, either! He turned his gaze out across the storming dark, toward the direction of the second cluster, and decided. They would go towards the dying Cause that seemed to be filled with hope!

The hateful cluster was many Causes chained to one despotic center. But the hopeful one was rushing towards them with the feeling of hope, and hope was not the emotion of an enemy! Whatever it was, it likely wanted something from him rather than of him. If both clusters were converging on his position regardless, then the only real choice was which meeting he controlled. He would meet hope first, learn everything it knew, and face hatred afterwards with that knowledge in hand.
Information first. Always information first!
"We move," Noah declared as he rose onto the throne, Seo-yeon scooping herself onto its handle as Emotive bounced up beside him and THE Infiniverse took her place at the island’s edge!

Thereafter, THE Creature and Anaximander landed fully upon the platform, the titan’s white-gold-threaded flames folding calm as the scholar plopped down cross-legged near the throne, and the vibrant golden island of dream-sand buzzed with gathering power beneath all of them...
And shot out towards a certain direction!

chapters.title: Chapter 5517: Existence and Anomalies! I
paragraphs: The golden island tore across the storming dark of THE Krazhor-Nul, and upon it, THE Creature spoke calmly.
"What are we running from, and what are we running to?"
Noah’s mouth curved slightly from his throne as he answered plainly.

"We are likely running away from one of those monstrous Cursed Steeds we learned about. It feels hateful and despotic. And we...are running towards another Cursed Steed! This one feels a bit...hopeful."
He said such words easily, and they were enough to make Anaximander smile and THE Creature frown!
For both of them instantly understood that something perilous was unfolding. Running from one dying Steed directly into another was not a plan any sane being would call safe.
Anaximander stroked his chin and spoke with calm honesty.

"I would offer to simply carry everyone away, you know." His eyes drifted across the island, over Emotive and Seo-yeon and THE Infiniverse, and finally settled on Noah, and he winced slightly. "But when I think about moving all of you, especially you, Osmont...your weight feels unfathomably heavy. It is not a matter of strength, I don’t carry things with strength. It is that whatever I carry comes with me, and what you are carrying would make traversal impossible. I would take a step and arrive nowhere at all."
Noah calmly listened, and nodded without any surprise.

He knew exactly what the scholar was sensing. He carried THE Infiniverse with him, and within her, countless deciillions of lives, thousands of realms, relocated sanctuaries, armories, farms, and now the limb of a Primeval One! Everything he had...was far too heavy. He was not a traveler anymore. He was an Existential nation that walked!
"It’s okay,"Noah said simply. "It’s Adversity. We simply need to get through it."
The island flew on, and Noah’s gaze slid over to the cross-legged scholar with genuine curiosity.
"Where have you been, by the way? For months to have passed?"
"Ah..."Anaximander brightened immediately.

"After we parted, I took a step to be far away. As far as I could manage, even, perhaps, toward those like me, if such things exist. And I appeared inside a Dimension filled with...well, they call themselves Superpowered Lifeforms."

"An entire society of extremely terrifying beings!"Anaximander nodded seriously. "They protect a cluster of Observable Existences within a vast Dimension from invasions and infiltrations, constantly, generation after generation, because their Dimension produces some type of Panacea that True Lifeforms across existence want badly. That place was...unique. Truly unique! I became friends with the protectors there. One of them, a Superpowered True Lifeform who could exert the weight of three Observable Existences with his body alone, mistakenly thought I was one of them, because I didn’t have any inherent authority either."He laughed at the memory.
Noah’s brows rose as he listened! A society of authority-less True Lifeforms guarding a treasure-Dimension? Existence truly was vast.

"But he said something curious,"Anaximander continued. "He mentioned how across Existence, different Dimensions exist as some Dimensions hold natural treasures that invite the envy of others. Panaceas. Unique essenses. Rare weavings that form nowhere else! His Dimension was one of them, and so they had fought countless conflicts across the ages, Gilded True Lifeforms and Infinite True Lifeforms arriving in waves, wanting what they protected."He gestured loosely at the storming skies around them.

"It rather reframes this place, doesn’t it? A Dimension is not merely a location. It is a body with organs worth stealing. I left a little after that, traveled around a bit, saw some truly strange corners, and then I went back to them, because their Dimension was the largest and most complex one I had found. I was there when THE Creature called me."He sighed then, and something troubled crossed his open face. "I may actually need to go back soon..."
He seemed weighed by something as he said it, a rare shadow on the perpetually delighted scholar!
But he shook his head and continued. "But the other Dimensions I saw are..."
And as Noah listened to Anaximander alongside the others with rapt attention...inside of his own Existence, many things were happening.

The cluster of Primeval Totipotent Cells anchored at the core of his Source had been drinking! Heavy inputs of himself flooded into them continuously, his Intent, his Osmontian Source Infinity, his Trueness, and somewhere in that deep blue sea, the drinking had crossed a threshold, for the cells seemed to have decided on exactly what to become.
They had read him. And his own Intent and identity had answered.

For what was THE Quintessential Osmontian, at his very root? A being who produced himself. Osmontian Biomass, generated endlessly, spent endlessly! And so his identity pressed its decision into the totipotent lattices, and the cells, capable of becoming anything,chose to become the thing that makes!
They moved!

The white-gold cluster dissolved from its anchoring and spread through him, flowing out of his Source’s deep sea and into his body, into his frame, into his bones! They poured through his skeleton like luminous rivers finding their channels, sinking into femur and spine and rib and skull, into the trabecular hollows where the oldest work of any body is done, and there they took form, cell by cathedral-cell, weaving themselves into the spongy architecture of his skeleton as they became...
Bone marrow!

Stellar blue-gold marrow bloomed through every bone of his existence, hematopoietic architecture rewritten at the Primeval grade, stem-lattices of white-gold threading through his skeletal core as the totipotent cells differentiated into an endless self-renewing engine, and the moment it finished anchoring...
Noah felt tremendous pain!

The marrow ignited! Cells began to be produced from it, the first generation of something entirely new, and they flowed outwards from his bones into the rest of his body, into blood and weaving and Source, and every single one of them burned going out, his whole frame lit from the inside by the agony of an existence being repopulated.
And alongside the pain...
BOOM!
A booming beat of his heart!

An utterly wild and fiendish aura erupted from Noah’s seated figure, ancient past all framing, and Anaximander stopped talking mid-sentance! THE Creature’s head turned sharply. Emotive and THE Infiniverse and even Seo-yeon all looked towards him at once, for the aura radiating off THE True Human Emperor in this moment did not feel like the composed weight of a crowned Osmontian.
It felt ancient. It felt...ever so slighty Primeval! Just tiny slivers of it!

|The Primeval Totipotent Cell Source has completed its differentiation.Designation: THE Primeval Osmontian Marrow.It is catalogued as a True Primeval Appendage of THE Osmontian, the first of its kind, an appendage grown not from your Trueness alone but from the fusion of your identity with apex Primeval root-matter.|

|Its function: it is a bone marrow, elevated terrifyingly. Seated through your entire skeleton, it now performs the deepest work of your body at the Primeval grade,producing THE Primeval Osmontian Cells,living cells carrying traces of Primeval weavings mixed inseparably with your Osmontian weavings. These cells proliferate across all parts of your existence. Your blood. Your flesh. Your Source. Your Intent’s expressions. Your very weavings! Everything you are will, over time, come to be built from cells that are part Primeval, and the fiendish ancientness you are currently radiating is the first generation announcing itself.|

|The rate of production of THE Primeval Osmontian Cells is fixed. However. It can be accelerated under one condition: whenever you are wounded by a malicious foreign authority. And should your existence be injured enough that you begin to bleed, the following will occur. You will continue to bleed for a few seconds, deliberately, as the marrow reads the wound. Production will accelerate.And you will enter THE Primeval Osmontian Berserker state,a battle-state in which your existence is momentarily elevated the more injured you become. Production, accelerated. Healing, accelerated. Power, Intent, Output, all of it, elevated in proportion to your wounds.|

Noah felt the slow production beginning within him, the glorious Cells drifting out from his blue-gold marrow in steady generations, each one settling into his existence like a brick into a wall being quietly rebuilt from something older and grander! And as they proliferated...more prompts bloomed!

|A further consequence, and a considerable one. As THE Primeval Osmontian Cells proliferate and empower all facets of your existence, the intrinsic quality of every component rises, and elevation costs are gradually reducing across the board. Your Foundations. Your Osmontian Source Infinity. Your Volume, Output, and Trueness. All of them will grow cheaper to elevate as your cellular base grows more Primeval. And for the summit currently visible: elevation ofTHE Ananke Intent of THE Quintessential Osmontian to A-Rank, Idho, currently stands at 15,000,000 Osmontian Biomass. The Cells will bring that number down, Master. Slowly.|
Fifteen million!

Noah gazed at these prompts, at the summit priced and the road toward it quietly discounting itself with every Cell his marrow breathed out, and silently, steadily, the fiendish aura of ancientness became more and more prevalent across his existence, settling into his body, his gaze, his presense, an old wildness taking up permanent residence beneath the composed surface of THE True Human Emperor.
And through it all, he simply continued listening to Anaximander, the golden island streaking through the storm as all of them discussed many things!

chapters.title: Chapter 5518: Existence and Anomalies! II
paragraphs: The golden island streaked across the storming dark, and upon it, Anaximander had gone quiet for a long moment.
Noah had just finished telling him more about the fate of their Observable Existence, the door they had all come from...gone. Taken into the hands of THE Sealed One.
The scholar exhaled slow. He shook his head, and then, being Anaximander, curiosity reasserted itself.

"Ashes to ashes, dust to dust. I am glad you were able to save many. And I haven’t heard much about THE Sealed One in my travels. But I have heard extensively about two others, and if we are to speak of things worth fearing across Dimensions, these two came up at every campfire, in every society, in every tongue.THE Dimensional Eater. And Vakochev."
Noah’s brows rose.

Anaximander leaned forward. "There exists a slime. A small, harmless-looking slime. It appears within unsuspecting Dimensions without warning, without wake, without any door anyone can find, and it simply...sits there. Wobbling. Doing nothing! And here is the terrible weavings every civilization has learned across the ages. If that slime survives within a Dimension for longer than a few days, that Dimension will likely be marked for death. And then, at some hour no one can predict, the whole of it, the space, the weavings, the lifeforms, the very dimensional laws, will be devoured."

"The entire Dimension! Which is why, and I found this both tragic and extremely funny, slimes are hunted across nearly every established Dimension in existence. All slimes! Innocent ones, ordinary ones, little wobbling nothings that couldn’t devour a meal, exterminated on sight, because no lifeform who knows the story is willing to take the chance that the harmless one in front of them is THE one." He spread his hands.

"An entire species made refugee by a single member’s reputation. The Superpowered folk had standing extermination patrols. I watched a powerful protector burn a puddle of slime the size of a teacup with enough power to crack half an Observable Existence, and when I asked him if that seemed excessive, he looked at me like I was the mad one."

"And Vakochev," Anaximander continued, his voice settling into genuine scholarly respect, "is another matter entirely. From everything I gathered, he is one of the more powerful beings of this Era. Not a myth, not an ancient, a living power, current and active! And his Scales of Existence are not merely a ladder someone wrote down. They are a framework, a living structure covering many Observable Existences and Dimensions, vast areas of THE Infinite Carcosa, great stretches of THE Source Lands. Uncountable lifeforms are born, climb, and die entirely inside his architecture without ever learning a single other way to grow." He raised one finger.

"Even some weaker True Lifeforms, beings who have formed their own Egoic Intent, who have crossed onto their own path and owe the Scales nothing...paradoxically continue to follow the structure of his Scales anyway. His framework remains paramount even after Trueness, for those who want it."
Noah’s eyes narrowed slightly at that!
And then, from the edge of the golden sands, the silent Creature spoke up.
"Existence is vast."
His flat voice settled over the island, and everyone turned.

"We are young by comparison. All of us. Histories have been unfolding long before us, and we are walking across their aftermaths and calling it exploration."His white-gold-threaded flames stirred slowly around his frame.

"Apart from THE Sealed One...those for us to look out for are the Lineages connected to Those Who Remain. The Descendants of Those Who Remain. Those who are part of their Lineages...believe Existence is theirs. Not as ambition. As inheritance."
Noah listened closely, for THE Creature’s path was Existence itself!

"We are in a Dimension that has Cursed Descendants. Broken ones. Dying ones. But there are many more Dimensions of normal Descendants, unbroken lineages, and they all hold unique and terrifying capabilities exceeding any True Lifeform."His flat gaze moved across all of them, unhurried.

"And if I can give any advice...never take power as Absolute. The rankings you know, Infinite, Source, Gilded, True, they are catalogues, not walls. You might meet lifeforms who don’t fit in any of them, and they might have power exceeding all of them."
Then, dryly, without any change in his tone at all...
"I mean, look at Osmont here. I envision him to be one of those anomalous Existences. Alongside you, Anaximander."
Noah and Anaximander both shook their heads at these words immediately.
"I am...just human, nothing more..." Noah said.
"And I am a very normal scholar, an explorer..."Anaximander added, nodding seriously!
"Hm," said THE Creature.
Noah leaned back upon his throne as the conversation washed around him, thinking about everything that had been said.

A slime that ate Dimensions. A framework so grand the free still climbed it! Lineages who believed Existence was inherited property, and unbroken Descendants scattered across Dimensions with capabilities exceeding Trueness itself. Existence truly was vast and filled with far too many things, far too many powers, far too many histories still unfolding beneath every step they took!
But he...would move steadily on his own path.

His own way. His own Tongue, his own Scales! His Second Scale was being enacted even now, its Foundations all standing at Straif and above, and it almost seemed ready for the next stage, some threshold he could feel approaching. And beyond that, his curiosity burned in specific directions! His Causes. His Infinite Cause, seated in himself and THE Infiniverse and grown grander with her every devoured mouthful of this Dimension!
And the Steeds of Those Who Remain, dying carriers of First Causes, one of them rushing toward him at this very moment with hope in its failing weavings.
What gains could potentially be made there? What did a being who could seat Causes owe to creatures whose Causes were dying?
The golden island tore onward toward the hopeful dying thing, and THE True Human Emperor smiled slightly upon his throne! After a stretch of comfortable quiet, Noah began to speak again.
His voice was calm.

"I wonder sometimes how far we should go on those we consider our enemies."His gaze rested on the raging horizon. "THE Gilded Ones. Much of those who affected our Lower Observable Existence are either dead, or taken by THE Sealed One. So what remains of that grudge? Will we seek and kill all Gilded Ones, since we don’t like their nature? Those who are True? The Primeval Ones standing behind them?"His fingers drummed once on the throne’s armrest.
"When would the killing be enough? Or does one look at a certain point and say...it’s enough there? When is animosity enough, and when do you let go?"
No one interrupted. Even Emotive was still.

"Because as much as I love conflict, as a father, I start to think of all the countless who had nothing to do with the wars I waged with others...but I eradicated them all. And I have eradicated many." The words came flat and unflinching, a ledger read aloud.

"Entire hierarchies. Entire Civilizations. Beings who were simply born into the wrong banner in the wrong era, standing in formations they never chose, and I unmade them alongside their masters without slowing down to sort one from the other."
He let that sit, and then continued.

"I am currently distinguished as...THE True Human Emperor. And I have been thinking. I have been thinking about what I will do past THE Sealed One, and the Gilded and Infinite that he uses. About all those I have taken the lives of. I have been thinking some fairly crazy and grand thoughts, of how if I truly want to live by my identity, as THE True Human Emperor...should my gaze begin looking out across all of existence, to bring all those I deem Humans...under my fold?"

"Every scattered branch of humanity across every Dimension and Observable Existence. Every people with that brief, burning, striving pattern I call Human, gathered beneath one crown."His eyes gleamed with something that was neither warmth nor coldness but both braided together.

"Would this be me enacting conquest, as I have done before? Or salvation? I do know it will empower me. Every Human under my fold feeds the identity, and the identity feeds everything I am. So maybe the question is not about conquest or salvation but moreso...am I selfishly acting with my nature in mind, to do something grand...simply for the sake of my power?"
He exhaled, and his mouth curved wryly.
"Ah, I am talking a lot. I am just wrestling with the idea of what I will do across existence...for the sake of my identity. I don’t think I will sit still."
The silence that followed was brief.
Because THE Creature answered, and his flat voice came down grand!
"Existence is not idle."
His white-gold-threaded flames stirred as his gaze fixed on Noah.

"Existence isn’t something to simply be gawked at while a countless many die...because there are no rulers. I have walked across eras of it. I have seen what fills the spaces where no one governs. Harvests. Hoards. Lineages who believe everything is theirs, feeding on those who cannot answer back."His voice did not rise, and that made it heavier.
"As someone walking the path of Existence, I will tell you now that I seek to be a ruler. An Existential Ruler. A Great Ruler. Like Vakochev. So that I...can stand and declare how things should be."

"If I don’t like how Gilded Ones are, I will change it. If I don’t like how Source Lifeforms are, I will change it! Countless Lifeforms out there struggle and suffer because those who are good...have no capacity to be strong and take care of business. I have an immense dislike to many lifeforms who consider themselves good and pious...while doing nothing as their neighbors die and are oppressed. Goodness without power is a lament. I have heard enough laments."His flat eyes darkened with something old.
"I wish to be in a position of power to ensure what happened to me doesn’t happen to anyone else. No half of anyone, brutalized while the other half watches. Not on any shore of Existence I rule."
Anaximander had gone completely still, listening with the focus of a scholar witnessing something worth recording forever!
"The conquest you mention...seems to be alongside the same lines as what I wish to do. You, Osmont, wish to be a Ruler!" THE Creature said it plainly.

"Vakochev...is too passive. He made Scales based on Adversity. Sure. His Scales were good. They allowed me to get where I am! But that pain, that adversity...let it come to those who seek it. The innocent who simply want to live and die, why should they suffer alongside everyone else? Why should a farmer climb the same bleeding ladder as a conqueror, or be left to rot at its base?"His flames pulsed once!
"No. Vakochev’s Scales are too...general. New Scales are needed. New direction is needed."
And then, for the first time in the entire exchange, something moved through THE Creature’s expression!

"I thought I may have been trying to enact my own vision alone. But it seems that you...have your own vision as well."He nodded once, slow and final. "This is more than okay. You or me...we can see which one of our visions can be painted across Existence!"
Noah’s eyes pulsed with unfathomable brightness as he looked at THE Creature!

Two visions, spoken plainly over golden sands in a cursed Dimension! An Emperor of all Humans, and a Ruler of Existence itself! Not rivals, not yet, perhaps not ever, but two beings who had just discovered that neither of them intended to leave Existence as they found it, and an immense silence settled in this space as the golden island tore onward through the storm, carrying both of their futures toward a dying hope that nobody could say with surety...where it would end up.
