"Even some weaker True Lifeforms, beings who have formed their own Egoic Intent, who have crossed onto their own path and owe the Scales nothing...paradoxically continue to follow the structure of his Scales anyway.
His framework remains paramount even after Trueness, for those who want it."
Noah’s eyes narrowed slightly at that!
And then, from the edge of the golden sands, the silent Creature spoke up.
"Existence is vast."
His flat voice settled over the island, and everyone turned.
"We are young by comparison.
All of us.
Histories have been unfolding long before us, and we are walking across their aftermaths and calling it exploration."His white-gold-threaded flames stirred slowly around his frame.
"Apart from THE Sealed One...those for us to look out for are the Lineages connected to Those Who Remain.
The Descendants of Those Who Remain.
Those who are part of their Lineages...believe Existence is theirs.
Not as ambition.
As inheritance."
Noah listened closely, for THE Creature’s path was Existence itself!
"We are in a Dimension that has Cursed Descendants.
Broken ones.
Dying ones.

But there are many more Dimensions of normal Descendants, unbroken lineages, and they all hold unique and terrifying capabilities exceeding any True Lifeform."His flat gaze moved across all of them, unhurried.
"And if I can give any advice...never take power as Absolute.
The rankings you know, Infinite, Source, Gilded, True, they are catalogues, not walls.
You might meet lifeforms who don’t fit in any of them, and they might have power exceeding all of them."
Then, dryly, without any change in his tone at all...
"I mean, look at Osmont here.
I envision him to be one of those anomalous Existences.
Alongside you, Anaximander."
Noah and Anaximander both shook their heads at these words immediately.
"I am...just human, nothing more..." Noah said.
"And I am a very normal scholar, an explorer..."Anaximander added, nodding seriously!
"Hm," said THE Creature.
Noah leaned back upon his throne as the conversation washed around him, thinking about everything that had been said.
A slime that ate Dimensions.
A framework so grand the free still climbed it!
Lineages who believed Existence was inherited property, and unbroken Descendants scattered across Dimensions with capabilities exceeding Trueness itself.
Existence truly was vast and filled with far too many things, far too many powers, far too many histories still unfolding beneath every step they took!
But he...would move steadily on his own path.
His own way.
His own Tongue, his own Scales!
His Second Scale was being enacted even now, its Foundations all standing at Straif and above, and it almost seemed ready for the next stage, some threshold he could feel approaching.
And beyond that, his curiosity burned in specific directions!
His Causes.
His Infinite Cause, seated in himself and THE Infiniverse and grown grander with her every devoured mouthful of this Dimension!
And the Steeds of Those Who Remain, dying carriers of First Causes, one of them rushing toward him at this very moment with hope in its failing weavings.
What gains could potentially be made there?
What did a being who could seat Causes owe to creatures whose Causes were dying?
The golden island tore onward toward the hopeful dying thing, and THE True Human Emperor smiled slightly upon his throne!
After a stretch of comfortable quiet, Noah began to speak again.
His voice was calm.
"I wonder sometimes how far we should go on those we consider our enemies."His gaze rested on the raging horizon.
"THE Gilded Ones.
Much of those who affected our Lower Observable Existence are either dead, or taken by THE Sealed One.
So what remains of that grudge?
Will we seek and kill all Gilded Ones, since we don’t like their nature?
Those who are True?
The Primeval Ones standing behind them?"His fingers drummed once on the throne’s armrest.
"When would the killing be enough?
Or does one look at a certain point and say...it’s enough there?
When is animosity enough, and when do you let go?"
No one interrupted.
Even Emotive was still.
"Because as much as I love conflict, as a father, I start to think of all the countless who had nothing to do with the wars I waged with others...but I eradicated them all.
And I have eradicated many." The words came flat and unflinching, a ledger read aloud.
"Entire hierarchies.
Entire Civilizations.

Beings who were simply born into the wrong banner in the wrong era, standing in formations they never chose, and I unmade them alongside their masters without slowing down to sort one from the other."
He let that sit, and then continued.
"I am currently distinguished as...THE True Human Emperor.
And I have been thinking.
I have been thinking about what I will do past THE Sealed One, and the Gilded and Infinite that he uses.
About all those I have taken the lives of.

I have been thinking some fairly crazy and grand thoughts, of how if I truly want to live by my identity, as THE True Human Emperor...should my gaze begin looking out across all of existence, to bring all those I deem Humans...under my fold?"
"Every scattered branch of humanity across every Dimension and Observable Existence.
Every people with that brief, burning, striving pattern I call Human, gathered beneath one crown."His eyes gleamed with something that was neither warmth nor coldness but both braided together.
"Would this be me enacting conquest, as I have done before?
Or salvation?
I do know it will empower me.
Every Human under my fold feeds the identity, and the identity feeds everything I am.
So maybe the question is not about conquest or salvation but moreso...am I selfishly acting with my nature in mind, to do something grand...simply for the sake of my power?"
He exhaled, and his mouth curved wryly.
"Ah, I am talking a lot.
I am just wrestling with the idea of what I will do across existence...for the sake of my identity.
I don’t think I will sit still."
The silence that followed was brief.
Because THE Creature answered, and his flat voice came down grand!
"Existence is not idle."
His white-gold-threaded flames stirred as his gaze fixed on Noah.
"Existence isn’t something to simply be gawked at while a countless many die...because there are no rulers.
I have walked across eras of it.
I have seen what fills the spaces where no one governs.
Harvests.
Hoards.
Lineages who believe everything is theirs, feeding on those who cannot answer back."His voice did not rise, and that made it heavier.
"As someone walking the path of Existence, I will tell you now that I seek to be a ruler.
An Existential Ruler.
A Great Ruler.
Like Vakochev.
So that I...can stand and declare how things should be."
"If I don’t like how Gilded Ones are, I will change it.
If I don’t like how Source Lifeforms are, I will change it!
Countless Lifeforms out there struggle and suffer because those who are good...have no capacity to be strong and take care of business.
I have an immense dislike to many lifeforms who consider themselves good and pious...while doing nothing as their neighbors die and are oppressed.
Goodness without power is a lament.
I have heard enough laments."His flat eyes darkened with something old.
"I wish to be in a position of power to ensure what happened to me doesn’t happen to anyone else.
No half of anyone, brutalized while the other half watches.
Not on any shore of Existence I rule."
Anaximander had gone completely still, listening with the focus of a scholar witnessing something worth recording forever!
"The conquest you mention...seems to be alongside the same lines as what I wish to do.
You, Osmont, wish to be a Ruler!" THE Creature said it plainly.
"Vakochev...is too passive.
He made Scales based on Adversity.
Sure.
His Scales were good.
They allowed me to get where I am!
But that pain, that adversity...let it come to those who seek it.
The innocent who simply want to live and die, why should they suffer alongside everyone else?
Why should a farmer climb the same bleeding ladder as a conqueror, or be left to rot at its base?"His flames pulsed once!
"No.
Vakochev’s Scales are too...general.
New Scales are needed.
New direction is needed."
And then, for the first time in the entire exchange, something moved through THE Creature’s expression!
"I thought I may have been trying to enact my own vision alone.
But it seems that you...have your own vision as well."He nodded once, slow and final.
"This is more than okay.
You or me...we can see which one of our visions can be painted across Existence!"
Noah’s eyes pulsed with unfathomable brightness as he looked at THE Creature!
Two visions, spoken plainly over golden sands in a cursed Dimension!
An Emperor of all Humans, and a Ruler of Existence itself!

Not rivals, not yet, perhaps not ever, but two beings who had just discovered that neither of them intended to leave Existence as they found it, and an immense silence settled in this space as the golden island tore onward through the storm, carrying both of their futures toward a dying hope that nobody could say with surety...where it would end up.

chapters.title: Chapter 5519: No Chance!
paragraphs: To lead. To rule!

Noah was already a leader and ruler, he already held the distinction of THE True Human Emperor as for him, it came naturally. His people, his crown, his fold, all of it had grown out of him the way branches grow from a trunk.
But now, he thought of the distinction of a Great Ruler.

Could he truly see himself returning to glorious Conquest and expanding his rule across...THE Source Lands? THE Infinite Carcosa? And even across Dimensions of Existence themselves?! Would this be his quickest route to power, every Human gathered beneath his identity feeding the Letter that fed everything else?
He was thinking such grand thoughts when...
HUUM!
"Aba, the hateful cause is accelerating towards us!"

Seo-yeon's warning cut across the golden sands, and it came as a shock! For they had been moving at tremendous speeds in another direction entirely, streaking toward the hopeful dying Cause, and yet what she considered the hateful dying cluster was the one reaching them first!

Noah's will surged as the golden platform accelerated further, his Ananke Intent flooding across every grain of dream-sand as the entire island took on a deep blue hue, a comet of gold and cerulean tearing through the storming dark of THE Krazhor-Nul.
Light years folded beneath them. The Ego of Humilitas wrapped them tighter than it ever had!
And it did not matter.
For behind them, pressing through the storm like the fingers of a closing hand, he and all the others could now sense a terrifying set of auras! Many auras! Heavy past framing, and gaining!
Noah sighed once.
Then he patted Seo-yeon gently on the head. "You need to go back inside for now."
His daughter looked up at him, and she did not argue, for she could feel what was coming better than anyone! She nodded as mirrored light gathered around her small frame. "Aba... be careful."
She folded away into THE Infiniverse!

Noah's gaze turned to Emotive next, and he nodded once. Emotive pouted enormously, opened her mouth to protest, read his eyes, closed her mouth, and retreated into THE Infiniverse with her arms crossed the entire way down!
And in the next moment...existence congealed.

The storm around them thickened like cooling tar as the golden island's tremendous speed began bleeding away for no reason Noah's senses could name, space itself growing dense, resistant, wrong! He poured more Intent into their passage. The island surged. And then the concept of space seemingly became nullified entirely, for no matter how much further Noah pushed, no matter how many light years his will declared crossed...he found they were in the same space!
The horizon refused to approach. The distance refused to close! They flew, and they arrived nowhere, held inside a single stretch of storm like an insect in a trap.

|An extremely potent Ananke Intent has pervaded the surroundings. Its weavings mark it as belonging to a Source True Lifeform, and its declaration is simple: this space does not release what stands within it.|
At these words, the faces of Noah, THE Creature, Anaximander, and THE Infiniverse all hardened as they gazed back!
And they saw...a group of utterly terrifying beings.

The storm behind them had filled with True Lifeforms! More than twenty of them spread in loose formation across the dark sky, over half pressing down with the weight of THE Cenozoic Scale, antlered and flamed and stone-hided apex existences whose idle comfort had sharpened into readiness! Among them coiled Ormarr Grimtunge, whole and massive, his crimson eyes gleaming with long-awaited delight.
Beside him flew a woman in red robes whose cold face and crimson gaze emanated nothing, absolutely nothing, except the promise of murder!
And behind them all...was a monstrous, cursed thing.
Noah's eyes fixed upon it, and even his composed heart pressed heavier in his chest!

It was colossal beyond the entire party combined, a mountainous quadruped whose gray hide had gone the color of forgotten things, its titanic frame furrowed with fissures through which its failing First Cause guttered.

Chains of screaming crimson metal wrapped its throat. Its breath dragged like landslides! And its eyes...its eyes were vast pools of dying light filled with pain and hate and coldness all at once, the gaze of something that had been walking in agony for so long that agony had become its only remaining language, and beneath all of it, Noah could feel its dying Causes, and they were so heavy.
So heavy!
And then its ambient field touched them.
The Steed of Oblivion's suppression rolled across the trapped island like a tide of gray silence, and for the first time in her existence, THE Infiniverse made a sound of pain!

It felt like...Pantheon compression! Noah felt his own Pantheon strain against his backbone as its realms refused to unfurl, thousands of skies pressing inward as if a hand had closed around his home, and the ambient Biomass tick that had fed him since their hatching simply...stopped! Within THE Infiniverse, nested Observable Existences groaned as her weavings cramped, and Ruination's prompts arrived colder than they had ever been.

|The Steed's ambient field is an architecture of dimensional sovereignty, designed by Those Who Remain to keep their mounts paramount above all other dimensional laws. Within its range, THE Quintessential Pantheon of THE Infiniverse cannot fully unfurl. THE Quintessential Confluence will function at reduced grades. The Absolute Dimensional Ruling holds for now, but the field is not attacking it. It is slowly denying it the right to exist. Everyone inside THE Infiniverse is safe at this moment. That statement has a time limit, and I do not yet know its length.|
The coldest prompts she had ever delivered!
And through the gray pressure, the woman in red spoke. Exactly once. Her voice was quiet, toneless, and it landed across the trapped space like a blade being drawn from its sheath in a silent room.
"Kneel, and most of you will be kept alive."

That was all. No threat performed, no power flared! Just a fact, stated by something shaped for killing, and the twenty True Lifeforms behind her settled into formation as though the outcome had already been filed!
And beside her, Ormarr Grimtunge finally had his moment!

The great Serpent uncoiled forward through the storm, rising high above the trapped golden island with his reassembled bulk gleaming, and his laughter rolled out rich and vindicated, a follower savoring the taste of overwhelming force at his back.

"Hey now, look at this! Two of you have actually gathered back together!" His crimson eyes swept from Noah to THE Creature, drinking in their hardened faces like fine wine. "Haha, existence is being truly kind today! The seated fucker and the grave-walker, wrapped up in one net! Do you know what I had to endure because of you two? Do you know what it is to be a length of yourself short in front of your betters?!" His coils flexed as his smile stretched wide and brutal!
"No matter. No matter at all! It seems like...it is the end of the road for you all!"
This vindictive fucker began to look at them with glee.
And in Noah's eyes, at this exact moment...time seemingly stopped.
He stretched a moment of an instant into infinity!

His perception expanded through the frozen frame, the Serpent's gloating suspended mid-syllable, the blade in red hanging motionless, the Steed's guttering Causes flickering in place, and within that endless instant, THE True Human Emperor went to work! For a battle against this was not a battle.
THE Protagonist's Omniscient Regard activated!
His gaze swept across Lissana, across Ormarr, across the host, across the Steed, and many others, and the Character Sheets bloomed!

|Character Sheet: Lissana. Designation: THE Edge That Was Forged. Source True Lifeform. Her Ananke Intent is the declaration currently sealing this space. Danger to you: extreme. In direct combat, she alone exceeds your current fused ceiling. Disposition: no malice, no favor, nothing. You are a task. Motivations: she was forged, literally, her existence refined across a True lifetime. Notable thread: she does not know why twenty were sent by Jarl Erling for this errand, and unexplained orders unsettle the only thing she trusts, her function. Notable thread: her deepest buried thread is a single question she has never been permitted to ask: what she is when there is nothing to kill? Notable thread: her orders are capture, not slaughter. THE Infiniverse is to be taken undamaged, and she has been told nothing about why. She dislikes fighting blind more than she dislikes anything in existence.|

|Character Sheet: Ormarr Grimtunge. True Lifeform. Danger to you: Moderate, and currently irrelevant, as he will not act before Lissana does. Disposition: hatred, humiliation, hunger for redress. Motivations: to restore his standing with Jarl Erling. Notable thread: he was commanded to secrecy. No other Jarl may learn of this errand, and Ormarr believes this secrecy is about his master's pride. He has not asked himself what discovery would be worth hiding. Notable thread: he fears the blade in red far more than he fears you, and he fears one further thing above even her: being blamed if this errand fails. It cannot fail, be has to deliver!|

|Character Sheet: THE Steed of Oblivion. Designation: Ghrimhest, THE Fourth of the Second Brood. A living Observable Existence of the old broods, its First Cause in terminal collapse for ages beyond counting. Danger to you: absolute. There is no chance of victory against it. None. Its ambient sovereignty predates every framework you climb, its dying field grows stronger the longer you stand inside it, and even if all of you fight with everything, together, at your peaks...you cannot win! Its body does not need to strike you. Its existence alone is the strike. Motivations: none remain. Pain has replaced them all. Notable thread: it hates its handlers more than it hates its cargo. Notable thread: beneath the pain, its dying Causes are still listening. For what, it no longer remembers. Notable thread: ?????|

chapters.title: Chapter 5520: Buy Time!
paragraphs: The stretched instant held, and within it, Noah finished his thoughts.

They came for THE Infiniverse! And it was under the command of Jarl Erling as it should relate or Observable Existences and causes as how did he know? Did this fucker Ormarr report back so thoroughly after his death?
But apart from this...
Winning was not possible.

Lissana alone exceeded even his fused ceiling. Twenty True Lifeforms stood behind her with more than half at Cenozoic. And beneath all of them walked a being whose existence was the strike, whose ambient field was slowly denying his home the right to exist. Even all of them together, at their peaks, could not win this.
But he did not need to win this.

Because far across the storming dark, a dying Cause filled with hope was still rushing toward him! If his suspicions about what approached held even half their weight...then what he needed was not victory.
What he needed was time!
And buying time from beings who held every advantage required only one currency. Doubt! He had read their Sheets as he knew many of their details.
So THE True Human Emperor decided, within a frozen instant, to become grander than he was.
'Anaximander. Creature. Let me handle this for now. I am simply buying us time for now as something should be coming to balance the Scales...maybe.'
The mental messages left him as the instant collapsed, and time resumed!

Ormarr's gloating laughter was still rolling across the trapped space. Lissana's declaration still hung like a drawn blade! And Noah, cornered and outweighed beyond everything ...smiled slightly, and let go of every rein inside his marrow!
HUUM!
The aura of THE Primeval Osmontian Marrow erupted from him freely.

The fiendish ancientness he had kept settled beneath his composure poured outward in slow, heavy waves, stellar blue-gold pressure carrying that unmistakable flavor of the apex and the earliest, and it rolled across the formation of True Lifeforms like a scent from a deeper age!
The party's loose formation...tightened.
The storm-antlered one's head snapped up. The three-faced female's gray flames dimmed to embers as her every face turned! The stone hound at the rear stopped looking backward!

And Noah floated forward alone and unhurried! Ahead of THE Creature and Anaximander, out past the edge of the golden sands, drifting into the open storm between his island and the blade in red as if the space between them belonged to him, as if her Ananke Intent sealing the region was a courtesy he was permitting, and he spoke with a lazy, unbothered cadence.
"Lissana."
The blade in red did not move, but her crimson eyes sharpened by a fraction, and behind her, Ormarr's coils actually flinched.
"That is your designation, is it not? A blade, an extremely sharp blade...used by Jarl Erling." Noah's voice carried easily through the suppression field entirely unafraid!
"And Ormarr fucking Grimtunge. Tell me, have you restored your standing with Jarl Erling yet, or is this errand your only chance to suck up? The only chance for you to prove yourself?"
"You...!" Ormarr's crimson eyes flared wide as his grand composure cracked down the middle! "How do you know of..."
"I know a great many things." Noah's smile did not widen.
And within his gaze, silently, THE Protagonist's Omniscient Regard drank.
Every reaction fed it! Every flinch and flare peeled another layer, the Sheets deepening as he got more and more records, as suspicion and alarm loosened the weavings of the beings before him.
His eyes returned to Lissana, and his voice gentled into something almost curious. "Such a gathering. Such expenditure! Do you know exactly what you were sent to do?"

"Do you know why you all were sent here? Why the Steed was woken for the first time in your service? Why your orders are capture, undamaged, when Jarl Erling has never once in his long dying cared whether merchandise arrived intact?" Each question fell like a drop of ink into clear water!
"You were told nothing. Have you asked yourself why he would hide and not come himself?"
Lissana's crimson eyes narrowed!
It was the smallest motion, a fraction of a fraction.
"Careful, all of you." Ormarr had recovered enough to talk.
"He plays games. He talks and talks while..."
"While what, Ormarr?" Noah turned to the Serpent lazily. "Someone as afraid as you shouldn't talk too much. I have already killed a part of you once."
WAA!
Noah spread his arms slightly, and invited them deeper.

His marrow's aura deepened around him, ancient and fiendish and utterly unbothered, and behind him, as if summoned by the gesture, the white-gold threading through THE Creature's obsidian flames burned brighter, and even Anaximander simply floated, unreadable.
"I'll make things even simpler. Sense my existence. Sense the existence of those behind me."
The trapped space went very quiet.
"What does it smell like?" Noah asked softly. "What does it feel like?"
Twenty True Lifeforms, against every tactical instinct they possessed...sensed!
They could not help it! The question was already inside them, and their ancient senses reached across the gap, and what came back was exactly what he knew it would be. Primeval weavings.
What they felt before. The white-gold light that had split this Dimension's sky for light years, the bloom every one of them had sensed and raced toward, and it had come from HERE, from THESE beings!

"You all felt the light. Your dying master pointed you at things backed by Primeval Ones and told you nothing. So I will ask the only question that matters...Will you all stake your lives to infuriate the Primeval Lifeforms sitting behind us...for the dying Jarl who could not even come here himself? How many years does that cursed fucker have left to live anyways? You all will be free soon enough...or are you waiting for his death to loot his corpse? Is this part of why you are in his service?"
He pulled and pulled as much information as he could as he bullshitted!
The question detonated in silence!
Hesitation rolled through the formation like a slow wave.
For a long moment, the party Jarl Erling had built held its breath!
And then Lissana spoke.
Her voice came exactly as it had before and it cut through every seeded doubt!
"I am only a blade."
Her crimson eyes rested on Noah, and there was nothing in them! No fear his aura could catch, no doubt his questions could water, no ambition his knowledge could leverage. Nothing but function!
"I am pointed, and I strike. Nothing else matters."
She barely moved her fingers.

It was less than a gesture! A whisper of motion at the end of one red sleeve, the kind of movement a being makes brushing away dust, and in the next moment, the space between them simply agreed with her!

Noah's defenses were bypassed! The layered folds of his Osmontian Source Infinity, the passive refusals of THE Unmoved Verdict, the conforming pressure of THE Sovereign Existence, edge after edge after edge slid past all of them as if they were opinions and she was fact, and a huge gash tore open across Noah's chest!

His flesh parted! And stellar crimson-blue-gold blood gushed out into the storm, blood that burned faintly with ancient light as it scattered across the trapped dark, and THE True Human Emperor's body rocked backward through the suppression field with his presense split open for every watching eye!
And Lissana looked down coldly as she repeated herself...
"I said, Kneel."

chapters.title: Chapter 5521: Fear and Doubt! I
paragraphs: He floated in the trapped dark, split open, and he had never looked more like an Emperor.

The gash across his chest wept freely, and yet Noah's body did not so much as sway! He hung in the storm with his crown gleaming and his shoulders level, dark bluish hair drifting in the pressure-winds of a Cenozoic enemy, and his blood...his blood did not fall.
It swirled!

Stellar crimson-blue-gold blood rose from his wound in slow, glorious ribbons, coiling around his figure like loyal serpents of burning light, each droplet threaded with Primeval Osmontian Cells that glimmered against the dark, and the sight of it silenced parts of the party that Lissana's attack had been meant to embolden! For wounded things were supposed to diminish. Prey was supposed to shrink when cut!
And the crowned figure before them bled upward, wore his own blood as regalia, and gazed ahead with nothing on his face but calmness.

|You are facing tremendous adversity. THE Aura of THE Protagonist has been triggered, and it has been pouring since the space sealed. Twenty-one True Lifeforms and a burden-bearer whose existence is the strike, all arrayed against you alone. The Aura is drinking every drop of this impossibility. +100,000 Osmontian Biomass has been gained so far. The count climbs while you stand here.|

|You have been wounded by a malicious foreign authority. THE Primeval Osmontian Marrow has read the wound, and production of THE Primeval Osmontian Cells is accelerating. You are bleeding, and per its design, you will continue to bleed for these few seconds, deliberately, as the deeper condition engages.|

|THE Primeval Osmontian Berserker state has been triggered. Your existence now elevates the more injured you become. Production, accelerated. Healing, accelerated. Power, Intent, Output, all climbing in proportion to your wounds. She cut you to punctuate a command, Master. She has instead turned a key.|
Prompts of majesty and wonder bloomed!

And his existence began to give off even grander waves of power! The fiendish ancient aura of the Marrow deepened around his bleeding frame, blue-gold pressure rolling out in slow tides that tasted older with every pulse, and the swirling ribbons of his blood burned brighter as the Berserker state fed on the very gash meant to humble him.
At this moment, three figures came to float beside him.
THE Creature drifted to his right, obsidian flames threaded with white-gold, his flat gaze fixed ahead. Anaximander settled at his left, robes drifting, unreadable.

And THE Infiniverse's manifestation took her place at his shoulder, composed and cold-eyed even as her realms strained. All three of them stood against the pressure pressing from every direction, the Steed's suppression grinding down on their weavings, Lissana's sealed space coiled around them, twenty True Lifeforms arrayed beyond, and every one of them felt the strain, and not one of them showed it.
Yet even in such a precarious position, Noah seemed unbothered as he floated there and looked towards Lissana.
Him. Kneel?

He almost wanted to laugh! He literally could not do it even if he wanted to, as his very identity was that much against it. THE Unkneeling Crown was his First Foundation! No Ego hierarchy in existence could place him beneath it, and no command could bend knees that his own weavings refused to own! Her demand was not merely offensive. It was, for him specifically, structurally impossible!
So. How could he bullshit to gain more time?
He could always...keep talking.

And the more he withstood this adversity, the more Osmontian Biomass he gained from it! He had to do this, as there was very real danger here, danger that could end everything, and within him, THE Infiniverse had to be protected. Every second bought was a second closer to the hopeful thing racing across the dark!
So...
Noah, even while bleeding, gazed at Lissana and Ormarr and the others, and began to tell a story.

"In a certain dimension, there was a king who ruled over a wealthy valley, protected by a massive stone dam that held back the roaring sea. He was a proud man, convinced that because he was king, nothing he built could ever fail."
The party stared! A story? The bleeding fucker was telling them a story?!

"One morning, his chief architect rushed into the throne room, trembling with fear. 'My King,' he cried, pointing out the window, 'look at the dam! A massive crack has split the center wall, and water is spraying into the air! We must evacuate!'"
Noah's voice rolled on, calm and unhurried, his blood swirling grandly around him as he spoke.

"The king walked to the window and looked right at the spraying water. But his pride was a thick blindfold. He turned around, smiled, and said, 'Do not be foolish. I built that wall. It is perfect because it is mine. That is not a crack; it is just the morning sun playing tricks on your fearful eyes.'"
The stone hound's ears had flattened. The three-faced female's every face watched him now!

"The next day, the crack grew into a roaring chasm. Sea water rushed into the valley, flooding the palace gardens and sloshing across the throne room floor. The servants packed their bags and fled for the hills. Yet, the king just lifted his robes, stepped onto his golden chair, and looked away from the window. 'The gardeners have simply over-watered the lilies,' he insisted to the empty room. 'The sea would never dare defy my kingdom.'"
His gaze drifted, slow and deliberate, across every listening face!

"An hour later, the dam completely shattered. A wall of black water smashed through the palace, tearing down the walls of stone and gold. The violent current swept the king away, stripping him of his crown and his heavy robes."

"He washed up alive on a barren, muddy shore miles down the coast. When he finally opened his eyes, he had no crown, no servants, and no subjects. His entire kingdom was gone, buried forever under the ocean he chose not to see."
The moment he finished telling this story, Lissana coldly waved her hand again!

The space agreed with her a second time, and another gash tore open across Noah's shoulder as blood erupted into the storm! And his figure...his figure shockingly became even more glorious! The fresh ribbons of stellar blood joined the coiling regalia around him as the Berserker state drank the new wound, his aura climbing another register, ancient and fiendish and rising, a being who was visibly, impossibly, growing grander with every cut she gave him.
|Adversity deepening. +47,000 Osmontian Biomass gained since the last report. The rate of production of THE Primeval Osmontian Cells has accelerated again with the second wound.|
Noah looked ahead through the swirling burning blood, and he could see it plainly now.
Hesitation. On all of them!

On Ormarr, whose coils had drawn tight around his own center! Hesitation on every face in the formation...except one. Lissana alone remained untouched, unread, unmoved, this being simply that unique, a blade that doubt could find no edge to settle on.
So Noah spoke to the ones it could.
"Cracks have began to appear for all of you, as the Dam is about to shatter." His voice carried through the sealed space, quiet and vast at once.

"I am the messenger telling you to save yourselves. While I may be weaker than you, what I represent is a raging sea that will sweep away everything about your existences. Heed my message. Turn away."
And he simply floated there, bleeding gloriously!

The crowned figure hung wrapped in slow-turning ribbons of Primeval blood, wounds worn like decorations, ancient aura rolling off him in patient tides, gazing at a formation of apex beings with the serene disappointment of a king reviewing subjects who had arrived late, and not one being present could reconcile what their senses reported with what their eyes were seeing, and that irreconcilable gap was where fear lived.
But Lissana began to billow with terrifying power!

Her red robes lifted as her existence finally, truly, gathered itself, crimson light bleeding off her frame in blade-thin sheets that sliced the storm into ribbons, and her toneless voice came once more!
"I don't need to kill one particular target." Her crimson eyes fixed on Noah alone. "But you...you can die..."
"Wait, Lissana..."

It was Ormarr! Ormarr Grimtunge was actually the one to speak, his grand voice cracked through with open hesitation, the follower's terror of blame at last outweighing the follower's terror of his betters, and Noah looked on grandly as his seeds bloomed in the unlikeliest soil.
And within his own stillness, a memory rose.
The prophecy of Ryaenara's brother. Ulf!
Three deaths must the deathless die before the door swings wide
The felt, the made, the borrowed self, each one must be united
Choose true, O brief and burning one, for choices carve the way
And what was written in the white was written from today
Three deaths. Would he truly need to die once, here, today?
He found himself questioning it, and he found, turning the question over, that he actually did not have any heavy emotions attached to it at all. To die was to be human.
And he had something that made it so he could return from death!
But he could not die so easily. Not here, not cheaply, not with THE Infiniverse in the balance!

He was about to turn his head at this moment toward the Steed itself, toward the dying colossus whose Causes were still listening, when Lissana raised her hand fully, the skies of the sealed space beginning to shake as a terrifying Intent howled awake, an edge the size of an era swinging back for its stroke!
At such a time...
"Aba, she is here!"
Seo-yeon's voice rang out from within THE Infiniverse!
And in the next second...
BOOM!
Existence shuddered, fractured, and collapsed all at once as an unfathomably heavy aura descended!

chapters.title: Chapter 5522: Fear and Doubt! II
paragraphs: The storm parted.

It did not part the way storms part for power, shoved aside and resentful! It parted the way crowds part for royalty, currents of raging Infinity and Primordial Source drawing back upon themselves in long reverent curtains, and through the opened sky, descending before the golden island in a slow fall of white light...
Came a dragon.
A pure-white dragon!

Noah and all the others watched her descent, and even here, even wounded and sealed and surrounded, every gaze present was pulled upward and held! She was colossal, her pearl-white scales layered like plates of living moonlight, faint rivers of silver shimmering through them with each beat of her vast wings! Twin horns of translucent ivory spiraled back from her skull, and between them drifted a mane of soft white flame that burned without fuel and without end! Around her titanic limbs, the scars of shattered chains still smoked faintly, crimson burn-lines wrapped like the ghosts of shackles!
And her body radiated pain.

The curse was plain upon her. Terminal weavings guttered through her frame in slow dying threads, the same collapse that hollowed the gray colossus behind the war-host, ages deep and unhealed, and every beat of her wings carried the weight of something that had been hurting for thousands of years.
And yet...she carried tremendous regality.

The pain did not bow her. The curse did not diminish her! She descended like a queen returning to a throne room that had wronged her, her golden eyes sweeping the sealed space with cold command, and the dying light within her burned somehow prouder than the living light of everything arrayed against her!
Noah looked at her with shining eyes.
Was this it? Was this the hopeful dying cluster of Causes he had been waiting for, the one rushing toward them like someone running to a long-awaited door?!

|A conflicting field has appeared. The newcomer's ambient weavings carry the same architecture of dimensional sovereignty as the Steed of Oblivion, and the two sovereignties do not stack. They contest. Her field has rejected the imposition of the Steed of Oblivion across this region. The suppression is breaking.|
And Noah felt it.

The terrifying strain that had been grinding down on THE Infiniverse eased all at once, the gray pressure peeling back off her realms like a hand releasing a throat, and beside him, THE Infiniverse's manifestation exhaled as her compressed weavings finally unfurled! The ambient Biomass tick stuttered, and resumed. Noah could breathe easier, his Pantheon flexing against his backbone once more, and the mechanic he had only theorized bloomed proven across the battlefield.
Two Steed-fields...cancelled each other!
His eyes locked onto her, and hers came down to meet him.

And Noah felt a variety of emotions moving in those vast golden pupils! Pain, ancient and banked. Wariness, sharp and counting! Exhaustion deeper than eras, and beneath all of it, running through every ring of those ring-in-ring pupils, one thing pulsed stronger than all the rest.
Profound immensity, and majesty!

It was like looking at something sacred. This was older than power, the gravity of an unbroken line, of something seated by hands that predated every framework he had ever climbed, and those eyes pulsed with immensity and with pure, terrible hope as she looked down at him coldly and asked...
"Are you the one...to fulfill the promise?"
Noah blinked at these words.
What the hell promise?

He had not the faintest idea what this magnificent dying wonder was talking about! But he was wounds deep into the greatest bluff of his existence, and stopping now was not among his options, so he had to continue bullshitting, and at this moment, behind his calm face, his gaze quietly drank her in.
THE Protagonist's Omniscient Regard activated.

|Character Sheet: Hvitrmarr, The White Steed. Danger to you: immense in capability, none in disposition. She descends, unbroken, from one of the FIRST Steeds, the original brood whose First Causes were seated PERSONALLY by Those Who Remain. Her architecture is truer than every Steed of the later broods, which is why her Cause fails slower, and why her ambient sovereignty just overruled a creature many times her size. Notable thread: she carries inherited ancestral memories, carvings at the bottom of her Cause that she did not live. Notable thread: her lineage transmits a promise, and its surviving shape reads: what living hands seat, living hands can seat again. Notable thread: ?????|
Noah's eyes shined brilliantly as the Sheet settled through him.

First lineage! Seated personally by Those Who Remain! And the promise, there it was, what living hands seat, living hands can seat again, a sentence carried across years of chains. He had no idea what fulfilling it truly required.
But he would do whatever it took to survive!

And so, at this time, Noah gathered himself! He reached down into the deepest architecture of everything he was, into the brilliant light of his Infinite Cause, the first Cause, the one woven inseparably through THE Infiniverse herself! And then he emulated further, drawing up the resonance of his own nine Causes that permeated across THE Infiniverse's endless realms, and even the gathered light of the Causes of the nested Observable Existences within her, generations of living hearts beating inside a living home, all of it channeled upward through his bleeding frame and released through a glorious and calm...
"I AM."
BOOM!
His words released a burst of life very few in all of existence could understand.

It was not power! It was not Intent! It was a burst of living Causes, layered and harmonized and vast, first light upon first light upon first light, unblemished! Uncursed! The radiance of Causes that had been seated by living hands and had never once known terminal weavings, blooming outward through a Dimension where every native Cause had been dying for ages, and it washed across the sealed space like dawn crossing a graveyard!
Hvitrmarr's golden eyes shined brilliantly!
And behind Lissana...the hateful, bored Steed of Oblivion trembled!

Its great gray head, hung low in chained agony for ages beyond counting, shot up! Its guttering eyes fixed across the distance at the source of that impossible light, and through its mountainous frame, the dying Causes that had forgotten everything but pain...listened!
Noah captured all of this movement!
"I am the one that can fulfill that promise. And yet...these insects behind me are standing in the way."
Lissana's expression finally changed!

It was slight, a tightening at the eyes, a fractional stillness in a being made of function, but on that cold face it rang like a bell! And behind her, the Serpent's crimson eyes had gone fully ashen, alongside every other True Lifeform in the formation.
And yet, even as Noah said this, Hvitrmarr's eyes flashed with cold regality!
There was no gratitude in the look she gave him, and no awe.

Her ring pupils passed over his bleeding, glowing, grandstanding figure as if she could see through everything here, through the bluff and the blood-regalia and the borrowed certainty, and her gaze actually moved from him...to THE Infiniverse, resting on the manifestation beside him with an intensity that made her straighten! And then the White Steed spoke.
"There is no time for this. Let's go."
White light erupted from her!

It burst outward in a single silent bloom, a sovereignty of pearl and flame folding over the golden island, over Noah and THE Infiniverse, over the sandy platform, over Anaximander and THE Creature, wrapping all of them in white.
And they all disappeared!
The sealed space stood suddenly, ringingly empty.

Lissana floated before the vacancy where her task had been, her raised hand still holding an unswung stroke, and her crimson gaze was heavy! Around her, twenty True Lifeforms stared at absence, ashen and silent.
And Ormarr Grimtunge howled!
"NO! No no no NO!" His coils thrashed through the storm as the follower's every nightmare arrived at once! "GET THEM BACK! SOMEBODY GET THEM BA-"
But behind them all, his howling was drowned out.

For the Steed of Oblivion was still trembling! The gray colossus strained against its screaming chains, its head thrown high for the first time in ages, its guttering eyes fixed on the point in the dark where the impossible light had vanished, and from its mountainous chest, in an ancient voice that had not spoken across ages of walking agony, it began to bellow out!
"Living! Living, and not Cursed! A Steed, not Cursed!"
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5523: Fear and Doubt! III
paragraphs: <THE Recorder of Wilds>
Upon a golden cloud inside a sealed killing field, an old woman refilled her tea and could not remember the last time an afternoon had given her this much.
She had drifted along inside the formation the entire way, unseen and unsensed, and now she floated barely above the coils of the great Serpent as the party finally cornered its target.
"Well now. Let us see what the target was..."

Her ancient gaze swept the trapped golden island, and it snagged, immediately, on the crowned figure at its heart! She read him the way she read all creatures, peeling the layers with eyes older than the frameworks beneath them, and for the first time in an age...the layers pushed back!

"Hm. Now that is unusual. A young thing. A very young thing, barely into its Trueness, and yet it smells of my own kind. There is Primeval weaving threaded through it, which should not be entirely possible..." She sipped, and her wrinkled eyes narrowed with genuine delight.
Her gaze drifted to the flame-wrapped titan beside him, and paused again!

"And this one. Oh my. This one is not a creature at all, is it. It is a place wearing a shape. The weavings do not stop at its skin, they continue outward into everything nearby, quietly claiming, and behind it..." Her cup stopped halfway to her lips, for her old eyes had found the faint outline folded at the titan's back, the seated colossus of worn gray stone resting just beneath the surface of the visible.
"...well, I shouldn't pry too much on that."
And then the scholar!

She looked at the man in white robes floating placidly amid apex predators, and her reading found...nothing! Simply nothing, an absence shaped like a man, as if existence had agreed not to write anything down about him at all!
"...I have no shelf for that one," the old woman admitted to her tea.
"A lifeform that reads as no lifeform..."
But it was when her gaze landed on the fourth figure that the old woman set down her cup entirely.
The woman standing at the crowned cub's shoulder. She was the biggest oddity on the entire battlefield!
"Oh. Oh my. Now what do we have here." The Recorder leaned forward fully, ancient eyes wide with the purest fascination they had held in eras!
"Is that a Steed? But it can't be a Steed...what...? Is she the target of the Jarl all along?" Her voice dropped to a marveling hush.
Below her, the confrontation unfolded!

"Ah, and here we observe a cornered animal. Twenty-one hunters, a sealed range, no exit. Every creature in nature has a response to this moment. Some bolt. Some freeze. Some bare the throat and hope."
A slow smile folded through her wrinkles as the crowned figure drifted forward, alone, ahead of his own protectors, radiating borrowed enormity!
"Look at him go. He has unbanked every drop of that Primeval scent and is parading it before the colony like a bird spreading feathers it barely owns..."
Then the blade in red cut him, and the old woman clicked her tongue softly.
"The predator does not argue with the puffing bird. She simply cuts it, to remind the flock what is real. Beautiful, in its way."

Then her ancient brows rose, for the cut thing did not diminish! The cub's blood rose off him in swirling ribbons of stellar light as his aura climbed, wounds feeding something in his marrow, and the old woman laughed softly into her sleeve.
The second cut came. The story about the king and the dam rolled out over the killing field, and the Recorder listened to the whole story with her chin in her wrinkled palm, thoroughly entertained!
And then...the storm parted.
HUUM!

The old woman felt it before she saw it, an ambient sovereignty descending through the sky that did not belong to the gray colossus below, and when the white shape came down through the parted currents, THE Recorder of Wilds, Primeval One, watcher of eras, unsensable and unsurprisable...
Was shocked!
Her cup rattled against its tray!
"Oh, you patient, magnificent creature..." The old woman was on her feet upon the cloud now, tea forgotten, ancient eyes drinking in the white dragon's descent with open shining eyes!
She had only began looking when the crowned Emperor below began erupting as he screamed out...I AM!

She watched the burst of living Causes bloom across the graveyard-dark. She watched the gray colossus lift its head for the first time. She watched the white Steed's cold eyes pass straight through the cub's magnificent puffery and land on the woman beside him!

And then the white light erupted, and the entire party, cub and woman and titan and absence and golden island all together, vanished from the sealed space, carried countless distances in a single sovereign fold!

The killing field rang with sudden emptiness! The blade in red stared at vacancy. The Serpent howled about blame! The gray colossus bellowed its first words in ages at the point where the light had gone, and upon her golden cloud above all of it, the old woman stood in the ruins of the afternoon's expectations with her eyes gleaming and her mind turning, deliciously, toward a decision!

Which way now? The fled party, carried off by a powerful Steed? Or the abandoned hunters? She reached down for her tea, weighing wilderness against wilderness, and was just about to choose when a nanosecond later...
BOOM!
The sky above the killing field filled with Steeds.
Eight of them!

Eight dying colossi burst through the storm in harness formation, terminal weavings guttering, ancient eyes burning with impossible rejuvenated hope, and behind them, dragged through the parting dark on chains of cursed lightning, came a throne!
And upon the throne sat a titan of rot and lucidity.
Jarl Skallagrim!

The old woman's brows climbed as she took him in! The Cursed Descendant rode through the sky above Lissana's frozen party with his fissures glowing dull red, his titanic frame draped in the casual grandeur of a being who had stopped performing madness and no longer cared who noticed, and in his open palm, brilliant waves of possibilities churned and folded like a sea of unwritten pages!
He did not slow for the party below. He barely glanced at them! His cold, terribly sane eyes swept across twenty-one shocked and fearful True Lifeforms!
And then Jarl Skallagrim turned his head.
Before his throne passed through the far edge of the killing field, the dying titan turned, unhurried, and stared straight at her.
At HER!
At THE Recorder of Wilds! At a Primeval One whom the Steed of Oblivion could not sense...and this rotting, dying, cursed thing looked directly into her ancient eyes across the open sky...
And nodded coldly!
Then he tugged on the chains of lightning, and the eight rejuvenated Steeds roared, and the throne surged forward through the dark, following exactly where Hvitrmarr had disappeared towards!
The old woman stood very still upon her golden cloud for a long moment.
Then she shook her head slowly as a smile spread across her wrinkled face that was pure, undiluted interest.
Her golden cloud turned, and followed the eight Steeds pulling a throne!

chapters.title: Chapter 5524: Fear and Doubt! IV
paragraphs: <THE True Human Emperor>
They were inside a pocket of space that never stopped moving.
Noah's senses spread out and found no ground, no sky, no fixed point at all.

The golden island floated at the heart of an isolated bubble of stillness while beyond its unseen walls, countless strings of the Dimension tore past in endless luminous rivers, weavings of Infinity and Primordial Source and THE Lingering Word all streaking by like light bending around the center of a black hole.
They were within something that traversed THE Krazhor-Nul without pause, folded inside its wake, carried at speeds that made his earlier island-flight look like drifting!
And before them, the maker of this pocket floated.
Hvitrmarr!

The Cursed Steed's massive body coursed through the Dimension without stopping, her vast white wings beating in slow sovereign rhythm as her pearl-scaled frame filled the moving dark, and her golden ring-in-ring eyes were turned back upon them, looking at him...and at THE Infiniverse.
THE Creature and Anaximander gazed at her with cautious eyes! Her terrifying power saturated the pocket even reined in, a sovereignty that had overruled the Steed of Oblivion.
As for Noah...
He was looking at this as a tremendous opportunity!

For this was exactly what he had been looking for from the moment they arrived in this Dimension and received the information of what Cursed Steeds were. Lifeforms stemming from Those Who Remain, their existences structured to be similar to Observable Existences, living Causes flowing through them! Back then he had envisioned it, and asked himself.

What could be the possibility, if he revived such Causes? If he resuscitated the terminal, dying Causes of such lifeforms?! When he had done it for Terminal Observable Existences, he had replaced their dying hearts with his own Nine Prime Causes, and it had only ever elevated his existence and his Infinite Cause thereafter!

And when he had been searching for directions to take his path as THE True Human Emperor, spreading his weavings across the vastness of existence, across all that was Human...the answer had been right there.
So at this moment, Noah reframed his mind, and began looking at the Cursed Steed before him as if she were Human.
And she fit!

She had gambled everything on hope, a brief and burning wager against certain death. She negotiated, offering her existence in exchange for salvation! She feared her ending and ran from it anyway, and carried uncertainty in her ancient voice the way every Human carried it into every unknowable tomorrow.
Strip away the scales and the size and the sovereignty, and what remained was the pattern he had crowned himself upon, striving, bargaining, hoping, afraid!
Human.
She could be labeled Human. And more practically...as a sick human, but filthy rich! Someone of high standing whose salvation, if he delivered it, would benefit him tremendously!
Was that not Human too? An exchange of favors? Helping one, and in turn, they help you? The oldest Human condition there was!
Noah was about to address this powerful Cursed Steed when her ancient voice rang out first.
"We will all die very soon."

"I miscalculated, and there is no time. Jarl Skallagrim, someone whose power I underestimated, is chasing me with eight others just like me. He is a Cursed Descendant, true and true." Her golden eyes did not blink as the strings of the Dimension tore past beyond her pocket.

"I took a gamble to break my chains, because I sensed hope. Because my existence, filled with dying Causes, sensed it. Now, whether that is you, or her...if the promise really is true...do it now, and do it fast. Because I am chained in this Dimension while being Cursed, and I cannot leave it. I can only keep running across it." A pause, and her vast voice lowered.
"If the promise is true, fulfill it, and I will owe you my existence. If it is merely false weavings of my lineage...then death arrives for us all."
And at this time, Noah sensed it, threaded through her last few words, unmistakable to him.
Uncertainty.
The very Human emotion of uncertainty, carried inside an ancient sovereign voice, a being who did not know if the promise her whole lineage had waited upon was real, and his expression hardened.
A Cursed Descendant with eight Cursed Steeds was chasing after her!
His eyes flashed with immensity as he looked at THE Infiniverse.
"Let's go."
The two of them floated up grandly from the golden island!

Emperor and a unique living Observable Existence rose together through the moving pocket, dark-blue hair and cerulean threads streaming in the wake-winds, and they crossed the open space toward the Cursed Steed as her massive form turned slightly to receive them. And with every measure of distance closed, Noah felt it more.

It was like approaching a terrifying furnace of existence! He was drawing near the core of something that was similar to THE Infiniverse, structured like her, layered like her, Causes turning within a living frame like hers, and yet not her at all, older, wilder, seated by different hands, and wound through with something that made his marrow prickle even at this distance.
And beside him, THE Infiniverse's composed face...broke.
A pained expression crossed her features, her cerulean eyes tightening as her own weavings resonated with the entity before her, and she asked...
"How... can you live with such pain?"
Hvitrmarr's great head lowered slightly, and her answer came calm, and slow.

"One does not live with pain. It leaves no room for living with it." Her golden rings turned. "So one lives beside it. The pain fills every moment I stand inside. Every single one. But it cannot fill the moment that has not yet arrived. So that is where I lived. In the moment that had not yet come. I have lived entirely in tomorrow."
THE Infiniverse's hands curled slowly at her sides.

They neared her massive chest, and the terrifying pressure released from this creature was purposefully reined in, drawn back into her body layer by deliberate layer so that they could approach, and Noah got to take her in fully at last.

Her scales, this close, were wonders. Each one the size of a shield, worn smooth as ancient ivory, pearl-white with hairline lines of age running through them like the memory of every year they had survived, and beneath their surfaces, faint rivers of silver light moved slowly, like veins of a world.

They were warm. That was the shocking thing, warm as living skin, humming faintly with the deep engine-thrum of the Causes turning far beneath! And threaded through the warmth, so fine it could be missed, ran a wrongness, a cold gray filament tracing the border of every scale like frost that refused to melt.
Noah and THE Infiniverse reached out together, and put their hands on these scales.
The moment they did...
HUUM!
His existence shook.

Sharp prickles of pain lanced through him instantly, not from the scale, from everywhere, as if his entire existence was suddenly being hounded and pierced by ten thousand patient needles at once, his weavings flinching, his Causes recoiling, his marrow flaring in alarm!

|You have come into contact with a Lifeform carrying an extremely terrifying Curse, fused into its First Cause and all interlinking Causes within it. This is not ambient Lingering Word. This is a seated, sentenced, active Curse- too much contact, and this Curse can be transferred over to your own Causes.|
His expression became incredibly heavy.

chapters.title: Chapter 5525: Fear and Doubt! V
paragraphs: Because through the contact, through his hands upon her warm ancient scales, he had become capable of fully sensing just what was inside a Cursed Steed.
It was horrendous.
|I have identified the curse. Designation: THE Gnawing Remembrance of Nhaglfarr-Ythok, of Those Who Remain. It manufactures pain from the victim's own capacity to feel.|

|Its function, as I read it: the Curse converts feeling itself into agony. Every emotion the victim experiences is seized and reforged into pain before it finishes being felt. Contentment burns. Memory of joy burns worse, the Curse replays the victim's finest moments through their weavings and chews each one, so that everything they ever loved becomes a returning blade. And hope... Hope burns worst of all. The Curse prices hope above every other feeling, and the moment a victim dares to hope, the gnawing sharpens tenfold. This is why the Steeds of this Dimension stopped hoping ages ago.|

|It never permits adaptation. Every nanosecond, the Curse refreshes the victim's sensitivity, resetting their weavings to feel the pain as if for the first time. There is no dulling. There is no growing numb. Even a thousand years in, the pain is as first-day fresh as it was at the seating. And it forbids escape through death: it sustains the victim at the edge of their existence, feeding on their feeling, and permits their ending only when the Cause is fully consumed.|

|And for the Steeds, it is worst of all. Their Causes are organs of feeling, many living channels through a single existence, and the Curse is threaded through EVERY one. They do not feel the gnawing once. They feel it through every Cause they carry, simultaneously, every nanosecond, from seating until death. The one before you has endured this for three thousand years while choosing, every single day, to keep the capacity to hope, which the Curse punishes above all things...|
Noah's existence winced in pain as merely identifying it made the edges of the Curse taste him back.

And at this time, from beneath his palms, murky dark tendrils began leaking out of Hvitrmarr's scales! Thin filaments of obsidian gray seeped up through the ancient ivory and began stretching onto Noah's hands, and onto the hands of THE Infiniverse, curling, probing, patient, reaching for their weavings as if to infect them.
He had to make a choice here. A gamble!

If he continued, there was a high chance of being branded with a Curse he could not do anything about, a sentence from Those Who Remain hooked into his Causes, into THE Infiniverse's Causes, forever! But if he succeeded...he would reverse the Curse of an utterly unfathomable being while seating his Prime Causes inside a Cursed Steed whose origins were so grand that success would catapult him tremendously.
Noah breathed slowly.
And for the first time in a very long time...he felt Doubt.

Doubt! He had given away his Everything of Doubt a while ago, traded it out of his existence entirely, and yet here it was, regenerated quietly among his many Human emotions, standing in his chest like an old tenant returned to a rebuilt house.

Because should he fail here, it would not only be him. THE Infiniverse would be Cursed alongside him, alongside all their Causes, alongside every realm and every life she carried. His entire path...his whole journey...everything could end against these warm ancient scales.
As he thought of this...
He blinked, in an epiphany.
He was also... feeling fear.
Him? THE True Human Emperor? Noah Osmont, who had walked into apocalypses on purpose and priced adversity like a delicacy? He was feeling...a trace of genuine fear?
Was doubt and fear such a potent human condition? Was it so potent that he regenerated their Everythings to now feel even them? Was this...true of who he was?!
DUM!
He felt the heavy beat of his heart!
And at this moment, from beyond himself, he felt a wave of resonance answer it. Faint flickering flames of the very same feeling, mirrored back at him from the colossal existence beneath his hands.
Hvitrmarr.

Through the contact, through the resonance of fear meeting fear, Noah saw. Deep inside this Cursed Steed, far beneath the scales and the sovereignty and the three thousand years of patience, there was a figure.

A white-robed woman, coiled small in the dark of her own vast existence, arms wrapped around herself, pained! Frightened! This grand Steed, this lifeform who had shattered chains and overruled the Steed of Oblivion and spoken of death with a level voice...also felt fear.
Fear of the oblivion that was coming for her. Fear of feeling nothing and seeing nothing...when she had spent her whole cursed existence feeling everything.
Noah couldn't help but shake his head at that.

And at this time, without him even realizing it, his expression changed. It settled into something that only the true kings and emperors of ancient eras ever obtained, the ones who had learned that leading was never about standing above fear, the quiet certain warmth of a ruler who goes first into the dark so that others may follow, and he spoke softly, to the trembling woman coiled inside the mountain of scales.

"Let me in. I will help you, and you will help me." His hand pressed gently against the warm ancient ivory as the dark tendrils curled around his fingers. "We are both fearful. But it is much easier to overcome this fear together."
He said such words, and Hvitrmarr trembled.

Her colossal frame shuddered once through its whole length as her golden ring-in-ring eyes gazed down at him, at THE Infiniverse beside him, at the two small existences standing willingly against her Cursed chest with the infection already reaching for their hands, and after a moment, after three thousand years of tomorrows arriving all at once...
Her scales opened.
The great plates of ancient ivory parted along seams that had never once unsealed, folding back petal upon petal, and within...utterly sacred and unfathomable wonders revealed themselves.

Vaults of white flame turning in slow rivers! Horizons folded inside horizons, the interior architecture of something forged by the hands that predated every framework, Causes hanging in the deep like dying suns, and all of it threaded through with the gray gnawing dark of the Curse.
And Noah stepped in, alongside THE Infiniverse as his mind pulsed with an epiphany.

To lead was to walk point on the edge of the unknown. Some say that great leaders are fearless...monoliths of absolute certainty who move through chaos without a tremor. But that is a myth and not the reality of human nature.
A truly great human leader does not fear fear. They welcome it, understand it, and transmute it.
BOOM!
Instantly, light detonated across existence!

Endless blue light gushed out of one half of Hvitrmarr, cerulean brilliance erupting through her parted scales and her weavings and her very frame as Noah's Intent and Osmontian Source Infinity and his Prime Causes poured into the ancient interior, painting half of her colossal form in radiant, living, boundless blue.

And in the same nanosecond, endless murky obsidian curse-light bloomed over the other half, THE Gnawing Remembrance rising to answer the intrusion, gray-black malice flooding through the opposing hemisphere of her existence.
It looked like existence in this whole area had been split in two!
One half, endlessly blue. Another half, endlessly dark!
Outside, Anaximander and THE Creature had heavy expressions as they looked out.
For the domain that had been constantly moving...came to a stop.

The pocket dissolved as Hvitrmarr's flight ended, and the surroundings cleared to reveal where the long run had carried them, an ancient billowing stretch of ice, glacial plains folding to every horizon beneath a sky of falling snow, white flakes drifting down through the frozen quiet of THE Krazhor-Nul's far reaches.
And across that white stillness, for light years...one half of existence was painted blue, and another half was painted black.

The colossal form of Hvitrmarr floated at the center of it all, split down her length by two warring lights, blue sovereignty and obsidian sentence grinding against each other through every Cause she carried, and the snow itself fell blue on one side of the sky and gray-black on the other!
And in the next nanosecond...
ROAR!
The cursed black half seemingly roared out with malice!

It surged! Where the two lights had stood at even halves, fifty against fifty, the obsidian cursed brilliance rapidly began to gain ground, swallowing the blue in great gnawing waves, sixty, seventy, covering eighty percent of her colossal frame with horrifying speed, and it only continued to accelerate, an ancient sentence rising to devour the presense that had dared to argue with it!
It was a Curse tracing back to Those Who Remain.
It was undeniable!
