chapters.title: Chapter 5526: Death! I
paragraphs: Somewhere in the cold reaches of an ancient Dimension, a bleeding man stands with his hands on cursed scales, and inside his chest, two old tenants have moved back into a house that evicted them long ago.
Doubt and fear.

And it should be said that even now, even trembling, some corner of that man is questioning. Weighing the gamble, counting the gains, tallying what a reversed curse and a seated Steed would be worth against everything he could lose!

He is not the first to face this homecoming. Every civilization that ever climbed has run the same argument about these two tenants, and the argument begins with corpses. The soldier who doubted his footing for one breath, and the bridge took him. The mother who feared the dark road and so took the long one, and arrived too late. Doubt is the pause where blades find throats. Fear is the counsel of a smaller life! The evidence dies loudly, and so every discipline of power teaches the same first lesson.
Purge them.

Cultivators burn doubt out of their foundations the way farmers burn stubble from a field. Emperors train fear out of their heirs before the heirs can walk. Some go further still, and trade the emotions away entirely, carve them out, hand them to another, and stand afterward in the clean silence where the trembling used to be, and call that silence strength.
And for a while, it is. The purged strike faster. The purged sleep well.
But the doctrine keeps no record of how the purged die, because the ones who could testify are under the water.

Fear is a map with exactly one thing drawn on it: what matters. No being has ever feared the loss of something worthless! A man feels fear at a sickbed because the one in the bed is his whole sky. A queen in chains feels fear of oblivion because she spent three thousand years earning the tomorrow that oblivion would cancel. The fearless do not carry more courage than the fearful. They carry less cargo! Strip a being of everything it loves and watch how brave it becomes, and then ask whether that bravery is worth what was paid for it.
So what is a Human, who is born holding both?
A Human is a brief and burning pattern with no time to armor itself into silence. Humans doubt because their knowledge is partial, and so they check the wall twice, and the wall holds.
Humans fear because everything they hold can be taken, and so they hold it properly, and build anyway, love anyway, cross the dark anyway.
Which brings the matter, at last, to leaders, and to the one distinction on which everything turns.
A good Human leader is not afraid of fear.

For fear denied in the light doubles in the dark, and a leader who cannot admit the tremor in his own hand will demand that no hand around him tremble, and such leaders break their people long before any enemy arrives.

And the fearless cannot lead the fearful. They can only outpace them! A being who feels nothing before the dark can walk into it, certainly, but no bridge exists between his silence and their trembling, and no one follows. It is the leader who feels the fear fully, names it aloud, and steps first regardless who turns terror into a road.

His fear is the proof that the danger is real. His step is the proof that it can be crossed. Fear shared is halved, and fear witnessed being overcome is transformed, and this is the entire mechanism by which frightened peoples have crossed every impossible thing they ever crossed.
Courage was never the absence of fear. Courage is fear, correctly spent.

So when doubt regenerates in a chest that once traded it away, and a heart that forgot the rhythm beats hard against cursed scales, that is not a foundation cracking. That is the foundation completing itself.
Somewhere in the cold, the snow is falling in two colors, and the black half is climbing.
The man with his hands on the scales has his fear, and his doubt, and his greed, and his crown.
Now he must spend them.
Ultimately, the ones who feel everything, and go forward anyway, have always been the strongest things in existence.
<THE True Human Emperor>
Inside Hvitrmarr, Noah held the hand of THE Infiniverse, and he was trembling.

Their joined hands were already stained black. The Curse had wasted no time, murky tendrils sunken into their fingers and crawling up their wrists as their feet darkened where they stood upon the inner weavings of the White Steed, and across Noah's body, gashes tore themselves open one after another! Across THE Infiniverse's frame too, thin lines split her manifestation as blood sputtered out of both of them gloriously, stellar crimson-blue-gold scattering into the vaulted white-flame dark of a living Steed at war with itself!
But even in such a situation...
Noah's body began to pulse with light.

Multicolored radiance bloomed out of his body in slow, mounting waves, the light of his Nine Prime Causes, Existence and Paradox and Chaos and Mana, Quintessence and Adversity, Tyranny and Harvest and Apocalypse, each one a different burning shade turning through his weavings! And beneath them all surged the endless blue light of his Infinite Cause, pouring out of his core in tides as their blackened limbs instantly shone bright, the stains burning back inch by inch, and a sea of blue began to expand around the two of them, pushing the gnawing dark to a perimeter!
And within that fought-for clearing...Noah got to learn exactly what he was up against.
His senses spread through her, and the structure of Hvitrmarr unfolded before him.
She was made up of nine Causes. And they were all First Causes!

Nine First Causes, seated by the hands of Those Who Remain at the dawn of this Dimension, turning through her colossal existence like nine ancient suns! But what was horrendous, what made his expression harden even through the blue light, was HOW they were seated. These Causes were not installed within her the way Prime Causes sat within Observable Existences.
These Causes were bound to her Organs. No. They were her Organs!

Cause and flesh fused into single existing things! When he had resuscitated Terminal Observable Existences, he had replaced their dying Prime Causes the way one replaces a foundations of a building. But here, to replace a First Cause...one would have to replace the Organ of a Cursed Steed itself! Break down living anatomy seated by the makers of this Dimension, and grow new anatomy in its place, all while the Curse defended every inch!
His Sight moved through her, and he discerned them, one by one as these causes...were not the normal causes of Observable Existences.
THE First Cause of Fealty, seated as her Heart! The vast drumming organ at her center, a Cause that beat not for herself but for another, the sworn bond of the First Steeds given muscle and rhythm!
THE First Cause of Honor, seated as her Spine! The unbending column running her colossal length, the Cause of carrying every weight upright and breaking before bowing!
THE First Cause of Valor, seated as her Lungs! Twin oceans of white flame drawing the breath before every charge, courage itself made into respiration.
THE First Cause of Obedience, seated as her Ears! Deep coiled chambers that heard the command before it was spoken, attunement to a rider's will woven into living structure.
THE First Cause of Vigilance, seated as her Eyes! The golden ring-in-ring wonders, the watch that never closes, awareness layered within awareness.
THE First Cause of Endurance, seated as her Bones! The tireless frame that had borne burdens across ages, persistence given architecture.
THE First Cause of Temperance, seated as her Stomach! The furnace that consumed only what duty required and nothing more, restraint as an organ!
THE First Cause of Mercy, seated as her Claws! Strength vast enough to unmake, shaped into instruments that had chosen gentleness for three thousand years!
And THE First Cause of Devotion, seated as her Wings. The great white sails that had only ever flown carrying another before herself, service itself given feathers and flight.

This was what Those Who Remain had built! Not a beast of burden at all, but something sworn and honorable and enduring and devoted, nine virtues seated as nine organs, and then their descendants had cursed the entire order of them and hitched what remained to thrones.
Noah and THE Infiniverse struggled against the pressing dark as he took it all in, and he made his choice in the same breath!
"Ruination. Infiniverse. Confluence."
HUUM!

The fusion slammed through the three of them inside the body of a fourth! His crown unwove into him, THE Infiniverse dissolved into his chest, and THE Quintessential Confluence rose within Hvitrmarr's inner vaults, grades climbing a rank as his frame, already carved with gashes, blazed crimson-gold through the blue! And through the fused sight, the full scale of the task ahead of him resolved without pity.
Nine Organs. Nine fused First Causes. Every one defended by a Curse that punished hope itself, in a body older than the Scales, on a clock measured in the hoofbeats of eight Steeds and an Jarl.
It was almost impossible. He saw that plainly.

And doubt rose, and fear rose with it, the two regenerated tenants beating hard against his ribs! But Noah Osmont was not made of two emotions. He was Human, and Human was a crowded house! His pride rose beside the fear, the pride of a man who had never once left a wall unclimbed.

His stubbornness rose beside the doubt, the mule-hearted refusal that had carried him up from an F Rank Hunter through every apocalypse existence could schedule! His greed rose, pricing the First-lineage Steed and finding the reward worth any gamble!

His love rose, for the daughter sensing agony-clusters and the mother inside his home and the women who depended on him! And above all of them rose the quality that had crowned him, the responsibility of THE True Human Emperor, the plain and total conviction that if all that was Human was his to gather, then all that was Human was his to protect, and the Human thing before him was dying.
Fear said the wall was high. Every other thing he was said... climb.
He had to try. And he had to succeed!
But how?! How could he resuscitate Causes that were not merely Terminal, but fused into flesh and filled with a Curse that lashed out against every touch?!

sentences.text: Somewhere in the cold reaches of an ancient Dimension, a bleeding man stands with his hands on cursed scales, and inside his chest, two old tenants have moved back into a house that evicted them long ago.
Doubt and fear.
And it should be said that even now, even trembling, some corner of that man is questioning.
Weighing the gamble, counting the gains, tallying what a reversed curse and a seated Steed would be worth against everything he could lose!
He is not the first to face this homecoming.
Every civilization that ever climbed has run the same argument about these two tenants, and the argument begins with corpses.
The soldier who doubted his footing for one breath, and the bridge took him.
The mother who feared the dark road and so took the long one, and arrived too late.
Doubt is the pause where blades find throats.
Fear is the counsel of a smaller life!
The evidence dies loudly, and so every discipline of power teaches the same first lesson.
Purge them.
Cultivators burn doubt out of their foundations the way farmers burn stubble from a field.
Emperors train fear out of their heirs before the heirs can walk.

Some go further still, and trade the emotions away entirely, carve them out, hand them to another, and stand afterward in the clean silence where the trembling used to be, and call that silence strength.
And for a while, it is.
The purged strike faster.
The purged sleep well.
But the doctrine keeps no record of how the purged die, because the ones who could testify are under the water.
Fear is a map with exactly one thing drawn on it: what matters.
No being has ever feared the loss of something worthless!
A man feels fear at a sickbed because the one in the bed is his whole sky.
A queen in chains feels fear of oblivion because she spent three thousand years earning the tomorrow that oblivion would cancel.
The fearless do not carry more courage than the fearful.
They carry less cargo!
Strip a being of everything it loves and watch how brave it becomes, and then ask whether that bravery is worth what was paid for it.
So what is a Human, who is born holding both?
A Human is a brief and burning pattern with no time to armor itself into silence.
Humans doubt because their knowledge is partial, and so they check the wall twice, and the wall holds.
Humans fear because everything they hold can be taken, and so they hold it properly, and build anyway, love anyway, cross the dark anyway.
Which brings the matter, at last, to leaders, and to the one distinction on which everything turns.
A good Human leader is not afraid of fear.

For fear denied in the light doubles in the dark, and a leader who cannot admit the tremor in his own hand will demand that no hand around him tremble, and such leaders break their people long before any enemy arrives.
And the fearless cannot lead the fearful.
They can only outpace them!
A being who feels nothing before the dark can walk into it, certainly, but no bridge exists between his silence and their trembling, and no one follows.
It is the leader who feels the fear fully, names it aloud, and steps first regardless who turns terror into a road.
His fear is the proof that the danger is real.
His step is the proof that it can be crossed.
Fear shared is halved, and fear witnessed being overcome is transformed, and this is the entire mechanism by which frightened peoples have crossed every impossible thing they ever crossed.
Courage was never the absence of fear.
Courage is fear, correctly spent.
So when doubt regenerates in a chest that once traded it away, and a heart that forgot the rhythm beats hard against cursed scales, that is not a foundation cracking.
That is the foundation completing itself.
Somewhere in the cold, the snow is falling in two colors, and the black half is climbing.
The man with his hands on the scales has his fear, and his doubt, and his greed, and his crown.
Now he must spend them.
Ultimately, the ones who feel everything, and go forward anyway, have always been the strongest things in existence.

chapters.title: Chapter 5527: Death! II
paragraphs: Noah looked around the vaulted dark, at the nine ancient suns and the gnawing gray threaded through every one, and the decision assembled itself with the cold clarity of a craftsman surveying a ruin.
He would simply have to replace the Organs themselves, no big innovations needed.

Break down cursed anatomy seated by the makers of a Dimension. Grow new Organs from his own existence in the wounds left behind. Seat his Prime Causes into the growing flesh and hope that the grafts would take!
So much work. So much impossible work!
He proceeded ahead, and started.
"The Lungs first, and I will need as much help as you can give, Hvitrmarr!" Noah declared, and moved!

He descended through her inner vaults to the twin oceans of white flame, THE First Cause of Valor laboring beneath its gray threading, every breath of the great Steed dragging through cursed channels! And Noah set his fused existence against it as his Intent erupted.

THE Ananke Intent of THE Quintessential Osmontian poured out of him in prismatic seas as his Osmontian Source Infinity followed in continental tides, and he began to BREAK the Organ down with the help of Hvitrmarr herself!

He did not do it crudely, not destructively, but the way a master smith unmakes a flawed blade, edge by edge, fold by fold, his Intent declaring each cursed weaving unwoven as his Infinity dissolved the freed matter into raw potential.

The cost was staggering! A tremendous portion of his Intent's output and whole oceans of his Source Infinity vanished into the unmaking of a single Organ, his reserves screaming, his gashes tearing wider with the strain.
But he had boundless reserves.
And then came the replacing.
Noah raised his carved arms, and began to guide the blood raging around his body!

The Berserker blood! The swirling stellar regalia of crimson-blue-gold that had wreathed him since Lissana's cuts, saturated with Primeval Osmontian Cells, and he sent it flowing in glorious rivers down into the hollow where Valor's lungs had been! And into that flowing blood, he infused a portion of THE Primeval Osmontian Marrow itself, a seam of his own stellar blue-gold bone-architecture, seeded into the wound as the base of an Organ of a grand Steed!
The blood pooled. The marrow-seed took root. And flesh began to bud.

New lungs grew in the hollow, woven from his Cells and his blood and his seated Prime Cause of Adversity, courage-through-challenge pouring into the growing chambers, and then Noah's eyes widened, for the budding Organ was doing something he had not designed!
It held a mixture.

His Prime Cause of Adversity burned through the new flesh, and threaded through it, refusing to leave, rising out of the dissolved ruin of the old Organ like a stubborn ghost, came THE First Cause of Valor! The two Causes were MIXING!

Adversity and Valor winding around each other in the budding lungs, his weavings and the First weavings of Those Who Remain fusing into something that was neither and both, and the new Organ drew its first breath with a sound like a war-horn learning tenderness.
One. One Organ, budding and mixed and alive, and the cost of it had hollowed him his existence even with his boundlessness!
Noah steadied his carved body, turned toward the Heart of Fealty, and that....was when the Curse stopped defending.
And attacked.

THE Gnawing Remembrance of Nhaglfarr-Ythok had watched something dare to begin replacing it. Watched something dare to CURE! And the ancient sentence, offended beyond all measure, made a decision that proved beyond any doubt that it was cognizant.
It sacrificed itself.

Across Hvitrmarr's vaulted existence, four of the nine Organs suddenly blazed gray-black as the Curse burned its own holdings! Its potent grip on the Eyes of Vigilance, the Ears of Obedience, the Claws of Mercy, and the Wings of Devotion, four First Causes' worth of seated, ancient, concentrated Curse, torn out of those Organs entirely and converted, all at once, into fuel.
Into one attack!
ROAR!

The insidious eruption came from every direction at once, a tidal wave of weaponized sentence, four organs' worth of three-thousand-year agony condensed into a single gnawing tsunami, and it fell upon the fused figure of Noah with the full offense of a maker's malice!
It was not something he could possibly withstand.
His blue sea shattered! His Prime Cause lights bent! The wave crashed through his Intent and his Infinity and his budding triumph, and Noah felt it instantly, coldly, completely.
His collapse was coming.
Not a wound and most definitely not a setback.
His existence, fused and elevated and Berserker-burning, was going to break under this, and nothing he could run in any stretched instant said otherwise!
Death was coming.
And THE True Human Emperor...moved grandly.

There was no panic in him! There was no scrambling! Even as the Curse invaded his existence, gray-black threads chewing into his weavings, he kept his Prime Causes burning gloriously, nine colors blazing through the collapse like banners refusing to lower, and he looked, in the closing moments, not at the wave.
He looked at the four sacrificed Organs.

Eyes. Ears. Claws. Wings! Four Organs the Curse had abandoned to fuel its killing stroke, four First Causes sitting undefended for the first time in three thousand years, and Noah, dying, saw the trade laid bare upon the table and paid it with both hands.
He sent his blood.

Seas of gushing stellar blood erupted from his splitting frame, four glorious rivers of crimson-blue-gold roaring outward through the collapsing vaults, and even as he died, he began infusing his Causes into them.

Marrow-seed and Cell and Prime weaving poured into the Eyes as Quintessence met Vigilance! Into the Ears as Mana met Obedience! Into the Claws as Tyranny met Mercy, strength and gentleness winding together!
Into the Wings as Harvest met Devotion, and in the growing lungs behind him Adversity and Valor still burned, five Organs, five mixtures, five buddings seeded in the space of his own ending!
The wave closed over him.
His body split! His infinite seas of power were torn open down their length, and in the final fraction of the final instant, Noah made his last choice, and chose true.

He folded the collapse INWARD, taking the entire attack fully into himself, wrapping his split halves around the presences fused within him so that THE Infiniverse and Ruination, sheltered inside the breaking, would gain no damage at all! His ending would be his alone. Not his home's. Not his crown's.
And as everything came apart, THE True Human Emperor roared his last word into the dark!
"I AM QUINTESSENTIAL!"
BOOM!

The roar detonated through Hvitrmarr's vaulted existence as the five seeded Organs answered it, budding flesh blazing with mixed Cause-light, his Cells igniting through Eyes and Ears and Claws and Wings and Lungs, five ancient suns rekindling in new colors even as their gardener was unmade.
His body split apart in halves of guttering light.
And within the splitting, untouched by the wave, buried deeper than any attack naturally reached, one small organ shone!
A liver!
THE Hepatarch of the Undying Root gleamed resplendantly even in death, a quiet steady star inside the ruin of an Emperor, holding, holding, holding!
But it would not act in this moment. It could not! And so, for the first time in his entire grand existence, across every era and apocalypse...
Noah died.
Immense darkness folded around him, soft and total, and the last thing that moved through him was not fear, and was not doubt.
He was Quintessential. He was also Human.
And to be human...was to die.
Somewhere beyond the darkness, snow was still falling across an ancient white stretch of ice, and inside a white Steed, upon the white of his own guttering light, a death was being written.
Three deaths must the deathless die before the door swings wide.
What was written in the white...was written from today.
<THE Infiniverse>
The Emperor was dead.

His split halves drifted apart through the vaulted dark of the White Steed, two ruins of guttering light trailing stellar blood into the black, and the Curse's spent wave rolled onward past them, and for one single nanosecond, the inside of Hvitrmarr held nothing but silence.
Then, from each of his split halves...figures rose.

From one half, woven strings of crimson-gold gathered themselves upward into the illusory body of a woman crowned in her own circlet, Ruination, untouched, unharmed, exactly as her Master's final fold had ensured. And from the other half, cerulean threads spiraled up into the illusory manifestation of THE Infiniverse, whole and undamaged, standing upon the broken light of the being who had wrapped his own ending around her like armor!
Two figures. Two halves. One dead Emperor between them.
And the rage that rose off of both of them was unfathomable.

Ruination's illusory face was perfectly composed as her strings spread out from her in their thousands, and every single string was pulled tighter than a blade's edge, her fury expressed in pure, cold, absolute function! And THE Infiniverse, the efficient one, the serious one, the one who rarely smiled and never wasted a motion, stood over her Master's ruin with her hands slowly closing into fists as her cerulean eyes burned, and the realms within her, thousands of them, countless lives, all of it, tilted toward wrath like an entire existence leaning into a storm!
He had taken it alone. He had SPLIT rather than let one thread of it touch them!
"We continue!" Ruination said, and her voice had never been colder.
They moved!

The two of them poured their wills down into the dead Emperor's cells, and the cells answered! For THE Primeval Osmontian Cells did not know their maker had died, they knew only their work, and Ruination's strings threaded through the four blood-rivers still flowing toward Eyes and Ears and Claws and Wings, guiding, weaving, holding every budding graft in its proper form! THE Infiniverse's authority flooded the growing Lungs where Adversity and Valor still wound together, feeding the mixture, steadying its first breaths!
And when the Curse came creeping back...they were waiting.

Gray-black filaments slunk toward the five budding Organs, the gnawing sentence reaching to reclaim what it had sacrificed, and it found the way barred! Ruination's strings cut the filaments apart with surgical, vicious precision, no wasted force, no mercy, each thread of Curse unwoven the instant it extended! THE Infiniverse's dimensional weavings sealed around each budding Organ like the walls of her own realms, and the Curse pressed, and probed, and found five fortresses where five wounds had been!
New Causes had already bloomed!
The five Organs budded on, safe, mixing, growing, tended by the two loyal existences of a dead man.
And then THE Infiniverse went a step further.
Her burning eyes rose from the defended five, and fixed across the vaulted dark upon the vast drumming Organ at the Steed's center, still wrapped in its full portion of ancient Curse.
THE First Cause of Fealty. The Heart!

The Cause that beat for another. The sworn bond given muscle! And what was SHE, if not exactly that?! A living Observable Existence whose every realm turned around her Master, whose every Cause had bent toward him since her birth, whose loyalty was not a feeling but her fundamental architecture.
If any Organ in this cursed being answered to her nature, it was that one, and her Master had died five Organs into a nine-Organ war, and she would not stand guard over his work.
She would ADVANCE it!
And so, THE Infiniverse roared out.

The sound tore through the vaulted existence of the White Steed as, deep within Noah's broken body, the hidden Infiniverse herself, the true her, the living Observable Existence seated through his weavings with her thousands of realms and her nested skies and her billions of burning lives, shone brilliantly and erupted!
Hvitrmarr felt it all as it felt like her body was warring with itself, but she felt the hope ever so close as she lent all the help she could against the Curse.
BOOM!
Cerulean light detonated out of the dead Emperor's halves in a pillar that split the inner dark from vault to vault.

The full unfurled presense of an Observable Existence poured across the distance toward the cursed Heart of Fealty, realms condensing into radiance, Causes massing into tides, a loyal existence hurling her entire self at the center of an ancient sentence in her dead Master's name.
The Curse rose snarling around the Heart to meet her.
And beneath all of it, in the quiet ruin of the split halves, drifting in the dark where no light reached and no war touched...
The glimmering liver began to pulse.
Once.

The insidious eruption came from every direction at once, a tidal wave of weaponized sentence, four organs' worth of three-thousand-year agony condensed into a single gnawing tsunami, and it fell upon the fused figure of Noah with the full offense of a maker's malice!
It was not something he could possibly withstand.
His blue sea shattered!
His Prime Cause lights bent!
The wave crashed through his Intent and his Infinity and his budding triumph, and Noah felt it instantly, coldly, completely.
His collapse was coming.
Not a wound and most definitely not a setback.
His existence, fused and elevated and Berserker-burning, was going to break under this, and nothing he could run in any stretched instant said otherwise!
Death was coming.
And THE True Human Emperor...moved grandly.
There was no panic in him!
There was no scrambling!

Even as the Curse invaded his existence, gray-black threads chewing into his weavings, he kept his Prime Causes burning gloriously, nine colors blazing through the collapse like banners refusing to lower, and he looked, in the closing moments, not at the wave.
He looked at the four sacrificed Organs.
Eyes.
Ears.
Claws.
Wings!

Four Organs the Curse had abandoned to fuel its killing stroke, four First Causes sitting undefended for the first time in three thousand years, and Noah, dying, saw the trade laid bare upon the table and paid it with both hands.
He sent his blood.

Seas of gushing stellar blood erupted from his splitting frame, four glorious rivers of crimson-blue-gold roaring outward through the collapsing vaults, and even as he died, he began infusing his Causes into them.
Marrow-seed and Cell and Prime weaving poured into the Eyes as Quintessence met Vigilance!
Into the Ears as Mana met Obedience!
Into the Claws as Tyranny met Mercy, strength and gentleness winding together!
Into the Wings as Harvest met Devotion, and in the growing lungs behind him Adversity and Valor still burned, five Organs, five mixtures, five buddings seeded in the space of his own ending!
The wave closed over him.
His body split!
His infinite seas of power were torn open down their length, and in the final fraction of the final instant, Noah made his last choice, and chose true.

He folded the collapse INWARD, taking the entire attack fully into himself, wrapping his split halves around the presences fused within him so that THE Infiniverse and Ruination, sheltered inside the breaking, would gain no damage at all!
His ending would be his alone.
Not his home's.
Not his crown's.
And as everything came apart, THE True Human Emperor roared his last word into the dark!
"I AM QUINTESSENTIAL!"
BOOM!

The roar detonated through Hvitrmarr's vaulted existence as the five seeded Organs answered it, budding flesh blazing with mixed Cause-light, his Cells igniting through Eyes and Ears and Claws and Wings and Lungs, five ancient suns rekindling in new colors even as their gardener was unmade.
His body split apart in halves of guttering light.
And within the splitting, untouched by the wave, buried deeper than any attack naturally reached, one small organ shone!
A liver!
THE Hepatarch of the Undying Root gleamed resplendantly even in death, a quiet steady star inside the ruin of an Emperor, holding, holding, holding!
But it would not act in this moment.
It could not!
And so, for the first time in his entire grand existence, across every era and apocalypse...
Noah died.
Immense darkness folded around him, soft and total, and the last thing that moved through him was not fear, and was not doubt.
He was Quintessential.
He was also Human.
And to be human...was to die.
Somewhere beyond the darkness, snow was still falling across an ancient white stretch of ice, and inside a white Steed, upon the white of his own guttering light, a death was being written.
Three deaths must the deathless die before the door swings wide.
What was written in the white...was written from today.
<THE Infiniverse>
The Emperor was dead.

His split halves drifted apart through the vaulted dark of the White Steed, two ruins of guttering light trailing stellar blood into the black, and the Curse's spent wave rolled onward past them, and for one single nanosecond, the inside of Hvitrmarr held nothing but silence.
Then, from each of his split halves...figures rose.

From one half, woven strings of crimson-gold gathered themselves upward into the illusory body of a woman crowned in her own circlet, Ruination, untouched, unharmed, exactly as her Master's final fold had ensured.

And from the other half, cerulean threads spiraled up into the illusory manifestation of THE Infiniverse, whole and undamaged, standing upon the broken light of the being who had wrapped his own ending around her like armor!
Two figures.
Two halves.
One dead Emperor between them.
And the rage that rose off of both of them was unfathomable.

Ruination's illusory face was perfectly composed as her strings spread out from her in their thousands, and every single string was pulled tighter than a blade's edge, her fury expressed in pure, cold, absolute function!

And THE Infiniverse, the efficient one, the serious one, the one who rarely smiled and never wasted a motion, stood over her Master's ruin with her hands slowly closing into fists as her cerulean eyes burned, and the realms within her, thousands of them, countless lives, all of it, tilted toward wrath like an entire existence leaning into a storm!
He had taken it alone.
He had SPLIT rather than let one thread of it touch them!
"We continue!" Ruination said, and her voice had never been colder.
They moved!
The two of them poured their wills down into the dead Emperor's cells, and the cells answered!

For THE Primeval Osmontian Cells did not know their maker had died, they knew only their work, and Ruination's strings threaded through the four blood-rivers still flowing toward Eyes and Ears and Claws and Wings, guiding, weaving, holding every budding graft in its proper form!
THE Infiniverse's authority flooded the growing Lungs where Adversity and Valor still wound together, feeding the mixture, steadying its first breaths!
And when the Curse came creeping back...they were waiting.
Gray-black filaments slunk toward the five budding Organs, the gnawing sentence reaching to reclaim what it had sacrificed, and it found the way barred!
Ruination's strings cut the filaments apart with surgical, vicious precision, no wasted force, no mercy, each thread of Curse unwoven the instant it extended!
THE Infiniverse's dimensional weavings sealed around each budding Organ like the walls of her own realms, and the Curse pressed, and probed, and found five fortresses where five wounds had been!
New Causes had already bloomed!
The five Organs budded on, safe, mixing, growing, tended by the two loyal existences of a dead man.
And then THE Infiniverse went a step further.
Her burning eyes rose from the defended five, and fixed across the vaulted dark upon the vast drumming Organ at the Steed's center, still wrapped in its full portion of ancient Curse.
THE First Cause of Fealty.
The Heart!
The Cause that beat for another.
The sworn bond given muscle!
And what was SHE, if not exactly that?!
A living Observable Existence whose every realm turned around her Master, whose every Cause had bent toward him since her birth, whose loyalty was not a feeling but her fundamental architecture.
If any Organ in this cursed being answered to her nature, it was that one, and her Master had died five Organs into a nine-Organ war, and she would not stand guard over his work.
She would ADVANCE it!
And so, THE Infiniverse roared out.

The sound tore through the vaulted existence of the White Steed as, deep within Noah's broken body, the hidden Infiniverse herself, the true her, the living Observable Existence seated through his weavings with her thousands of realms and her nested skies and her billions of burning lives, shone brilliantly and erupted!
Hvitrmarr felt it all as it felt like her body was warring with itself, but she felt the hope ever so close as she lent all the help she could against the Curse.
BOOM!
Cerulean light detonated out of the dead Emperor's halves in a pillar that split the inner dark from vault to vault.

The full unfurled presense of an Observable Existence poured across the distance toward the cursed Heart of Fealty, realms condensing into radiance, Causes massing into tides, a loyal existence hurling her entire self at the center of an ancient sentence in her dead Master's name.
The Curse rose snarling around the Heart to meet her.
And beneath all of it, in the quiet ruin of the split halves, drifting in the dark where no light reached and no war touched...
The glimmering liver began to pulse.
Once.

chapters.title: Chapter 5528: Death! III
paragraphs: <THE True Human Emperor>
Death was not empty.

That was the first thing Noah learned on the other side of it. The immense darkness that had folded around him thinned, and sensation returned without a body to carry it, and he found himself standing upon an endless sea of red.
It was heavy.

Heavy the way a debt is heavy, the way a name spoken at the wrong funeral is heavy, and the red stretched out to every horizon without a single wave, thick and still and patient, and across its surface, floating in their countless numbers...
Were bodies.
All those he had killed.

They floated face-up as far as any sight could reach! The countless he had killed in his home world when it was still tiny. Those from the dungeons, beasts and horrors he had cleaved through by the thousands for essence! Those from the Beast World, from Atlantis, from the Demon World, warriors and monarchs and soldiers who had stood in formations against him.

Those from his Universe. From his Cosmos! From his Wheel of Existence, hierarchies he had erased in afternoons, hosts he had unmade between conversations! From his Observable Existence and every battlefield across every era of his climb, they floated in the red, countless past counting, an ocean floored with everything his ascension had cost everyone else.
And each of them seemed to be looking at him.

Their eyes were open. Every single one! And though no mouth moved, the question rose off the red sea like heat, asked in the countless voices of the drowned, pressing against him from every direction at once.
Why?
Why did we deserve to die?
Noah stood upon the heavy red, and did not look away.
And then, out of the endless sea of blood, directly before him...a body rose.

It came up slowly, red parting off its shoulders, and it did not float like the others. It stood! A figure with light gold hair falling past his ears, fair skin that shone faintly gold as if dawn had been rubbed into it, adorned in a white robe that the sea somehow did not stain, and his eyes, as they opened upon Noah, were cold.
Noah knew him.
The precipice of the Novus Galaxy. The octagonal shattered space. The raving laughter in his closing palm.
It was Aldrich, the Founder of the Celestials!

But there was no madness in him now. Death, it seemed, had returned what desperation had taken, and the being who had died a raving lunatic stood upon the sea of his killer's making with the cold, composed dignity of what he had been before the end.
"Do you remember my last day?" Aldrich asked.
His voice carried flatly across the red.
"I remember it completely. Death is generous that way. It returns every moment you spent dying, and lets you hold them all at once." His golden eyes did not blink.

"I stood at the very precipice of the Novus Galaxy, at the edge of everything I had ever known, with my essence spent and your tendrils around my limbs. I had been magnificent once. A Founder! Raised up from nothing, given strength, given purpose, given a Galaxy to shepherd. And then I learned what I was. A puppet. A thing on strings, raised up and thrown away like nothing the moment the play required it."

"So I did the only thing a cornered puppet could do. I rang the bell. I broke the barrier of my own home and called destruction down upon the enemy I could not defeat, and I laughed, because it was the first act of my entire existence that no string had chosen for me."
The sea of red was utterly silent around his words.
"And you crushed me. Mid-sentence, mind you. You folded your palm and ended me the way one crushes a bug." His head tilted slightly.
"So I will ask you what all of them are asking." One golden hand swept slowly across the endless floating dead.

"Why did I deserve to die? All I was trying to do was break past the lines of fate laid through me. Past a destiny that others had set! Is that not what you have done at every single step? You defied your system. You defied your Galaxy, your Universe, your Cosmos, your Scales! You have made a crown out of refusing every script ever written for you. I refused ONE script, ONE time, at the very end, with my last breath." His cold eyes fixed on Noah's.
"Why did you deserve to go on...and I deserved your palm?"

The question rolled out across the sea, and the countless dead seemed to lean into it! Every open-eyed body in the red asking through him, the soldiers born into wrong banners, the hierarchies erased between errands, the groups unmade for standing in formations they never chose, all of their why gathered into one golden-haired vessel standing dry-robed upon an ocean of consequence.
And Noah looked at Aldrich calmly.

He did not flinch from it. He did not reach for comfortable weavings, for they-attacked-first, for any of the soft accountings the living tell themselves about their dead! He stood upon the sea he had filled, and let the question weigh what it weighed, and when he answered, his voice was quiet, and grand, and tyrannical, and human, all four at once.
"The dead should stay dead."

"That is my first answer, and it is respect! Your day ended, Aldrich. It ended completely, at the edge of your Galaxy, with your one free act burning in your hands. Nothing I say here can add to it or take from it, and nothing you ask here can reopen it. The dead pleading their case to the living is the living's dream, not the dead's right. You had your last day."
Noah's gaze moved past him then, across the endless red, across every open eye in the ocean.
"And my second answer is for all of you." His voice carried to every horizon.

"Across existence, all of us seek to defy fate and destiny. All of us! The hierarchies I erased were defying their extinctions, and you, Founder, were defying your strings, and I was defying everything, and every single one of us reached for the same forbidden thing with the same desperate hands."
His eyes came back to Aldrich, and they were level, and they did not apologize.
"Some fail. Some succeed. You did not die because you deserved it. Deserving was never consulted! You simply failed."
"And I...I have yet to fail."
Aldrich stared at him for a long moment.
And whatever the dead do with honesty, he did it in silence.
Then Noah rose.

He drifted upward off the heavy surface, and turned, and looked out at the endless seas of blood and corpses stretching behind him, at every era of his climb floating face-up in the red. He would not pretend they did not weigh. And he would not let them anchor.
He waved his hand.
And shockingly, his grasp closed around the ENTIRE sea!
Every horizon of it, every drop of red, every floating body across every direction, gathered into the will of a single gesture, and atop all of it, Noah imposed...an endless blue!

His color! The color of his Infinity, of his Source, of his identity, of every road he had climbed and every road still unclimbed, and it poured across the red sea from the point of his palm outward in a tide that did not ask permission!

The heavy red drank the blue and became it. The countless bodies sank gently beneath the rising color, their open eyes closing one by one as the blue took them, questions settling, accounts not erased but carried, an ocean of consequence folded whole into the identity of the one who owed it!
"Ashes to ashes," Noah said softly, to all of them, to every era, to the golden-haired vessel watching him from the settling tide. "Dust to dust!"
And then, endless blue covered everything!

It rose past the horizons and over the sky of that heavy place, blue upon blue upon blue without floor or shore, and through the totality of it, through the whole claimed ocean of everything he had done and everything he still owed...
Noah felt his existence waking from death!

chapters.title: Chapter 5529: Emergence!
paragraphs: The first thing that existed was a pulse.
DUM.

One beat, in an ocean of nothing, and Noah existed around it the way sound exists around a struck bell! He had no body yet. He had no eyes, no frame, no seas of power! There was only the pulse, and the quiet certainty folded inside it, and the pulse was a liver.
THE Hepatarch of the Undying Root was rebuilding him.
DUM. DUM.

And what a strange, profound thing it was, to be regrown from one's own organ! He felt himself assembling outward from that single glimmering seed, layer by patient layer, and the Root did not rebuild him the way healing rebuilds, flesh first and self after. It rebuilt him self FIRST!

His records returned in vast ordered floods, era upon era pouring back into being, the skill book, the dungeons, the crowns, the graves, every climb and every cost! His memories seated themselves. His Intent reassembled around its own claim, I am, I am, I AM, each beat of the Root another syllable of the sentence that was him! His authority, his Tongue, his Letters, his Foundations, all of it drawn back out of the Root's deep reserve and rewoven, and only then, only around a self already whole, did the flesh come!
And the flesh that came...was new.

For the Root did not have his old body to copy from. His old body had been split apart and spent! So it built him from what he had become, and what he had become was THE Primeval Osmontian Marrow, and so bone by bone, weaving by weaving, Noah Osmont was rebuilt...entirely out of Primeval Osmontian Cells.

Not threaded with them. MADE of them! A body woven wholly from matter that was part Primeval and part him, from his skeleton to his blood to the seas of his Infinity and Source, and as the last of it knitted closed and his eyes opened within the vaulted dark of the White Steed...
He felt it immediately.
His Intent and his Osmontian Source Infinity felt unfathomably light, and unfathomably sharp!

Where his power had once moved through him like great oceans, heavy and vast, it now moved like drawn light! Every expression of his will arrived without friction, every thread of his Infinity answered before the asking finished, an existence rebuilt without a single seam of its old climbing, and Noah flexed one new hand slowly as stellar blue-gold light traced through fingers that had never existed until this moment!
|Welcome back, Master. THE Hepatarch of the Undying Root is exhausted. It cannot act again until its reserve regrows. Do not die twice.|
He was reborn. And the door behind him was closed!
Noah rose through the vaulted dark, and looked out upon the war he had died in the middle of.

The five Organs he had seeded still budded, strong and defended, Adversity winding through Valor's new lungs, Quintessence through Vigilance's eyes, Mana through Obedience, Tyranny through Mercy, Harvest through Devotion, five mixed suns burning in colors this Dimension had never grown! Ruination's strings webbed the spaces between them, cutting down every creeping filament of gray!
And at the center of everything, wrapped around the vast drumming Heart of Fealty, THE Infiniverse was already working on the Sixth Organ.

She blazed! Her full unfurled presense was pressed against the cursed Heart in tides of cerulean, realms condensed into radiance, a living Observable Existence grappling an ancient sentence with her entire self, holding ground she had held alone through the whole of her Master's death, and Noah's chest tightened around the sight of her, his loyal one, his home, fighting his war while his body was still being written!
Then the Curse sensed him.
And THE Gnawing Remembrance of Nhaglfarr-Ythok went mad.

The gray-black mass around the Heart convulsed as its awareness snapped across the vaulted dark to the figure it had killed, the figure it had spent four Organs' worth of itself to kill, standing whole and new and burning quietly in the deep, and the shock that tore through the ancient sentence was a physical thing! The whole interior of Hvitrmarr shuddered with it! It had ended him. It had felt him end! And the ended thing was looking at it.
"Yes," Noah said. "Me."
And he moved!

What followed was arduous, and it was glorious! Noah crossed the vaulted dark like a drawn blade as his new existence sang, and he fell upon the cursed Heart beside THE Infiniverse, his lightened Intent slicing into gray weavings that had shrugged off his old self's oceans, his sharpened Infinity dissolving anchor after anchor, and the Sixth Organ's unmaking, which had cost him a collapse before, unfolded now beneath hands that moved with rebuilt purity.

The Heart of Fealty came apart in careful folds as his blood poured into the hollow, marrow-seed taking root, and THE Prime Cause of Existence flowed down into the budding chambers to wind around THE First Cause of Fealty, a bond fused to being itself, a heart that would beat for another as irrevocably as it existed at all.
And through it, at last, Hvitrmarr herself continued to join the war.

The White Steed, still bearing the full agony of the Curse across her remaining Organs, still burning in the pain that had filled three thousand years, burned with valor! Her vast sovereignty pressed down upon her own cursed anatomy from without as Noah tore at it from within, Steed and Emperor working the same wound from both sides, and her ancient voice rolled through her own vaults, tight with pain and with purpose as she finally got the handle of what Noah was doing!
"The Spine next. I will hold it still!"
They cut!

The Spine of Honor came apart between her stillness and his edge as Paradox poured into the rebuilding column, honor fused with contradiction, a spine that could bear opposing weights without breaking!
HUUM!
The Bones of Endurance followed, her frame screaming as her own skeleton was unmade and regrown, Chaos winding through Endurance, persistence that renewed itself from raw potential!

And the Stomach of Temperance last, the furnace that had only ever consumed what duty required, and into its rebuilt chambers flowed THE Prime Cause of Apocalypse, transformative endings seated inside perfect restraint, destruction that would forever after be a tool held by discipline.
And with every Organ that fell and rose again...the Curse lost its anchors!
It ROARED!

The gray-black mass raged through the shrinking territory left to it, mad past all sentience, an ancient sentence watching its grammar torn out word by word, and it lashed and gnawed and burned, and found nothing left to hold!
Nine Organs. Nine budding mixtures of First Cause and Prime Cause. Not one single seat remaining for a curse that had ruled this existence.
And at that moment, Noah closed his eyes.

He floated at the center of the White Steed's vaulted existence, and he sensed his Causes! All nine of them, no longer merely his, intermingled through nine ancient Organs with nine First Causes seated by the very hands of Those Who Remain!

Existence wound through Fealty. Paradox through Honor. Chaos through Endurance, Mana through Obedience, Quintessence through Vigilance, Adversity through Valor, Tyranny through Mercy, Harvest through Devotion, Apocalypse through Temperance!

Eighteen Causes in nine marriages, an anatomy that no maker and no framework had ever once contained, humming through the body of a First-lineage Steed, and every single one of them was waiting on his word!
His eyes opened, and they were endless blue.
Noah said quietly, to the raging, anchorless dark...
"You have gnawed at Steeds for ages, and chewed hope out of an entire brood."
His voice did not rise, and the whole of two existences leaned into it.
"But everything ends. And this existence is mine now, and yours ended the moment you killed me and I disagreed." His hand rose. "It is time for you to go."
And using his Causes as engines...he turned everything on.
BOOM!

All nine Organs of the White Steed IGNITED at once! Nine mixed suns roared to full burn as Cause fed Cause fed Cause, Fealty's new heart hammering, Valor's new lungs drawing a breath the size of an era, Honor's spine blazing down her colossal length, and from every Organ, from every marriage of First and Prime, endless blue light erupted and poured through the entirety of Hvitrmarr's existence, flooding her vaults, her weavings, her scales, her three thousand years, one rising tide of living radiance that sought to cover everything!
<THE Creature>
Upon the ancient stretch of ice, beneath the falling snow, THE Creature and Anaximander had been watching grimly.

For the dark had nearly won! They had stood witness across the light-years-long split of existence as the obsidian half climbed past eighty percent, past ninety, the blue guttering down to threads, and neither of them had been able to intervene, for the war was inside a sovereignty neither could enter, and there is no watching in all of existence heavier than watching a friend's light go out from the wrong side of a wall!
The blue had almost died. They had felt something end in there. Something vast.
And then, moments ago...the endless blue had risen!

It had come back up out of the black like a drowned dawn refusing the water, climbing, spreading, driving the obsidian before it, and now, across the frozen plains, the colossal form of the White Steed burned blue from horn to tail-tip, and at this moment...
Hvitrmarr raised her head.
Her great neck arched back against the snowing sky, her jaws opened wide, and she ROARED.

From her jaws, a pillar of murky obsidian light shot up! The whole gathered mass of the Curse, every gray-black thread of an ancient sentence torn from every Organ and every weaving, expelled in a single column that tore through the storm, and as it climbed, the pillar changed! The murk burned away along its length as white-blue light consumed it from below, obsidian becoming radiance becoming brilliance, and the pillar crossed upward across Gigaparsecs of the Dimension's sky, a lance of transformation visible from unfathomable distances!
And it was...brilliant.

It was an endless white-blue of unfathomable Causes! Eighteen of them, First and Prime in nine marriages, announcing themselves through the expelled corpse of the thing that had chained them, the light of an existence that was living, fully, loudly, freely, and becoming free of its Curse before the eyes of the watching dark.
And alongside it, from the White Steed herself, an unfathomably pure aura of immensity erupted.

It rolled out across the frozen plains in a single sovereign wave, and Anaximander and THE Creature, an absence no framework could file and Existence itself mid-digestion toward Ananke, staggered! Their legs bent! The two of them had to grab each other's shoulders, scholar gripping titan and titan gripping scholar, bracing against one another to make sure they did not kneel upon the ice!
For this was not even pressure. Pressure, they could have refused!
This was regality!

The unbroken authority of the First lineage, uncursed for the first time in three thousand years, seated now upon eighteen living Causes, the presense of a queen restored to what the living hands had originally made, and it did not demand that they kneel, it simply made kneeling feel like the oldest and most natural posture in existence!
The aura of regality...was too grand!

sentences.text: The first thing that existed was a pulse.
DUM.
One beat, in an ocean of nothing, and Noah existed around it the way sound exists around a struck bell!
He had no body yet.
He had no eyes, no frame, no seas of power!
There was only the pulse, and the quiet certainty folded inside it, and the pulse was a liver.
THE Hepatarch of the Undying Root was rebuilding him.
DUM.
DUM.
And what a strange, profound thing it was, to be regrown from one's own organ!
He felt himself assembling outward from that single glimmering seed, layer by patient layer, and the Root did not rebuild him the way healing rebuilds, flesh first and self after.
It rebuilt him self FIRST!
His records returned in vast ordered floods, era upon era pouring back into being, the skill book, the dungeons, the crowns, the graves, every climb and every cost!
His memories seated themselves.
His Intent reassembled around its own claim, I am, I am, I AM, each beat of the Root another syllable of the sentence that was him!
His authority, his Tongue, his Letters, his Foundations, all of it drawn back out of the Root's deep reserve and rewoven, and only then, only around a self already whole, did the flesh come!
And the flesh that came...was new.
For the Root did not have his old body to copy from.
His old body had been split apart and spent!

So it built him from what he had become, and what he had become was THE Primeval Osmontian Marrow, and so bone by bone, weaving by weaving, Noah Osmont was rebuilt...entirely out of Primeval Osmontian Cells.
Not threaded with them.
MADE of them!

A body woven wholly from matter that was part Primeval and part him, from his skeleton to his blood to the seas of his Infinity and Source, and as the last of it knitted closed and his eyes opened within the vaulted dark of the White Steed...
He felt it immediately.
His Intent and his Osmontian Source Infinity felt unfathomably light, and unfathomably sharp!
Where his power had once moved through him like great oceans, heavy and vast, it now moved like drawn light!

Every expression of his will arrived without friction, every thread of his Infinity answered before the asking finished, an existence rebuilt without a single seam of its old climbing, and Noah flexed one new hand slowly as stellar blue-gold light traced through fingers that had never existed until this moment!
|Welcome back, Master.
THE Hepatarch of the Undying Root is exhausted.
It cannot act again until its reserve regrows.
Do not die twice.|
He was reborn.
And the door behind him was closed!
Noah rose through the vaulted dark, and looked out upon the war he had died in the middle of.

The five Organs he had seeded still budded, strong and defended, Adversity winding through Valor's new lungs, Quintessence through Vigilance's eyes, Mana through Obedience, Tyranny through Mercy, Harvest through Devotion, five mixed suns burning in colors this Dimension had never grown!
Ruination's strings webbed the spaces between them, cutting down every creeping filament of gray!
And at the center of everything, wrapped around the vast drumming Heart of Fealty, THE Infiniverse was already working on the Sixth Organ.
She blazed!

Her full unfurled presense was pressed against the cursed Heart in tides of cerulean, realms condensed into radiance, a living Observable Existence grappling an ancient sentence with her entire self, holding ground she had held alone through the whole of her Master's death, and Noah's chest tightened around the sight of her, his loyal one, his home, fighting his war while his body was still being written!
Then the Curse sensed him.
And THE Gnawing Remembrance of Nhaglfarr-Ythok went mad.

The gray-black mass around the Heart convulsed as its awareness snapped across the vaulted dark to the figure it had killed, the figure it had spent four Organs' worth of itself to kill, standing whole and new and burning quietly in the deep, and the shock that tore through the ancient sentence was a physical thing!
The whole interior of Hvitrmarr shuddered with it!
It had ended him.
It had felt him end!
And the ended thing was looking at it.
"Yes," Noah said.
"Me."
And he moved!
What followed was arduous, and it was glorious!

Noah crossed the vaulted dark like a drawn blade as his new existence sang, and he fell upon the cursed Heart beside THE Infiniverse, his lightened Intent slicing into gray weavings that had shrugged off his old self's oceans, his sharpened Infinity dissolving anchor after anchor, and the Sixth Organ's unmaking, which had cost him a collapse before, unfolded now beneath hands that moved with rebuilt purity.

The Heart of Fealty came apart in careful folds as his blood poured into the hollow, marrow-seed taking root, and THE Prime Cause of Existence flowed down into the budding chambers to wind around THE First Cause of Fealty, a bond fused to being itself, a heart that would beat for another as irrevocably as it existed at all.
And through it, at last, Hvitrmarr herself continued to join the war.
The White Steed, still bearing the full agony of the Curse across her remaining Organs, still burning in the pain that had filled three thousand years, burned with valor!

Her vast sovereignty pressed down upon her own cursed anatomy from without as Noah tore at it from within, Steed and Emperor working the same wound from both sides, and her ancient voice rolled through her own vaults, tight with pain and with purpose as she finally got the handle of what Noah was doing!
"The Spine next.
I will hold it still!"
They cut!

The Spine of Honor came apart between her stillness and his edge as Paradox poured into the rebuilding column, honor fused with contradiction, a spine that could bear opposing weights without breaking!
HUUM!
The Bones of Endurance followed, her frame screaming as her own skeleton was unmade and regrown, Chaos winding through Endurance, persistence that renewed itself from raw potential!

And the Stomach of Temperance last, the furnace that had only ever consumed what duty required, and into its rebuilt chambers flowed THE Prime Cause of Apocalypse, transformative endings seated inside perfect restraint, destruction that would forever after be a tool held by discipline.
And with every Organ that fell and rose again...the Curse lost its anchors!
It ROARED!

The gray-black mass raged through the shrinking territory left to it, mad past all sentience, an ancient sentence watching its grammar torn out word by word, and it lashed and gnawed and burned, and found nothing left to hold!
Nine Organs.
Nine budding mixtures of First Cause and Prime Cause.
Not one single seat remaining for a curse that had ruled this existence.
And at that moment, Noah closed his eyes.
He floated at the center of the White Steed's vaulted existence, and he sensed his Causes!
All nine of them, no longer merely his, intermingled through nine ancient Organs with nine First Causes seated by the very hands of Those Who Remain!
Existence wound through Fealty.
Paradox through Honor.
Chaos through Endurance, Mana through Obedience, Quintessence through Vigilance, Adversity through Valor, Tyranny through Mercy, Harvest through Devotion, Apocalypse through Temperance!

Eighteen Causes in nine marriages, an anatomy that no maker and no framework had ever once contained, humming through the body of a First-lineage Steed, and every single one of them was waiting on his word!
His eyes opened, and they were endless blue.
Noah said quietly, to the raging, anchorless dark...
"You have gnawed at Steeds for ages, and chewed hope out of an entire brood."
His voice did not rise, and the whole of two existences leaned into it.
"But everything ends.
And this existence is mine now, and yours ended the moment you killed me and I disagreed." His hand rose.
"It is time for you to go."
And using his Causes as engines...he turned everything on.
BOOM!
All nine Organs of the White Steed IGNITED at once!

Nine mixed suns roared to full burn as Cause fed Cause fed Cause, Fealty's new heart hammering, Valor's new lungs drawing a breath the size of an era, Honor's spine blazing down her colossal length, and from every Organ, from every marriage of First and Prime, endless blue light erupted and poured through the entirety of Hvitrmarr's existence, flooding her vaults, her weavings, her scales, her three thousand years, one rising tide of living radiance that sought to cover everything!
<THE Creature>
